domains.name: vehicle
domains.description: SSOT for all vehicle master data across the enterprise. Owns VIN-level vehicle identity, model configurations, trim levels, MY (Model Year) lifecycle from SOP (Start of Production) to EOP (End of Production), powertrain variants (ICE, HEV, PHEV, EV), platform architectures, and ADAS feature sets. Serves as the authoritative reference for every downstream domain that needs to identify or describe a vehicle instance.

products.name: vin_registry
products.description: SSOT for every physical vehicle instance identified by its 17-character VIN per ISO 3779. Captures decoded VIN structure (WMI, VDS, VIS), manufacturing plant code, production sequence number, build date, model year (MY), line-off timestamp, homologation market, and current lifecycle status (pre-production, in-production, in-transit, in-service, end-of-life). This is the enterprise anchor record — the single identity key — that every downstream domain (sales, aftersales, logistics, mobility, finance) references to identify a specific vehicle unit.
products.reference: ISO 3779 VIN Standard / NHTSA VIN Decoder

products.name: model
products.description: Defines the commercial vehicle model (nameplate) as a business entity — e.g., F-150, Camry, Model 3. Captures model name, brand/marque, vehicle segment (sedan, SUV, pickup, commercial), body style, drive configuration (FWD, RWD, AWD, 4WD), primary market, launch MY, EOP MY, and program code. Serves as the top-level classification anchor for all vehicle configurations and trim hierarchies.

products.name: vehicle_model_year_program
products.description: Governs the MY (Model Year) lifecycle for each model, from SOP (Start of Production) through EOP (End of Production). Tracks planned SOP date, actual SOP date, planned EOP date, actual EOP date, regulatory MY designation, CAFE compliance year, homologation status per market, and program phase (concept, development, launch, production, wind-down). Links model to its annual production program and drives downstream planning in manufacturing and supply chain. This product is the single source of truth (SSOT) for its concept in the ECM Lakehouse.

products.name: vehicle_trim_level

Captures trim code, trim name, market positioning tier, MSRP base price, standard feature set description, target market region, and active/inactive status. Trim levels are the primary commercial differentiation unit used in sales, dealer ordering, and MSRP pricing. This product is the single source of truth (SSOT) for its concept in the ECM Lakehouse.

Used for homologation, CAFE compliance, and consumer-facing specifications.

products.name: platform

Platforms are shared across multiple nameplates and model years, making this a critical cross-model reference for engineering, manufacturing, and supply chain.

Captures configuration code, market region, build feasibility status, MSRP, destination charge, fuel economy label values, emissions certification status, and production plant assignment. products.name: vehicle_option_package
products.description: Defines factory-installed option packages, standalone options, exterior colors, and interior trim selections available for vehicle configurations. Captures option code, option name, option type (package, standalone, accessory, exterior color, interior trim), MSRP uplift, content description, availability constraints (trim/market/powertrain restrictions), mutually exclusive options, and required prerequisite options. Drives dealer order configuration, window sticker (Monroney label) generation, and BOM explosion in manufacturing. This product is the single source of truth (SSOT) for its concept in the ECM Lakehouse.

products.name: build_spec
products.description: The as-built specification record for a specific VIN, capturing the exact combination of configuration, options, colors, powertrain, and features installed on that vehicle unit as it rolled off the production line. Captures VIN reference, configuration code, exterior color, interior trim selection, all installed option codes, actual build date, plant code, production sequence number, and any deviation from standard specification (e.g., special order, fleet spec, running change). This is the definitive as-built record used by aftersales, warranty, recall population identification, and residual value analytics.

products.name: homologation

Captures homologation type (whole vehicle type approval, component approval), regulatory framework (FMVSS, ECE, NCAP, CARB, EPA), approval authority, certificate number, approval date, expiry date, applicable model/MY/market, emissions standard tier (e.g., EPA Tier 3, Euro 6d), and compliance status. Critical for market launch readiness and regulatory reporting.

Supports OTA update management, cybersecurity compliance, and aftersales diagnostics.

products.name: vehicle_ota_deployment
products.description: Association product representing the deployment of an OTA campaign to a specific vehicle. Each record captures the operational details of that deployment, linking one vin_registry record to one ota_campaign record.. Existence Justification: Each OTA campaign can be applied to many individual vehicles, and a single vehicle can receive multiple OTA campaigns over its lifecycle. The deployment of a campaign to a vehicle is recorded as a distinct operational event with its own status, timestamps, and version information, which is actively created and managed by the OTA management team.

products.name: ownership
products.description: This association product represents the ownership relationship between a vehicle (vin_registry) and a party (customer). It captures acquisition and disposition dates, ownership type, and ownership number, tracking the history of which parties own which vehicles.. Existence Justification: A vehicle can be owned by multiple parties over its lifecycle (e.g., resale), and a party can own multiple vehicles simultaneously. The business actively records each ownership event with dates, type, and ownership number, and users query ownership history for warranty, service, recall, and resale analytics.

products.name: campaign_enrollment
products.description: Association representing the enrollment of a vehicle (identified by VIN) into a service campaign. Captures enrollment status, dates, remedy completion, parts and labor costs, and warranty coverage for each vehicle‑campaign pair.. Existence Justification: Vehicles are enrolled in service campaigns; each campaign can affect many vehicles and a single vehicle can participate in multiple campaigns over its lifecycle. The enrollment is actively managed by aftersales operations and carries its own data such as notification dates, status, remedy completion, parts and labor costs, and warranty coverage.

products.name: regulatory_compliance_assignment
products.description: This association captures the compliance relationship between a vehicle model and a regulatory requirement. It records the compliance status, the date the requirement became effective for the model, and any notes specific to that pairing.. Existence Justification: Each vehicle model must satisfy multiple regulatory requirements, and each regulatory requirement applies to many vehicle models. The compliance team actively maintains a matrix that records the compliance status, effective dates, and notes for every model‑requirement pair.

domains.name: product
domains.description: SSOT for the commercial vehicle product catalog and program portfolio. Owns nameplate definitions, model year program plans, option and package configurations, BOM (Bill of Materials) product structures, MSRP price books, feature-to-market availability matrices, and SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) structures. Distinct from engineering (which owns technical design data) and vehicle (which owns VIN-level production instances).

products.name: bom_header
products.description: Product-level BOM (Bill of Materials) header record representing the commercial product structure for a given SKU or model year program. Captures BOM number, BOM type (commercial/engineering/service), effective date range, revision level, plant applicability, BOM status (active/superseded/obsolete), and total component count. This is the commercial BOM owned by the product domain — distinct from the engineering BOM managed in Teamcenter/Windchill, which is owned by the engineering domain. This product is the single source of truth (SSOT) for its concept in the ECM Lakehouse.
products.reference: BOM Header (SAP PP / Teamcenter BOM Management)

products.name: product_bom_line
products.description: Individual component line items within a product BOM (Bill of Materials). Captures BOM line number, part number, part description, part type (raw material/sub-assembly/purchased component/fastener), quantity per vehicle, unit of measure, effective date range, plant applicability, alternative item group, scrap factor percentage, and PPAP (Production Part Approval Process) status. Enables product cost rollup, MRP (Material Requirements Planning) explosion, and supply chain sourcing alignment. This product is the single source of truth (SSOT) for its concept in the ECM Lakehouse.
products.reference: BOM Item / Component (SAP PP CS01 / Teamcenter BOM Line)

products.name: product_segment

Captures segment code, segment name, segment hierarchy level, parent segment, SAE/industry classification code, competitive set definition, and applicable regulatory category. Used in market planning, competitive benchmarking, CAFE fleet averaging, and sales reporting. This product is the single source of truth (SSOT) for its concept in the ECM Lakehouse.

products.name: catalog_publication

Captures publication ID, catalog version, publication type (dealer/consumer/regulatory/internal), target system/channel, publication date, effective date range, published-by user, publication status (draft/approved/published/recalled), and distribution confirmation. Provides an audit trail of when and to whom catalog versions were released. This product is the single source of truth (SSOT) for its concept in the ECM Lakehouse.

products.name: package_availability
products.description: Associates an option package with a dealership, capturing the availability status and launch date for that package at the dealer. Each record links one option package to one dealership and stores attributes that belong only to this relationship.. Existence Justification: Dealerships actively manage which option packages they carry, setting an availability status and launch date for each package. Each option package can be offered by many dealerships, and each dealership can offer many option packages, creating a many‑to‑many relationship that carries its own attributes. This product is the single source of truth (SSOT) for its concept in the ECM Lakehouse.

products.name: pricing_condition_assignment
products.description: Represents the assignment of a pricing condition to a specific vehicle SKU. Each record links one SKU to one pricing condition and captures attributes that exist only in the context of this assignment, such as the condition value and its validity period.. Existence Justification: A pricing condition (e.g., discount, tax, freight) can be applied to many vehicle SKUs, and each SKU can have multiple pricing conditions such as MSRP, discounts, taxes, and fees. The pricing team actively creates, updates, and deletes these assignments, and each assignment carries attributes like value, validity dates, type, and status. This operational management makes the relationship a true many‑to‑many business entity. This product is the single source of truth (SSOT) for its concept in the ECM Lakehouse.

attributes.name: material_specification

attributes.name: owning_department
attributes.description: Engineering department or cost center that owns and is accountable for this test sample (e.g., 'Chassis Engineering', 'Powertrain NVH', 'Body Structures'). Used for resource allocation and cost tracking.

attributes.name: part_revision
attributes.description: Engineering revision or release level of the part at the time the sample was produced (e.g., 'A', 'B1', '03'). Critical for ensuring test results are attributed to the correct design iteration.

attributes.name: production_date
attributes.description: Date on which the test sample was physically manufactured or assembled. Used for age-related degradation analysis and correlation with production process parameters.

attributes.name: quantity_available
attributes.description: Current count of sample units available for testing, accounting for units already consumed, destroyed in destructive tests, or allocated to other test programs.

attributes.name: quantity_received
attributes.description: Number of individual sample units received in the shipment or batch. Supports sample allocation planning across multiple concurrent test programs.

attributes.name: reach_svhc_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the sample contains any Substance of Very High Concern (SVHC) as defined under EU REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006. Triggers mandatory disclosure and potential substitution requirements.

attributes.name: receipt_date
attributes.description: Date the test sample was received at the engineering test facility or laboratory. Marks the start of the sample custody chain and is used for scheduling and lead-time tracking.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether testing of this sample is mandated by a regulatory authority (e.g., UNECE, EPA, NHTSA, EU type approval) as opposed to being an internal engineering validation requirement.

attributes.name: responsible_engineer
attributes.description: Name or employee ID of the lead engineer responsible for this test sample and its associated test activities. Used for accountability, escalation, and PLM workflow routing.

attributes.name: rohs_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the sample complies with EU RoHS Directive 2011/65/EU restricting the use of hazardous substances (lead, mercury, cadmium, etc.) in electrical and electronic equipment.

attributes.name: safety_critical_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this sample is classified as a safety-critical component (e.g., braking, steering, airbag, fuel system) requiring enhanced traceability, witness testing, and regulatory sign-off.

attributes.name: sample_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the physical or virtual test sample, used in PLM systems such as Siemens Teamcenter and ENOVIA for traceability across engineering programs.

attributes.name: sample_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name of the test sample, typically reflecting the component, assembly, or system under evaluation (e.g., 'Front Suspension Knuckle – Prototype A').

attributes.name: sample_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the test sample, tracking its progression from initial request through preparation, active testing, hold, completion, and final disposition or archival. attributes.name: serial_number

attributes.name: storage_condition
attributes.description: Required environmental storage condition for the sample to maintain its integrity prior to testing. Ensures samples are not degraded by improper storage. attributes.name: unit_cost

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.name: weight_kg

attributes.name: digital_twin_id

attributes.name: engineering_team_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.engineering_team. Business justification: Test benches are owned and operated by specific engineering teams. The existing owning_department text field is a denormalized reference to the engineering team. Adding engineering_team_id FK normaliz

attributes.name: adas_validation_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the test bench is configured to support Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) validation, including sensor fusion, camera, radar, and LiDAR signal injection.

attributes.name: annual_capacity_hours
attributes.description: Total planned available hours per year for the test bench after accounting for scheduled maintenance, calibration, and planned downtime. Used for capacity planning and program scheduling.

attributes.name: asset_tag
attributes.description: Internal fixed-asset tag or barcode label affixed to the test bench for asset register tracking and physical inventory audits.

attributes.name: automation_level
attributes.description: Degree of automation of the test bench: manual (operator-driven), semi-automated (partial automation with operator oversight), or fully automated (unattended 24/7 operation). Impacts scheduling efficiency and staffing requirements.

attributes.name: bay_number
attributes.description: Specific bay or cell number within the building where the test bench is installed. Used for precise physical location tracking and scheduling.

attributes.name: bench_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the test bench within the engineering facility. Used in PLM systems (Siemens Teamcenter, ENOVIA) and test management systems to reference the physical or virtual bench.

attributes.name: bench_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name of the test bench (e.g., 'NVH Chassis Dyno Bay 3', 'Powertrain HIL Bench 12'). Used in engineering reports and scheduling systems.

attributes.name: bench_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the test bench indicating whether it is available for scheduling, actively in use, undergoing maintenance or calibration, reserved for a specific program, or decommissioned.

attributes.name: bench_type
attributes.description: Classification of the test bench by its primary testing capability. Examples include engine dynamometer, chassis dynamometer, Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL), Software-in-the-Loop (SIL), NVH, EMI/EMC, climatic chamber, fatigue rig, crash sled, or endurance bench. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: engine_dyno|chassis_dyno|hil|sil|mil|nvh|emi_emc|climatic|fatigue|crash|endurance|calibration|other — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: building_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific building or laboratory block within the facility where the test bench is physically located. Supports asset management and maintenance routing.

attributes.name: calibration_certificate_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the most recent calibration certificate issued for the test bench. Provides traceability to the accredited calibration body and measurement standards.

attributes.name: calibration_interval_days
attributes.description: Defined interval in calendar days between mandatory calibrations of the test bench, as specified by the calibration plan or manufacturer recommendation.

attributes.name: channel_count
attributes.description: Total number of measurement channels (sensor inputs) available on the test bench data acquisition system. Determines the number of simultaneous parameters that can be monitored during a test run.

attributes.name: commissioning_date
attributes.description: Date on which the test bench was formally commissioned and accepted into service following installation qualification (IQ) and operational qualification (OQ). Marks the start of the asset lifecycle.

attributes.name: control_system_type
attributes.description: Type or brand of the automation and control system used to operate the test bench (e.g., AVL PUMA Open, Horiba STARS, National Instruments VeriStand, dSPACE ControlDesk). Used for software compatibility and integration planning.

attributes.name: coolant_flow_rate_lpm
attributes.description: Required coolant water flow rate in litres per minute for the test bench cooling system. Used for facility water usage tracking and ESG sustainability reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the test bench master record was first created in the data platform. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and governance purposes.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to the hourly rate and cost fields for this test bench (e.g., EUR, USD, GBP).

attributes.name: data_acquisition_system
attributes.description: Name or type of the data acquisition system (DAS) integrated with the test bench for capturing measurement signals (e.g., HBK QuantumX, National Instruments cDAQ, AVL IndiCom). Relevant for data lineage and IoT sensor data flows.

attributes.name: decommissioning_date
attributes.description: Date on which the test bench was formally decommissioned and removed from active service. Null if the bench is still in service.

attributes.name: emissions_measurement_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the test bench is equipped with a certified exhaust emissions measurement system (e.g., CVS dilution tunnel, FTIR analyser) for regulatory homologation testing.

attributes.name: facility_location
attributes.description: Physical location or site where the test bench is installed (e.g., plant name, building, bay number). Used for resource scheduling and logistics planning.

attributes.name: hil_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the test bench supports Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) simulation, enabling ECU and embedded software validation against real-time vehicle models without a physical vehicle.

attributes.name: hourly_rate
attributes.description: Internal charge-back rate per hour for use of the test bench, used for program cost allocation and engineering budget tracking. Expressed in the local facility currency.

attributes.name: iso_accreditation_number
attributes.description: Accreditation number issued by the national accreditation body (e.g., DAkkS, UKAS, A2LA) confirming the test bench meets ISO 17025 requirements for measurement traceability. Required for regulatory homologation test results.

attributes.name: last_calibration_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent calibration performed on the test bench. Critical for ensuring measurement traceability and compliance with ISO 17025 accreditation requirements.

attributes.name: last_maintenance_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent preventive or corrective maintenance activity performed on the test bench. Used to track maintenance history and schedule future work orders.

attributes.name: maintenance_interval_days
attributes.description: Defined interval in calendar days between scheduled preventive maintenance activities, as specified in the maintenance plan for this test bench.

attributes.name: manufacturer
attributes.description: Name of the original equipment manufacturer (OEM) of the test bench hardware (e.g., AVL, Horiba, FEV, MTS Systems). Used for maintenance contracts and spare parts sourcing.

attributes.name: max_power_kw
attributes.description: Maximum power absorption or generation capacity of the test bench in kilowatts. Determines which powertrain configurations and test profiles can be executed on this bench.

attributes.name: max_speed_rpm
attributes.description: Maximum rotational speed in revolutions per minute (RPM) that the test bench can accommodate. Constrains the test profiles and engine/motor configurations that can be tested.

attributes.name: max_torque_nm
attributes.description: Maximum torque capacity of the test bench in Newton-metres. Used to validate compatibility with the powertrain or drivetrain under test.

attributes.name: model_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer's model or part number for the test bench hardware. Used for maintenance, calibration, and procurement of compatible components.

attributes.name: network_segment
attributes.description: IT/OT network segment or VLAN to which the test bench data acquisition and control systems are connected. Used for cybersecurity zoning and IoT edge computing data flow management.

attributes.name: next_calibration_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date by which the next calibration must be completed to maintain measurement traceability and regulatory compliance. Drives preventive maintenance scheduling.

attributes.name: next_maintenance_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next planned preventive maintenance activity on the test bench. Supports maintenance planning and minimizes unplanned downtime.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, known limitations, special configurations, or engineering remarks about the test bench that do not fit structured fields.

attributes.name: plm_asset_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the test bench record in the PLM system (e.g., Siemens Teamcenter, ENOVIA, PTC Windchill). Enables traceability between the physical asset and its digital representation in the product lifecycle management system.

attributes.name: power_consumption_kw
attributes.description: Rated electrical power consumption of the test bench in kilowatts under typical operating conditions. Used for energy management, ESG CO2 tracking, and facility capacity planning.

attributes.name: responsible_engineer
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the lead engineer responsible for the test bench, its calibration, and its operational readiness. Used for accountability and escalation.

attributes.name: safety_classification
attributes.description: Automotive Safety Integrity Level (ASIL) classification of the test bench environment per ISO 26262, indicating the functional safety requirements applicable to tests conducted on this bench.

attributes.name: sampling_rate_hz
attributes.description: Maximum data acquisition sampling rate in Hertz (samples per second) supported by the test bench instrumentation. Determines the resolution of time-series test data captured.

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer-assigned serial number uniquely identifying the physical test bench unit. Used for warranty tracking, calibration records, and asset management.

attributes.name: supported_fuel_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of fuel or energy types the test bench is configured to support (e.g., gasoline, diesel, hydrogen, CNG, LPG, BEV/electric). Determines which powertrain programs can use this bench.

attributes.name: temperature_range_max_c
attributes.description: Maximum ambient or controlled temperature in degrees Celsius that the test bench environment can achieve. Used to validate thermal performance and high-temperature durability.

attributes.name: temperature_range_min_c
attributes.description: Minimum ambient or controlled temperature in degrees Celsius that the test bench environment can achieve. Relevant for climatic chambers and cold-start validation tests.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the test bench master record. Used for change tracking, data lineage, and synchronisation with source PLM systems.

attributes.name: utilization_target_pct
attributes.description: Target utilization rate of the test bench expressed as a percentage of available capacity. Used as a KPI benchmark for engineering resource management.

attributes.name: calibration_reference_test_bench_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on test_bench (calibration_reference_test_bench_id)

attributes.name: patent_family_id
attributes.description: Primary key for patent_family

attributes.name: vehicle_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.vehicle_program. Business justification: Patent families are associated with specific vehicle programs (the innovations they protect are developed within a program context). The existing vehicle_program_relevance text field is a denormalized

attributes.name: abstract_text
attributes.description: Official abstract text of the invention as published in the priority application, providing a concise summary of the technical problem solved and the solution claimed. Used for search and classification purposes.

attributes.name: annual_maintenance_cost
attributes.description: Total annualized cost of maintaining the patent family across all active jurisdictions, including renewal fees, annuities, and agent fees. Used for IP portfolio cost management and ROI analysis.

attributes.name: book_value
attributes.description: Capitalized intangible asset value of the patent family as recorded on the balance sheet, net of accumulated amortization. Relevant for IFRS 38 intangible asset reporting.

attributes.name: citation_count_backward
attributes.description: Number of prior art references cited by the patent family's applications (backward citations). Indicates the depth of prior art search and the novelty positioning of the invention.

attributes.name: citation_count_forward
attributes.description: Number of times patents in this family have been cited by subsequent patent applications (forward citations). A key indicator of the patent family's technological influence and value.

attributes.name: claim_count
attributes.description: Total number of claims in the lead application of the patent family, including independent and dependent claims. Claim count is an indicator of the breadth and depth of IP protection.

attributes.name: cn_application_number
attributes.description: Application number assigned by the China National Intellectual Property Administration (CNIPA) for the Chinese national phase or direct Chinese application within this family. China is a critical automotive market jurisdiction.

attributes.name: cpc_classification_code
attributes.description: Primary Cooperative Patent Classification code assigned by the USPTO or EPO, providing finer-grained technology categorization than IPC. Used for competitive landscape analysis and freedom-to-operate assessments.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the patent family record was first created in the engineering data lakehouse, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports data lineage and audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: cumulative_prosecution_cost
attributes.description: Total accumulated cost of prosecuting the patent family from initial filing through current status, including attorney fees, filing fees, translation costs, and examination fees across all jurisdictions.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts recorded on this patent family record (e.g., EUR, USD, JPY).

attributes.name: de_application_number
attributes.description: Application number assigned by the German Patent and Trade Mark Office (DPMA) for the German national application within this family. Germany is the primary automotive manufacturing jurisdiction in Europe.

attributes.name: earliest_filing_date
attributes.description: The actual calendar date on which the first application in the family was filed with a patent office. May coincide with or differ from the priority date when provisional applications are involved.

attributes.name: earliest_grant_date
attributes.description: Date on which the first granted patent within the family was issued by a patent office. Marks the start of enforceable IP rights for the family.

attributes.name: earliest_publication_date
attributes.description: Date on which the earliest member of the patent family was first published by a patent office, making the invention publicly disclosed. Relevant for prior-art and freedom-to-operate analyses.

attributes.name: ecn_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the Engineering Change Notice (ECN) or Engineering Change Order (ECO) that triggered or is associated with this patent family, linking IP protection to specific design changes.

attributes.name: ep_application_number
attributes.description: Application number assigned by the European Patent Office (EPO) for the European regional phase application within this family. Used for tracking EPO prosecution and validation in EPC member states.

attributes.name: expected_expiry_date
attributes.description: Projected date on which the last surviving granted patent in the family will expire, calculated as 20 years from the earliest filing date (utility) or 15 years from grant (design), subject to patent term extensions. Used for IP portfolio lifecycle planning.

attributes.name: external_counsel_firm
attributes.description: Name of the external law firm or patent attorney firm responsible for prosecuting and maintaining this patent family. Used for outside counsel management and cost allocation.

attributes.name: family_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier assigned to the patent family by the IP management system or patent office (e.g., INPADOC family number). Used for cross-referencing across jurisdictions.

attributes.name: family_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the patent family reflecting the overall prosecution and enforcement state across all member applications.

attributes.name: family_title
attributes.description: Official title of the invention as filed, representing the primary human-readable label for the patent family. Typically derived from the earliest priority application.

attributes.name: family_type
attributes.description: Classification of the patent family by the nature of the intellectual property protection sought. Utility covers functional inventions; design covers ornamental aspects; plant covers new plant varieties; utility_model covers petty patents in applicable jurisdictions; divisional covers child applications split from a parent.

attributes.name: frand_declared_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a FRAND licensing commitment has been formally declared to a standards body for this patent family. Triggers specific licensing obligations and royalty rate constraints.

attributes.name: freedom_to_operate_status
attributes.description: Result of the most recent Freedom-to-Operate (FTO) analysis for the technology covered by this patent family, indicating whether the company can commercialize the invention without infringing third-party rights.

attributes.name: fto_assessment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent Freedom-to-Operate assessment was completed. Used to determine whether the FTO analysis is current and requires refresh.

attributes.name: independent_claim_count
attributes.description: Number of independent claims in the lead application, each defining a distinct scope of protection. Independent claims are the primary measure of patent breadth.

attributes.name: internal_ip_counsel_name
attributes.description: Full name of the internal IP attorney or patent engineer responsible for managing this patent family. Used for workload management and accountability tracking.

attributes.name: invention_disclosure_number
attributes.description: Internal reference number of the Invention Disclosure Record (IDR) submitted by the inventor(s) to the IP department, linking the patent family back to the original R&D disclosure. Enables traceability from invention to granted patent.

attributes.name: inventor_count
attributes.description: Total number of named inventors across all applications in the patent family. Used for inventor recognition reporting and royalty distribution calculations.

attributes.name: ip_owner_legal_entity
attributes.description: Legal name of the corporate entity that holds title to the patent family (assignee of record). May differ from the operating business unit when IP is held by a holding company or subsidiary.

attributes.name: ipc_classification_code
attributes.description: Primary International Patent Classification code assigned to the invention, structured per WIPO IPC hierarchy (Section/Class/Subclass/Group/Subgroup). Enables cross-jurisdictional technology benchmarking and prior-art searches.

attributes.name: jp_application_number
attributes.description: Application number assigned by the Japan Patent Office (JPO) for the Japanese national phase or direct Japanese application within this family.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_count
attributes.description: Number of distinct national or regional jurisdictions in which patent protection has been sought or granted for this family. Indicates the geographic breadth of IP coverage.

attributes.name: lead_inventor_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary inventor listed on the patent family's priority application. Used for inventor recognition programs, royalty sharing, and legal correspondence.

attributes.name: licensing_revenue_ytd
attributes.description: Cumulative licensing revenue received for this patent family in the current fiscal year, expressed in the reporting currency. Used for IP monetization performance tracking.

attributes.name: licensing_status
attributes.description: Current licensing disposition of the patent family, indicating whether the IP is being actively licensed to third parties, subject to cross-licensing arrangements, or available for licensing.

attributes.name: litigation_case_reference
attributes.description: Internal or court-assigned case reference number for active litigation involving this patent family. Populated only when litigation_flag is TRUE. Used for legal matter management and e-discovery.

attributes.name: litigation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patent family is currently involved in active litigation, including infringement suits, inter partes review (IPR), opposition proceedings, or invalidity challenges.

attributes.name: owning_business_unit
attributes.description: Name of the internal business unit or R&D division that owns the patent family and is responsible for its prosecution costs and commercialization strategy (e.g., Powertrain Engineering, ADAS Systems, Vehicle Safety).

attributes.name: patent_portfolio_category
attributes.description: Strategic classification of the patent family within the company's IP portfolio. Core patents protect key product differentiators; standard_essential patents (SEPs) are essential to industry standards (e.g., V2X, LTE-V); defensive patents deter litigation; blocking patents prevent competitor entry; licensing and cross_license patents are managed for revenue or reciprocal access.

attributes.name: pct_application_number
attributes.description: Application number assigned under the WIPO Patent Cooperation Treaty (PCT) international phase, if the family includes a PCT filing. Enables tracking of the international phase prosecution and national phase entries.

attributes.name: plm_document_code
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking this patent family to the corresponding technical disclosure or design document in the PLM system (e.g., Siemens Teamcenter, ENOVIA, PTC Windchill). Enables traceability between IP assets and engineering design artifacts.

attributes.name: priority_application_number
attributes.description: Application number of the earliest priority filing (the root application) from which the family's priority date is derived. Establishes the legal priority date under the Paris Convention.

attributes.name: priority_date
attributes.description: The earliest filing date claimed by the patent family, establishing the legal priority date under the Paris Convention. Critical for determining novelty and inventive step against prior art.

attributes.name: product_relevance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patent family is currently embodied in or relevant to a production vehicle or component. Distinguishes patents protecting current products from purely defensive or future-oriented filings.

attributes.name: prosecution_status
attributes.description: Detailed current stage in the patent prosecution workflow for the lead application in the family. Tracks progress through examination, allowance, grant, and post-grant proceedings.

attributes.name: standard_essential_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patent family has been declared as potentially essential to an industry standard (e.g., ISO 26262, SAE J3016, 3GPP V2X, IEEE 802.11p). SEPs carry FRAND licensing obligations.

attributes.name: strategic_importance_rating
attributes.description: Internal rating of the patent family's strategic importance to the company's product roadmap and competitive position. Used to prioritize prosecution investment and maintenance decisions.

attributes.name: technology_domain
attributes.description: High-level technology area to which the invention belongs (e.g., powertrain, ADAS, battery management, chassis, infotainment, connectivity). Used for portfolio analytics and R&D investment reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: powertrain|adas|battery_management|chassis|infotainment|connectivity|body_electronics|safety_systems|manufacturing_process|software — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the patent family record in the engineering data lakehouse. Used for change tracking, incremental data loads, and audit compliance.

attributes.name: us_application_number
attributes.description: Application number assigned by the United States Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO) for the US national phase or direct US application within this family.

attributes.name: continuation_patent_family_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on patent_family (continuation_patent_family_id)

domains.name: quality
domains.description: End-to-end quality assurance and control across design, manufacturing, and field operations. Owns APQP plans, FMEA (Failure Mode and Effects Analysis), SPC (Statistical Process Control) data, inspection plans, quality audits, defect tracking, and PPM rates. Includes incoming material inspection, in-process quality gates, final vehicle PDI (Pre-Delivery Inspection), NCAP/WLTP test results, and corrective action (8D, 5-Why) processes. Supports IATF 16949 compliance.

domains.name: logistics
domains.description: Outbound logistics and distribution including finished vehicle transportation, vehicle storage yards, compound operations, carrier management, and delivery scheduling. Manages vehicle shipment from plant to dealer, rail/truck/vessel logistics, port processing, last-mile delivery, and CKD/SKD kit logistics. Tracks in-transit inventory, delivery lead times, transportation costs, carrier performance, and OTD metrics. Includes export/import operations for global distribution.

products.name: shipment
products.description: Core master record for each outbound vehicle shipment from plant to dealer or distribution point. Captures shipment origin (plant/compound), destination (dealer/port/yard), transport mode (rail, truck, vessel, CKD/SKD), shipment status, planned and actual departure/arrival dates, OTD tracking, and associated VINs. Primary operational entity for finished vehicle logistics. Sourced from SAP SD outbound delivery and MES traceability.

domains.name: inventory
domains.description: Inventory management for raw materials, components, WIP (Work in Progress), finished goods, and service parts across plants, warehouses, and dealer networks. Captures: golden_party_id (surviving record), duplicate_party_id (merged/suppressed record), source_system_a, source_system_b, match_rule_set_version, match_confidence_score (0-1), match_method (deterministic/probabilistic/manual), matched_attributes (JSON list of attributes used), resolution_action (merge/link/suppress/review), resolution_date, resolved_by (user or system), review_status (auto-approved/pending_review/rejected), and rejection_reason. Supports MDM governance, SSOT maintenance, and regulatory right-to-erasure compliance.
products.reference: Salesforce Data Cloud Identity Resolution / MDM best practice

attributes.description: Technique used to determine the match: deterministic, probabilistic, or manual review.

attributes.name: matched_attributes

products.name: fi_application
products.description: Master reference table for fi_application. Referenced by fi_application_id.

attributes.name: fi_application_id
attributes.description: Primary key for fi_application

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.channel. Business justification: F&I applications are submitted through specific sales channels (dealer, online, direct). The current model stores channel as a STRING field. Adding channel_id normalizes this reference to the channel

attributes.name: co_applicant_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the secondary applicant (co-borrower or co-lessee) on the F&I application, if applicable. Nullable when no co-applicant is present.

attributes.name: dealership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealership that originated and submitted the F&I application on behalf of the customer.

attributes.name: finance_product_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific finance product (rate plan, lease program, or loan product) offered by the lender and selected for this application.

attributes.name: lender_id
attributes.description: Reference to the financial institution, captive finance company (e.g., OEM captive), or bank that is providing the financing for this application.

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary applicant (customer) who is the principal borrower or lessee on the F&I application.

attributes.name: quote_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.quote. Business justification: F&I applications are initiated based on a vehicle quote, using the quoted vehicle price, configured options, and financing terms as inputs. Adding quote_id to fi_application links the credit applicati

attributes.name: sales_incentive_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.sales_incentive_program. Business justification: F&I applications for subvented financing are tied to OEM incentive programs that offer below-market interest rates. Adding sales_incentive_program_id to fi_application links the credit application to

attributes.name: sales_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vehicle sales order associated with this F&I application, linking the financing request to the specific vehicle purchase transaction.

attributes.name: vin_registry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific vehicle (identified by VIN) being financed under this F&I application.

attributes.name: adverse_action_notice_sent
attributes.description: Indicates whether a mandatory adverse action notice has been sent to the applicant following a credit decline or counter-offer, as required by ECOA and FCRA regulations.

attributes.name: annual_income
attributes.description: Self-declared or verified gross annual income of the primary applicant in the application currency, used as a key input for debt-to-income ratio calculation and credit decisioning.

attributes.name: annual_mileage_allowance
attributes.description: Contracted annual mileage allowance (in kilometres or miles) for lease applications. Excess mileage charges apply if the customer exceeds this limit at lease end.

attributes.name: applicant_date_of_birth
attributes.description: Date of birth of the primary applicant, used for identity verification and credit eligibility assessment. Subject to GDPR/CCPA data protection requirements.

attributes.name: applicant_email
attributes.description: Primary email address of the applicant used for application status notifications and document delivery. Subject to GDPR/CCPA data protection requirements.

attributes.name: applicant_first_name
attributes.description: Legal first (given) name of the primary applicant as provided on the F&I application. Subject to GDPR/CCPA data protection requirements.

attributes.name: applicant_last_name
attributes.description: Legal last (family) name of the primary applicant as provided on the F&I application. Subject to GDPR/CCPA data protection requirements.

attributes.name: applicant_national_id_number
attributes.description: Government-issued national identification number (e.g., Social Security Number in the US, National Insurance Number in the UK) of the primary applicant, used for credit bureau inquiry and identity verification. Must be masked in non-production environments.

attributes.name: applicant_phone
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number of the applicant for application follow-up and verification purposes. Subject to GDPR/CCPA data protection requirements.

attributes.name: application_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable reference number assigned to the F&I application at origination, used across dealer management systems (DMS), lender portals, and customer communications.

attributes.name: application_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the F&I application, tracking progression from initial submission through credit decisioning to funding. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|under_review|approved|conditionally_approved|declined|cancelled|funded — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: application_type
attributes.description: Classification of the financing structure being applied for: retail installment sale, operating lease, balloon payment plan, fleet financing, or commercial loan. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: retail_finance|lease|balloon|fleet_finance|commercial_loan|hire_purchase — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: approved_amount
attributes.description: Actual financing amount approved by the lender, which may differ from the requested amount based on credit assessment and lender policy.

attributes.name: buy_rate
attributes.description: The base interest rate at which the lender offers financing to the dealer (wholesale rate), before the dealer marks it up to the customer sell rate. Confidential commercial data.

attributes.name: conditions_text
attributes.description: Free-text description of conditions that must be satisfied for a conditionally approved application to proceed to funding (e.g., proof of income, additional down payment, co-signer requirement).

attributes.name: contract_signed_date
attributes.description: Date on which the customer signed the finance or lease contract, marking the legal commencement of the financing agreement.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the F&I application record was first created in the system, used for audit trail and data lineage purposes.

attributes.name: credit_bureau_source
attributes.description: Name of the credit reporting agency from which the credit score and credit report were obtained for this application.

attributes.name: credit_score
attributes.description: Credit bureau score (e.g., FICO score or equivalent) of the primary applicant at the time of application, used as the primary quantitative input for credit decisioning and interest rate determination.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this F&I application (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: dealer_reserve_amount
attributes.description: Dealer participation or reserve income earned by the dealership from the lender for placing the finance contract, calculated as the spread between the buy rate and the sell rate. Confidential commercial data.

attributes.name: decision_code
attributes.description: Lender-assigned decision code indicating the specific reason for approval, conditional approval, or decline of the application (e.g., A01 for standard approval, D03 for insufficient income). Codes vary by lender.

attributes.name: decision_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the lender or captive finance company issued the credit decision (approval, conditional approval, or decline) on the application.

attributes.name: decline_reason
attributes.description: Standardized reason description for application decline as required by ECOA adverse action notice regulations (e.g., insufficient income, poor credit history, excessive obligations). Populated only when application_status is declined.

attributes.name: down_payment_amount
attributes.description: Cash down payment amount provided by the customer at the point of sale, reducing the financed principal. Includes trade-in equity where applicable.

attributes.name: employer_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary applicant's current employer, used for income verification and credit assessment purposes.

attributes.name: employment_status
attributes.description: Current employment status of the primary applicant as declared on the F&I application, used in credit risk assessment.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the credit approval or application offer expires if not funded, after which a new application or re-pull of credit may be required.

attributes.name: fi_product_premium
attributes.description: Total premium or cost of ancillary F&I products (GAP, extended warranty, etc.) included in the financed amount, contributing to the total amount financed.

attributes.name: fi_product_type
attributes.description: Type of ancillary Finance and Insurance (F&I) product included in the application (e.g., GAP insurance, extended warranty, paint protection film). Multiple F&I products may be associated via a separate line table. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: gap_insurance|extended_warranty|paint_protection|tyre_insurance|credit_life|service_plan — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: funding_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the approved F&I application was funded by the lender, marking the point at which the financial contract is activated and proceeds are disbursed to the dealer.

attributes.name: interest_rate
attributes.description: Annual interest rate (APR) applied to the financed amount as approved by the lender. Expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 0.0499 for 4.99%). Used for monthly payment calculation and regulatory disclosure.

attributes.name: market_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the market in which the F&I application was originated, used for regulatory compliance routing and reporting (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU).

attributes.name: monthly_payment_amount
attributes.description: Calculated monthly installment or lease payment amount due from the customer, inclusive of principal, interest, and any applicable fees as disclosed under TILA/CCD.

attributes.name: regulatory_disclosure_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether all mandatory regulatory disclosures (e.g., TILA Truth-in-Lending disclosure, EU Consumer Credit Directive pre-contractual information) have been provided to the applicant prior to contract signing.

attributes.name: requested_amount
attributes.description: Total amount of financing requested by the applicant, representing the principal loan or lease amount before lender adjustments.

attributes.name: residual_value
attributes.description: Estimated residual (balloon) value of the vehicle at the end of the lease or balloon finance term, used to calculate monthly payments and end-of-term purchase option pricing.

attributes.name: source_system_reference
attributes.description: Application reference number or identifier from the originating source system (DMS, lender portal, or Salesforce Automotive Cloud), used for cross-system reconciliation and audit trail.

attributes.name: submission_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the F&I application was formally submitted by the dealer or customer for credit review, representing the principal business event timestamp.

attributes.name: term_months
attributes.description: Duration of the financing agreement in months (e.g., 24, 36, 48, 60, 72, 84), representing the repayment or lease period.

attributes.name: trade_in_value
attributes.description: Agreed appraised value of the customer's trade-in vehicle applied as equity toward the new vehicle purchase, reducing the financed amount.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the F&I application record was most recently modified, supporting audit trail and change tracking requirements.

attributes.name: vehicle_selling_price
attributes.description: Agreed final selling price of the vehicle being financed, as negotiated between the dealer and customer. May differ from MSRP due to dealer discounts or incentives.

attributes.name: superseded_fi_application_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on fi_application (superseded_fi_application_id)

products.name: lender
products.description: Master reference table for lender. Referenced by lender_id.

attributes.name: lender_id
attributes.description: Primary key for lender

attributes.name: api_endpoint_url
attributes.description: Base URL of the lender's credit decisioning or financing application API, used for real-time credit application submission and rate quote retrieval from dealer systems.

attributes.name: approval_turnaround_hours
attributes.description: Average or contractual credit decision turnaround time in hours from application submission to approval/decline. Used for dealer SLA management and lender performance benchmarking.

attributes.name: base_rate_type
attributes.description: Type of base interest rate structure used by the lender. Fixed rates are locked at origination; variable rates float with a benchmark index (SOFR, Prime). Impacts F&I deal structuring and incentive subvention calculations.

attributes.name: captive_oem_code
attributes.description: OEM brand code identifying the automotive manufacturer that owns or exclusively partners with this captive finance company (e.g., 'FORD' for Ford Motor Credit, 'BMW' for BMW Financial Services). Null for third-party lenders.

attributes.name: commercial_fleet_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lender supports commercial fleet financing programs for corporate, government, or rental fleet customers. Fleet lenders typically offer volume-based rate structures.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the lender's primary country of incorporation and operations (e.g., USA, DEU, GBR, JPN). Drives market-specific financing program eligibility.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the lender master record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.

attributes.name: credit_tier_supported
attributes.description: Credit quality tier(s) that the lender is approved to finance. Prime lenders target high-credit-score buyers; subprime lenders specialize in challenged credit. Drives dealer routing logic for financing applications.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the lender's primary operating currency (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, JPY). Used to denominate financing rates, fees, and incentive program amounts.

attributes.name: data_sharing_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lender has provided consent for data sharing with the OEM for analytics, incentive reconciliation, and portfolio performance reporting under the data sharing agreement.

attributes.name: dealer_portal_url
attributes.description: URL of the lender's dealer-facing portal for submitting financing applications, accessing rate sheets, and managing floorplan accounts. Integrated with DMS and Salesforce Automotive Cloud.

attributes.name: dealer_reserve_cap_pct
attributes.description: Maximum dealer reserve markup (in percentage points above buy rate) that the lender permits dealers to add to the customer's contract rate. Regulated by CFPB fair lending guidelines to prevent discriminatory pricing.

attributes.name: ev_financing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lender has specific EV financing programs, including battery residual value guarantees, federal tax credit assignment (IRA Section 30D), and EV-specific underwriting criteria.

attributes.name: floorplan_financing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lender offers wholesale floorplan financing to dealers for vehicle inventory. Floorplan lenders advance funds to dealers to purchase inventory from the OEM.

attributes.name: funding_turnaround_hours
attributes.description: Average or contractual time in hours from contract submission to dealer funding (disbursement of loan proceeds to the dealer). Critical for dealer cash flow management.

attributes.name: headquarters_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the lender's registered headquarters street address, used for legal correspondence and regulatory filings.

attributes.name: headquarters_city
attributes.description: City of the lender's registered headquarters, used for geographic segmentation of lender coverage and regulatory jurisdiction determination.

attributes.name: headquarters_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the lender's registered headquarters location. May differ from country_code if the lender operates across multiple markets.

attributes.name: headquarters_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the lender's registered headquarters address.

attributes.name: headquarters_state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or region of the lender's registered headquarters. Determines applicable state-level lending regulations (e.g., usury laws, dealer reserve caps).

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent compliance and performance review of the lender relationship, including fair lending audit, CFPB compliance check, and program performance assessment.

attributes.name: lease_financing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lender offers vehicle lease financing products (closed-end or open-end leases). Lease-capable lenders support residual value programs and money factor pricing.

attributes.name: lender_category
attributes.description: Business category of financing products offered by the lender. Retail lenders support consumer vehicle purchase loans; wholesale lenders support dealer floorplan financing; fleet lenders support commercial fleet accounts.

attributes.name: lender_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for the lender, used in SAP SD financing interfaces, dealer management systems (DMS), and captive finance platform integrations.

attributes.name: lender_name
attributes.description: Full legal registered name of the lending institution or captive finance company (e.g., Ford Motor Credit Company, Toyota Financial Services, Volkswagen Financial Services AG).

attributes.name: lender_short_name
attributes.description: Abbreviated or trade name of the lender used in dealer portals, sales reporting dashboards, and Salesforce Automotive Cloud opportunity records.

attributes.name: lender_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the lender relationship. Active lenders are eligible to receive financing applications from dealers. Suspended lenders are temporarily blocked pending compliance review.

attributes.name: lender_type
attributes.description: Classification of the lender by institutional type. Captive lenders are OEM-owned finance arms (e.g., GMAC, BMW Financial Services); banks and credit unions are third-party. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: captive|bank|credit_union|independent_finance|leasing_company|government — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: max_loan_amount
attributes.description: Maximum vehicle financing loan amount (in lender's primary currency) that the lender will approve per transaction. Caps deal size for risk management purposes.

attributes.name: max_loan_to_value_pct
attributes.description: Maximum loan-to-value ratio (expressed as a percentage) the lender will finance relative to the vehicle's MSRP or appraised value. A value of 110.00 means the lender will finance up to 110% of vehicle value (including negative equity).

attributes.name: max_term_months
attributes.description: Maximum financing term in months that the lender offers for vehicle purchase loans (e.g., 84 months). Longer terms reduce monthly payments but increase total interest cost.

attributes.name: max_vehicle_age_years
attributes.description: Maximum age of the vehicle (in years from model year) that the lender will finance. Older vehicles typically carry higher default risk and are excluded by prime lenders.

attributes.name: max_vehicle_mileage
attributes.description: Maximum odometer reading (in miles or kilometers per lender's market standard) of a used vehicle that the lender will finance. High-mileage vehicles are excluded from many prime lending programs.

attributes.name: min_loan_amount
attributes.description: Minimum vehicle financing loan amount (in lender's primary currency) that the lender will approve. Used to filter lender eligibility during deal structuring in the F&I (Finance and Insurance) office.

attributes.name: min_term_months
attributes.description: Minimum financing term in months that the lender offers for vehicle purchase loans (e.g., 12 months). Used to filter lender eligibility for short-term financing requests.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the next scheduled compliance and performance review of the lender is due. Drives compliance calendar and audit scheduling workflows.

attributes.name: onboarding_date
attributes.description: Date on which the lender was formally onboarded and activated in the OEM's financing ecosystem, including DMS integration, portal access provisioning, and compliance verification completion.

attributes.name: parent_lender_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier for the parent lender entity, enabling hierarchical lender group structures (e.g., a regional subsidiary referencing its national parent captive finance company).

attributes.name: preferred_lender_rank
attributes.description: Numeric ranking (1 = highest preference) indicating the OEM's or dealer group's preferred routing order for financing applications. Lower rank lenders receive first-look submission priority in the dealer's F&I workflow.

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Business email address of the primary lender relationship contact for program communications, rate sheet distribution, and incentive claim correspondence.

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary relationship manager or account executive at the lender responsible for OEM/dealer program coordination.

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Direct phone number of the primary lender relationship contact, used for escalation and program negotiation.

attributes.name: program_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the lender's financing program agreement expires or is scheduled to terminate. Null for open-ended agreements. Triggers renewal workflow in Salesforce Automotive Cloud.

attributes.name: program_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the lender's financing program agreement with the OEM or dealer group became effective. Determines eligibility window for incentive subvention and preferred lender programs.

attributes.name: registration_number
attributes.description: Official government-issued legal entity registration or charter number for the lending institution (e.g., NMLS ID in the USA, BaFin registration in Germany). Required for regulatory compliance verification.

attributes.name: routing_number
attributes.description: American Bankers Association (ABA) routing transit number for the lender's primary settlement bank account, used for ACH disbursements of dealer incentive payments and floorplan advances.

attributes.name: subvention_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lender participates in OEM-sponsored rate subvention programs (e.g., 0% APR for 60 months). Subvention programs require the OEM to buy down the customer's interest rate by paying the lender a subsidy.

attributes.name: supported_vehicle_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or description of vehicle types the lender finances (e.g., new, certified_pre_owned, used, commercial, electric_vehicle). Determines lender eligibility routing in F&I deal structuring. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: new|certified_pre_owned|used|commercial|electric_vehicle|motorcycle — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: swift_bic_code
attributes.description: SWIFT/BIC code uniquely identifying the lender's financial institution for international wire transfers and cross-border automotive financing settlements.

attributes.name: tax_id
attributes.description: Federal or national tax identification number of the lender (e.g., EIN in the USA, VAT registration number in the EU). Used for 1099 reporting, withholding tax, and cross-border financing compliance.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the lender master record, in ISO 8601 format. Used for change data capture (CDC) and incremental Lakehouse Silver layer processing.

attributes.name: website_url
attributes.description: Official public website URL of the lender, used for dealer portal links, consumer financing application redirects, and program documentation access.

products.name: finance_product
products.description: Master reference table for finance_product. Referenced by finance_product_id.

attributes.name: finance_product_id
attributes.description: Primary key for finance_product

attributes.name: annual_mileage_allowance
attributes.description: Standard contracted annual mileage allowance included in the base product terms for lease and PCP products. Excess mileage is charged at the excess_mileage_rate.

attributes.name: apr
attributes.description: The Annual Percentage Rate (APR) for this finance product, expressed as a decimal. Mandatory regulatory disclosure metric representing the true cost of credit including fees. Required under Consumer Credit Directive.

attributes.name: arrangement_fee
attributes.description: Fixed fee charged to the customer at the inception of the finance agreement. Included in APR calculations and disclosed in pre-contractual information.

attributes.name: balloon_payment_pct
attributes.description: The guaranteed future value (GFV) or balloon payment expressed as a percentage of the vehicle's on-the-road price. Applicable to PCP (Personal Contract Purchase) and balloon finance products. Null for standard loans.

attributes.name: benchmark_rate_index
attributes.description: Reference rate index to which a variable rate product is linked (e.g., SOFR, EURIBOR, Bank of England Base Rate). Null for fixed-rate products.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this finance product record was first created in the data lakehouse. Used for audit trail and data governance purposes.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the finance product is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Determines the currency of all monetary terms associated with this product.

attributes.name: dealer_commission_rate
attributes.description: The commission rate payable to the dealer for introducing this finance product, expressed as a decimal. Subject to FCA discretionary commission arrangement (DCA) rules. Confidential commercial term.

attributes.name: discontinuation_date
attributes.description: The date on which this finance product was formally discontinued and removed from the active product catalog. Null for active products.

attributes.name: early_settlement_fee
attributes.description: Fee charged to the customer for settling the finance agreement before the contracted end date. Subject to statutory rebate rules under the Consumer Credit Act.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which this finance product is available for new originations. Used in product eligibility date-range checks during quote generation.

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: The date after which this finance product is no longer available for new originations. Null indicates the product is open-ended with no planned end date.

attributes.name: eligible_vehicle_age_max_years
attributes.description: Maximum age of the vehicle in years at the time of finance origination. Used to restrict certain products to new or nearly-new vehicles and to manage residual value risk.

attributes.name: excess_mileage_rate
attributes.description: Charge per unit of distance (mile or kilometre) for mileage exceeding the contracted annual mileage allowance. Applicable to lease and PCP products. Null for loan products.

attributes.name: external_product_id
attributes.description: The identifier for this finance product in the originating source system (e.g., SAP SD material number, Salesforce product ID). Used for cross-system reconciliation and data lineage.

attributes.name: fca_product_category
attributes.description: FCA-defined product category classification for regulated credit products (e.g., 'Hire Purchase', 'Conditional Sale', 'Personal Contract Purchase', 'Finance Lease'). Required for FCA regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: finance_channel
attributes.description: The distribution channel through which this finance product is offered. Determines eligibility rules, commission structures, and regulatory disclosure requirements.

attributes.name: is_ev_incentive_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this finance product is eligible for government or manufacturer EV purchase incentives (e.g., Plug-in Car Grant, IRA EV tax credit). Used in incentive program eligibility logic.

attributes.name: is_regulated
attributes.description: Indicates whether this finance product is a regulated credit agreement subject to consumer credit legislation and conduct of business rules. Drives mandatory disclosure and affordability assessment requirements.

attributes.name: late_payment_fee
attributes.description: Fee charged per late payment event under this finance product. Must be disclosed in the pre-contractual information and is subject to FCA fairness rules.

attributes.name: launch_date
attributes.description: The date on which this finance product was first made commercially available to dealers and customers. Used in product performance analytics and vintage analysis.

attributes.name: market_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the market in which this finance product is offered. Finance products are market-specific due to regulatory and tax differences.

attributes.name: max_dealer_rate_markup_bps
attributes.description: Maximum number of basis points by which a dealer is permitted to mark up the standard rate when quoting to a customer. Regulated under FCA DCA rules. Confidential commercial term.

attributes.name: max_deposit_pct
attributes.description: Maximum deposit percentage allowed under this finance product. Prevents over-capitalisation and ensures the product remains within its intended credit structure.

attributes.name: max_loan_amount
attributes.description: Maximum principal amount that can be financed under this product. Caps the exposure per agreement and is used in credit risk and underwriting rules.

attributes.name: max_term_months
attributes.description: Maximum contract duration in months for this finance product. Defines the upper bound for repayment schedules and residual value calculations.

attributes.name: mileage_unit
attributes.description: Unit of distance measurement used for mileage allowance and excess mileage charges. Varies by market (miles in UK/US, km in continental Europe).

attributes.name: min_deposit_pct
attributes.description: Minimum required deposit (down payment) as a percentage of the vehicle's on-the-road price, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.10 for 10%). Used in affordability and eligibility checks.

attributes.name: min_loan_amount
attributes.description: Minimum principal amount that can be financed under this product. Used in eligibility checks during quote generation and order capture in SAP SD and Salesforce.

attributes.name: min_term_months
attributes.description: Minimum contract duration in months for this finance product. Used in eligibility validation and product suitability assessments.

attributes.name: new_used_eligibility
attributes.description: Indicates whether this finance product is available for new vehicles, used/pre-owned vehicles, or both. Drives product filtering in dealer quoting systems.

attributes.name: nominal_interest_rate
attributes.description: The stated annual nominal interest rate (flat rate) for this finance product, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0699 for 6.99%). Used in payment schedule calculations.

attributes.name: payment_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which regular repayments are due under this finance product. Monthly is standard for retail automotive finance; quarterly or annual may apply to fleet or commercial products.

attributes.name: payment_in_advance_count
attributes.description: Number of rental payments collected in advance at the start of the agreement (e.g., 3 months in advance for a lease). Common in fleet and business lease products.

attributes.name: product_category
attributes.description: Business segment category for the finance product, distinguishing retail consumer finance from fleet, commercial, dealer stock, or wholesale financing arrangements.

attributes.name: product_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the finance product within the automotive finance product catalog. Used in SAP SD and Salesforce Automotive Cloud for product referencing.

attributes.name: product_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the finance product, including its key features, target customer segment, and commercial positioning. Used in dealer training materials and product documentation.

attributes.name: product_name
attributes.description: Human-readable commercial name of the finance product (e.g., 'Standard Auto Loan', 'Balloon Finance Plan', 'Lease with Maintenance'). Used in dealer-facing and customer-facing materials.

attributes.name: product_owner
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the business owner responsible for this finance product's commercial performance, pricing, and compliance. Used in governance and escalation workflows.

attributes.name: product_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the finance product. Controls whether the product is available for new originations, under review, or retired from the product catalog.

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: Classification of the finance product by its fundamental structure. Determines the financial mechanics, regulatory treatment, and accounting classification. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: loan|lease|balloon|hire_purchase|fleet_finance|subscription|pcp|pcm — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: rate_margin_bps
attributes.description: The margin in basis points added to the benchmark rate index for variable-rate products. For example, a margin of 150 bps over EURIBOR. Null for fixed-rate products.

attributes.name: rate_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the interest rate for this finance product is fixed for the full term, variable (linked to a benchmark rate), capped, or stepped over the contract period.

attributes.name: regulatory_framework
