attributes.description: The primary regulatory framework governing this finance product (e.g., 'Consumer Credit Act 1974', 'Consumer Credit Directive 2008/48/EC', 'Regulation Z / TILA'). Determines disclosure and conduct obligations.

attributes.name: residual_value_pct
attributes.description: Estimated residual value of the vehicle at the end of the finance term, expressed as a percentage of the original vehicle price. Used in lease and PCP product pricing and risk modelling.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this finance product definition originates (e.g., 'SAP_SD', 'SALESFORCE_AC', 'DEALER_FMS'). Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: subsidy_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the finance product is subsidised by the manufacturer (subvented rate), the dealer, or is unsubsidised. Subvented products are funded by the OEM to support vehicle sales incentives.

attributes.name: subvention_rate
attributes.description: The rate subsidy provided by the manufacturer or dealer to reduce the customer-facing APR below the standard market rate. Expressed as a decimal. Confidential commercial term.

attributes.name: target_vehicle_segment
attributes.description: The vehicle segment or nameplate category for which this finance product is designed (e.g., passenger car, SUV, commercial vehicle, EV). Used in product eligibility rules and marketing targeting.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this finance product record was last modified. Used for change tracking, incremental data loads, and audit compliance.

attributes.name: superseded_finance_product_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on finance_product (superseded_finance_product_id)

domains.name: dealer
domains.description: Dealer network management including dealer profiles, franchise agreements, territory assignments, and dealer performance scorecards. Manages dealer inventory allocation, vehicle allocation rules, dealer incentive programs, and DMS (Dealer Management System) integration. Tracks dealer sales performance, customer satisfaction scores, service capacity, and parts inventory at dealer locations. Supports both OEM-owned and independent franchise dealer models. Integrates with CDK Global DMS.

products.name: dealership
products.description: Master record for each dealer location in the OEM franchise network. Captures dealer legal entity, DMS (Dealer Management System) integration identifiers (CDK Global), franchise type (OEM-owned vs independent), physical address, contact details, operational status, market region, and channel classification. This is the SSOT for dealer identity across the enterprise.

attributes.name: dealership_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each dealer location in the OEM franchise network. Primary key for the dealership master record and the enterprise Single Source of Truth (SSOT) for dealer identity.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.billing_account. Business justification: Required for finance: each dealership must be linked to its primary billing account for invoice generation and payment reconciliation, a standard practice in automotive dealer finance operations.

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Financial consolidation reports require each dealership to be assigned to a legal company code for statutory reporting; dealers know their company code.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Expense allocation and internal budgeting are performed per dealership via a dedicated cost center; required for cost‑center expense statements.

attributes.name: payment_term_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.payment_term. Business justification: Required for billing: dealership default payment terms are needed for all invoices, enabling consistent net‑due days and discount calculations per dealer.

attributes.name: region_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to dealer.dealer_region. Business justification: Dealerships are assigned to a region; add dealer_region_id FK to link each dealership to its region.

attributes.name: activation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the dealership was formally activated in the OEM dealer network and became eligible to receive vehicle allocations and participate in OEM programs.

attributes.name: adas_certified
attributes.business_glossary_term: Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) Certified Dealer Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dealership is certified to perform Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) calibration and repair. Required for servicing vehicles equipped with cameras, radar, and LiDAR-based safety systems.

tag_set.value: Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) Certified Dealer Flag

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address of the dealership physical location. Used for logistics, customer navigation, regulatory filings, and Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI) vehicle delivery coordination.

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for the dealership (suite, unit, building number). Supplements address_line1 for precise location identification.

attributes.name: cdk_dealer_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: CDK Global Dealer Management System (DMS) Dealer ID
attributes.description: Unique dealer identifier assigned within the CDK Global Dealer Management System (DMS). This is the integration key used for all data exchanges between the OEM lakehouse and the CDK DMS platform including inventory, F&I, and service scheduling feeds.

tag_set.value: CDK Global Dealer Management System (DMS) Dealer ID

attributes.name: channel_classification
attributes.description: Categorizes the dealer's primary sales channel model. Retail covers traditional showroom sales; fleet covers B2B volume sales; agency model covers OEM-set pricing arrangements; export covers cross-border sales points.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City in which the dealership is physically located. Used for geographic market analysis, territory assignment, and customer proximity reporting.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the country in which the dealership is physically located (e.g., USA, CAN, MEX, GBR, DEU). Drives regulatory compliance, currency, and tax treatment.

attributes.name: deactivation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the dealership was deactivated or terminated from the OEM dealer network. Nullable for currently active dealers. Used for franchise termination tracking and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: dealer_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code assigned by the OEM to uniquely identify the dealer location across all enterprise systems including SAP SD, CDK Global DMS, and Salesforce Automotive Cloud. Used on all inter-system communications, vehicle allocations, and incentive programs.

attributes.name: dealer_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the dealership within the OEM franchise network. Controls eligibility for vehicle allocation, incentive programs, and DMS integration. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: active|inactive|suspended|pending_approval|terminated|under_review — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: dealer_tier
attributes.description: OEM-assigned performance tier classification for the dealership based on annual sales volume, customer satisfaction scores, and compliance metrics. Determines eligibility for premium vehicle allocations, co-op marketing funds, and incentive program tiers.

attributes.name: dms_go_live_date
attributes.description: Date on which the CDK Global DMS integration for this dealership went live and began transmitting data to the OEM enterprise systems. Used for integration tenure tracking and data completeness assessments.

attributes.name: dms_integration_status
attributes.description: Current status of the CDK Global DMS data integration feed for this dealership. Indicates whether real-time inventory, sales, and service data is flowing correctly into the OEM lakehouse.

attributes.name: ev_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dealership has completed OEM Electric Vehicle (EV) certification requirements including technician training, charging infrastructure installation, and EV-specific tooling. Required for allocation of BEV and PHEV models.

attributes.name: ev_charger_count
attributes.description: Number of EV charging stations installed at the dealership for customer and demo vehicle use. Relevant for EV certification compliance and customer experience reporting.

attributes.name: franchise_agreement_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the active franchise agreement between the OEM and the dealer entity. Used to link the dealership master record to the franchise agreement contract for legal and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: franchise_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current franchise agreement is scheduled to expire or must be renewed. Nullable for perpetual agreements. Triggers renewal workflow when within the notice period.

attributes.name: franchise_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current franchise agreement between the OEM and the dealer became effective. Used for tenure calculations, renewal scheduling, and performance baseline setting.

attributes.name: franchise_type
attributes.description: Classification of the dealer's franchise arrangement with the OEM. Distinguishes OEM-owned (captive) outlets from independent franchise dealers, authorized repairers, fleet-only points, used vehicle specialists, and satellite locations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: oem_owned|independent_franchise|authorized_repairer|fleet_only|used_vehicle_only|satellite — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: home_delivery_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Whether this dealership supports home delivery to customers.

attributes.name: last_mile_delivery_radius_km
attributes.description: Maximum delivery radius in km for home delivery from this dealership.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate (WGS 84 decimal degrees) of the dealership location. Enables spatial analytics, territory mapping, and customer proximity calculations for dealer locator services.

attributes.name: legal_name
attributes.description: Full registered legal name of the dealer entity as recorded with the relevant state or national business registry. Used for franchise agreements, regulatory filings, and financial settlements.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate (WGS 84 decimal degrees) of the dealership location. Enables spatial analytics, territory mapping, and customer proximity calculations for dealer locator services.

attributes.name: lot_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum number of vehicles that can be stored on the dealer lot (outdoor inventory storage). Used for vehicle allocation limits, inventory aging analysis, and logistics planning.

attributes.name: market_region_code
attributes.description: OEM-defined market region code to which this dealership belongs (e.g., NORTHEAST, MIDWEST, SOUTHWEST, WEST, SOUTHEAST). Used for territory management, regional incentive programs, and sales performance reporting.

attributes.name: new_vehicle_sales_capacity
attributes.description: OEM-assessed annual new vehicle sales capacity (unit count) for this dealership based on facility size, staffing, and market area. Used as the denominator for allocation planning and sales target setting.

attributes.name: oem_brand_codes
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of OEM brand codes (e.g., BRAND_A|BRAND_B) that this dealership is franchised to sell and service. A single dealer point may hold multi-brand authorizations (e.g., passenger car and commercial vehicle brands).

attributes.name: ownership_group_name
attributes.description: Name of the dealer group or automotive retail group that owns this dealership location (e.g., AutoNation, Penske, Lithia). Enables group-level performance aggregation, consolidated incentive calculations, and multi-point dealer management.

attributes.name: parts_warehouse_area_sqm
attributes.description: Total floor area in square metres of the dealership's parts storage facility. Used for parts inventory capacity planning, MRP replenishment calculations, and Just-in-Time (JIT) parts delivery scheduling.

attributes.name: pdi_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dealership is certified to perform Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI) on new vehicles prior to customer handover. PDI certification is required for new vehicle delivery authorization.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the dealership's physical location. Used for geographic market segmentation, territory boundary analysis, and customer catchment area reporting.

attributes.name: primary_email
attributes.description: Primary business email address for the dealership used for OEM communications, vehicle allocation notifications, incentive program updates, and Technical Service Bulletin (TSB) distribution.

attributes.name: primary_phone
attributes.description: Main switchboard or primary contact telephone number for the dealership. Used for OEM-to-dealer communications, customer service escalations, and directory listings.

attributes.name: principal_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary OEM relationship contact at the dealership. Used for franchise communications, incentive program notifications, and regulatory bulletin distribution.

attributes.name: principal_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary OEM relationship contact at the dealership (typically the Dealer Principal or General Manager). Used for OEM communications, franchise agreement correspondence, and escalation routing.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the dealership master record was first created in the enterprise data platform. Follows ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for data lineage, audit trail, and record age analysis.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the dealership master record in the enterprise data platform. Follows ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change detection, data freshness monitoring, and audit compliance.

attributes.name: sales_district_code
attributes.description: OEM-defined sales district code representing the sub-regional territory assignment for this dealership. Used for district sales manager (DSM) alignment, vehicle allocation quotas, and performance benchmarking.

attributes.name: sap_customer_number
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA customer master number (SD module) assigned to this dealership for vehicle order processing, invoicing, and financial settlement. Links dealership to SAP SD sales orders and FI accounts receivable.

attributes.name: service_bay_count
attributes.description: Total number of service bays available at the dealership for vehicle maintenance and repair operations. Used for after-sales capacity planning, warranty repair throughput analysis, and service scheduling optimization.

attributes.name: showroom_display_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum number of vehicles that can be displayed simultaneously in the dealership showroom. Used for vehicle allocation planning, demo fleet sizing, and facility investment decisions.

attributes.name: state_province_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-2 state or province code for the dealership's physical location (e.g., CA, TX, NY, ON). Used for CAFE compliance reporting, CARB emissions zone classification, and state-level dealer franchise law compliance.

attributes.name: trading_name
attributes.description: The public-facing 'doing business as' (DBA) name of the dealership as displayed to customers, on signage, and in marketing materials. May differ from the legal entity name.

attributes.name: used_vehicle_sales_capacity
attributes.description: OEM-assessed annual used vehicle sales capacity (unit count) for this dealership. Used for certified pre-owned (CPO) program eligibility and used vehicle allocation planning.

attributes.name: warranty_authorized
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dealership is authorized to perform OEM warranty repairs and submit warranty claims. Drives warranty claim processing eligibility in SAP and CDK DMS.

attributes.name: website_url
attributes.description: Public-facing website URL for the dealership. Used for digital marketing integration, online inventory syndication, and customer-facing dealer locator services.

attributes.name: yard_slot_capacity
attributes.description: Number of vehicle storage slots available at the dealership yard.

products.name: franchise_agreement
products.description: Formal franchise contract between the OEM and an independent or OEM-owned dealer. Tracks agreement effective dates, expiration, renewal terms, franchise tier, authorized vehicle lines (nameplates), territory rights, performance obligations, and agreement status. Supports both new franchise grants and renewals.

attributes.name: franchise_agreement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the franchise agreement record. Primary key.

attributes.name: franchise_dealer_dealership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealer entity that is party to this franchise agreement.

attributes.name: franchise_dealership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealer entity that is party to this franchise agreement.

attributes.name: agreement_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all financial terms in the franchise agreement (quotas, fees, investment requirements). Example: USD, EUR, JPY.

attributes.name: agreement_document_url
attributes.description: Secure URL or file path to the digitally stored franchise agreement contract document (PDF or scanned image).

attributes.name: agreement_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or title of the franchise agreement, typically including dealer name and location.

attributes.name: agreement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the franchise agreement. Format: FA-NNNNNNNN.

attributes.name: agreement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the franchise agreement: draft (being negotiated), pending approval (awaiting OEM sign-off), active (in force), suspended (temporarily inactive), terminated (ended before expiration), or expired (reached end date).

attributes.name: agreement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the franchise agreement based on its purpose: new franchise grant, renewal of existing agreement, amendment to terms, territory expansion, or termination agreement.

attributes.name: allocation_priority_tier
attributes.description: Priority tier for vehicle inventory allocation. Higher tiers receive preferential allocation of high-demand models and limited-production vehicles. Tier 1 = highest priority.

attributes.name: authorized_nameplates
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of vehicle nameplates (brands, model lines) that the dealer is authorized to sell under this franchise agreement. Examples: Sedan, SUV, Truck, EV (Electric Vehicle), HEV (Hybrid Electric Vehicle).

attributes.name: authorized_vehicle_lines
attributes.description: Specific vehicle lines or series the dealer is authorized to sell, such as luxury, commercial, electric, or performance segments.

attributes.name: auto_renewal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the franchise agreement automatically renews at expiration unless either party provides notice. True = auto-renews, False = requires explicit renewal.

attributes.name: certified_pre_owned_authorized_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dealer is authorized to sell OEM-certified pre-owned vehicles under the manufacturer's CPO program. True = authorized, False = not authorized.

attributes.name: commercial_fleet_authorized_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dealer is authorized to sell vehicles to commercial fleet customers and participate in fleet sales programs. True = authorized, False = not authorized.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this franchise agreement record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: customer_satisfaction_target_score
attributes.description: Minimum Net Promoter Score (NPS) or customer satisfaction score the dealer must achieve to maintain franchise agreement in good standing. Typically measured on a scale of 0-100.

attributes.name: dealer_signatory_name
attributes.description: Full name of the dealer authorized representative (typically dealer principal or owner) who signed the franchise agreement.

attributes.name: digital_retailing_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dealer must offer digital retailing capabilities (online sales, virtual showroom, e-commerce) as required by the franchise agreement. True = required, False = optional.

attributes.name: dms_integration_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Dealer Management System (DMS) Integration Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dealer must integrate their DMS (Dealer Management System) with OEM systems for real-time inventory, sales, and service data sharing. True = required, False = optional.

tag_set.value: Dealer Management System (DMS) Integration Required Flag

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the franchise agreement becomes legally binding and operational. Marks the start of the dealer's franchise rights and obligations.

attributes.name: ev_charging_infrastructure_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electric Vehicle (EV) Charging Infrastructure Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dealer must install and maintain EV (Electric Vehicle) charging infrastructure at their facility as a condition of selling electric or hybrid vehicles. True = required, False = optional.

tag_set.value: Electric Vehicle (EV) Charging Infrastructure Required Flag

attributes.name: exclusive_territory_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dealer has exclusive rights to sell in the assigned territory. True = exclusive (no other dealers in territory), False = non-exclusive (shared territory).

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the franchise agreement is scheduled to end. Nullable for open-ended or perpetual agreements subject to performance review.

attributes.name: facility_investment_requirement_amount
attributes.description: Minimum capital expenditure (CapEx) the dealer must invest in facility improvements, showroom standards, service equipment, and infrastructure to meet OEM brand standards.

attributes.name: franchise_tier
attributes.description: Tier or level of the franchise agreement indicating dealer status, privileges, and performance expectations. Higher tiers typically receive preferential allocation and incentives.

attributes.name: governing_law_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Legal jurisdiction and governing law that applies to the franchise agreement, typically the state or country where the dealer operates or where the OEM is headquartered.

attributes.name: home_delivery_obligation_flag
attributes.description: Whether the franchise agreement requires home delivery capability.

attributes.name: incentive_program_eligibility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dealer is eligible to participate in OEM dealer incentive programs, volume bonuses, and performance rewards. True = eligible, False = not eligible.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this franchise agreement record was last updated in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: minimum_sales_quota_annual
attributes.description: Minimum number of vehicle units the dealer must sell annually to maintain franchise agreement in good standing. Performance obligation defined in agreement.

attributes.name: minimum_service_capacity
attributes.description: Minimum number of vehicles the dealer must be capable of servicing per month to meet franchise agreement service obligations.

attributes.name: notice_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days advance notice required by either party to terminate or not renew the franchise agreement. Typical values are 30, 60, 90, or 180 days.

attributes.name: oem_signatory_name
attributes.description: Full name of the OEM authorized representative who signed the franchise agreement on behalf of the manufacturer.

attributes.name: ownership_model
attributes.description: Classification of dealer ownership structure: OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) owned, independent franchise, joint venture, or corporate store.

attributes.name: parts_inventory_requirement_amount
attributes.description: Minimum dollar value of OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) parts inventory the dealer must maintain at all times to meet franchise agreement obligations.

attributes.name: performance_review_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which the OEM conducts formal performance reviews of the dealer against franchise agreement obligations and performance metrics.

attributes.name: recall_service_authorized_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dealer is authorized to perform recall repairs and service campaigns issued by the OEM or NHTSA (National Highway Traffic Safety Administration). True = authorized, False = not authorized.

attributes.name: renewal_date
attributes.description: Date when the franchise agreement was last renewed or is scheduled for renewal review. Used for tracking renewal cycles.

attributes.name: renewal_term_months
attributes.description: Duration in months for each renewal period of the franchise agreement. Typical values are 12, 24, 36, or 60 months.

attributes.name: signed_date
attributes.description: Date when the franchise agreement was formally signed by both the dealer and OEM authorized representatives, making it legally binding.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the franchise agreement was terminated, if applicable. Populated only for agreements that ended before their scheduled expiration.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of why the franchise agreement was terminated early, including performance issues, dealer request, market consolidation, or regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: territory_description
attributes.description: Textual description of the geographic territory assigned to the dealer under this franchise agreement, including cities, counties, postal codes, or radius from dealer location.

attributes.name: territory_radius_km
attributes.description: Radius in kilometers from the dealer's primary location defining the franchise territory boundary, if territory is defined by radius rather than geographic boundaries.

attributes.name: training_certification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether dealer staff must complete OEM-mandated training and certification programs as a condition of the franchise agreement. True = required, False = optional.

attributes.name: warranty_administration_authorized_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dealer is authorized to process and submit warranty claims on behalf of customers under OEM warranty programs. True = authorized, False = not authorized.

products.name: dealer_territory
products.description: Geographic sales territory assigned to a dealership. Defines primary area of responsibility (PAR), zip/postal code coverage, county or region boundaries, territory type (exclusive, shared, open), effective dates, and overlap rules. Used for vehicle allocation, market representation planning, and dealer performance benchmarking.

attributes.name: dealer_territory_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the dealer territory assignment. Primary key.

attributes.name: franchise_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the franchise agreement that governs this territory assignment. Links territory rights to contractual terms.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.jurisdiction. Business justification: Territory planning aligns with the legal jurisdiction for emissions and safety regulations; linking enables jurisdiction‑specific reporting.

attributes.name: manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Territory manager assignment needed for territory performance reporting and incentive eligibility.

attributes.name: primary_dealer_dealership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealership that owns or is assigned this territory.

attributes.name: allocation_quota_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of regional or national vehicle allocation assigned to this territory. Sum of all territory percentages within a region should equal 100.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the territory assignment or modification was formally approved by OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) management.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) executive or manager who approved this territory assignment or modification.

attributes.name: city_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of cities or municipalities included in the territory coverage area.

attributes.name: competitive_intensity_rating
attributes.description: Assessment of competitive pressure within the territory based on number of competing brands, dealer density, and market saturation.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the territory location (e.g., USA, CAN, MEX).

attributes.name: county_region
attributes.description: County, district, or regional subdivision name within the state/province that defines part of the territory boundary.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this territory assignment record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage.

attributes.name: dms_integration_status
attributes.description: Status of territory data synchronization with the dealer's DMS (Dealer Management System), specifically CDK Global DMS. Indicates whether territory boundaries are reflected in dealer systems.

attributes.name: dms_last_sync_timestamp
attributes.business_glossary_term: Dealer Management System (DMS) Last Synchronization Timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the last successful synchronization of territory data with the dealer's DMS (Dealer Management System). Used to monitor data freshness and integration health.

tag_set.value: Dealer Management System (DMS) Last Synchronization Timestamp

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the territory assignment expires or is terminated. Null indicates an open-ended assignment.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the territory assignment becomes active and the dealer assumes responsibility for the defined area.

attributes.name: geographic_boundary_description
attributes.description: Textual description of territory boundaries using landmarks, highways, or natural features (e.g., 'North of I-40, East of Highway 101').

attributes.name: home_delivery_coverage_flag
attributes.description: Whether home delivery is available in this territory.

attributes.name: household_count_estimate
attributes.description: Estimated number of households within the territory. Used for market penetration analysis and vehicle allocation planning.

attributes.name: incentive_program_eligibility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether dealers in this territory are eligible for special OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) incentive programs or bonuses. True = eligible; False = not eligible.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this territory assignment record was last updated. Tracks the most recent change to any field in the record.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date when the territory assignment was last reviewed or audited by OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) management. Used to track compliance with periodic review requirements.

attributes.name: manager_email
attributes.description: Email address of the OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) territory manager. Used for dealer communications and escalations.

attributes.name: manager_name
attributes.description: Name of the OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) regional or territory manager responsible for overseeing this territory and dealer relationship.

attributes.name: manager_phone
attributes.description: Contact phone number for the OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) territory manager.

attributes.name: market_segment_classification
attributes.description: Classification of the territory market type based on population density and urbanization level. Influences vehicle mix allocation and marketing strategies.

attributes.name: modification_reason
attributes.description: Business justification for the most recent change to the territory assignment (e.g., market expansion, dealer consolidation, performance adjustment).

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next territory assignment review. Ensures regular evaluation of territory boundaries and dealer performance.

attributes.name: overlap_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this territory can overlap with other dealer territories. True allows shared coverage; False enforces exclusive boundaries.

attributes.name: overlap_rule_description
attributes.description: Business rules governing how overlapping territories are managed, including priority rules, customer assignment logic, and conflict resolution procedures.

attributes.name: performance_benchmark_group
attributes.description: Peer group or cohort used for dealer performance benchmarking. Territories with similar characteristics are grouped for fair comparison.

attributes.name: population_estimate
attributes.description: Estimated total population within the territory boundaries. Used for market sizing and dealer performance benchmarking.

attributes.name: postal_code_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated or range-based list of postal/zip codes included in the territory (e.g., '90001-90099,91000'). Used for precise geographic allocation.

attributes.name: primary_area_of_responsibility
attributes.description: Geographic description of the core territory where the dealer has primary sales and service responsibility. May include city names, county boundaries, or regional descriptors.

attributes.name: sales_potential_index
attributes.description: Numeric index representing the relative sales potential of the territory compared to a baseline (e.g., 100 = average, 150 = 50% above average). Used for vehicle allocation and quota setting.

attributes.name: special_program_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes describing any special programs, pilot initiatives, or unique conditions applicable to this territory (e.g., EV (Electric Vehicle) launch market, rural incentive zone).

attributes.name: state_province_code
attributes.description: Two or three-letter code for the state, province, or administrative region (e.g., CA, TX, ON).

attributes.name: territory_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code identifying the territory within the dealer network. Used for vehicle allocation and market planning.

attributes.name: territory_name
attributes.description: Business-friendly name or description of the territory (e.g., 'Metro East Region', 'Downtown District').

attributes.name: territory_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the territory assignment. Active territories are operational; pending awaits approval; suspended is temporarily halted; terminated is closed.

attributes.name: territory_type
attributes.description: Classification of territory assignment model: exclusive (single dealer), shared (multiple dealers), open (no restrictions), primary (main responsibility), secondary (backup coverage), overlay (special program).

attributes.name: vehicle_allocation_priority
attributes.description: Priority ranking for vehicle inventory allocation to this territory. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Used during supply constraints.

products.name: contact
products.description: Key personnel contacts at a dealership including dealer principal, general manager, sales manager, service manager, parts manager, and F&I manager. Tracks role, contact details, tenure, certification status, and active flag. Supports OEM communications, training enrollment, and dealer portal access management.

attributes.name: contact_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the dealer contact record. Primary key.

attributes.name: contact_dealer_dealership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealership where this contact is employed. Links to the dealer master record.

attributes.name: contact_dealership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealership where this contact is employed. Links to the dealer master record.

attributes.name: active_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contact is currently active and employed at the dealership. True if active; False if terminated, retired, or on extended leave.

attributes.name: certification_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date when the contact's current OEM certification expires and recertification is required. Null if certification is not required or not yet obtained.

attributes.name: certification_status
attributes.description: The current status of the contact's OEM certification or training requirements. Certified indicates all required certifications are current; in_progress indicates training underway; expired indicates recertification needed; not_required indicates role does not require certification; not_certified indicates certification required but not yet obtained.

attributes.name: communication_preference
attributes.description: The contact's preferred method of communication for OEM notifications and updates. Options include email, phone, mobile, fax, or portal messaging.

attributes.name: contact_role
attributes.description: The functional role or position of the contact at the dealership. Includes dealer principal, general manager, sales manager, service manager, parts manager, and F&I (Finance and Insurance) manager.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this dealer contact record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: The name of the source system from which this dealer contact record originated. Typically CDK Global DMS (Dealer Management System), Salesforce Automotive Cloud, or other dealer management platforms.

attributes.name: dealer_portal_access_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contact has been granted access to the OEM dealer portal for ordering, inventory management, warranty claims, and communications. True if access is granted; False if not.

attributes.name: department
attributes.description: The department or functional area within the dealership where the contact works. Includes sales, service, parts, F&I (Finance and Insurance), administration, and management.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary business email address for the dealer contact. Used for OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) communications, training enrollment, and dealer portal access.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_name
attributes.description: The name of the person to contact in case of an emergency involving this dealer contact.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_phone
attributes.description: The phone number of the emergency contact person for this dealer contact.

attributes.name: fax_number
attributes.description: Fax number for the dealer contact, if still in use for document transmission.

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: The given name of the dealer contact person.

attributes.name: hire_date
attributes.description: The date when the contact was hired or started employment at the dealership. Used to calculate tenure and eligibility for OEM programs.

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: The official job title or designation of the contact at the dealership, which may differ from the standardized contact role.

attributes.name: language_preference
attributes.description: The preferred language for communications with the contact. Uses ISO 639-2 three-letter language codes (ENG=English, SPA=Spanish, FRE=French, GER=German, ITA=Italian, POR=Portuguese, CHI=Chinese, JPN=Japanese, KOR=Korean, ARA=Arabic). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ENG|SPA|FRE|GER|ITA|POR|CHI|JPN|KOR|ARA — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: The family name or surname of the dealer contact person.

attributes.name: last_training_date
attributes.description: The date when the contact last completed an OEM training course or certification program.

attributes.name: middle_name
attributes.description: The middle name or initial of the dealer contact person, if applicable.

attributes.name: mobile_number
attributes.description: Mobile phone number for the dealer contact, used for urgent communications and field operations.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to the dealer contact. May include communication preferences, special requirements, or historical context.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary business phone number for the dealer contact. Includes country code, area code, and extension if applicable.

attributes.name: portal_last_login_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the contact last logged into the OEM dealer portal. Used to monitor engagement and identify inactive users.

attributes.name: portal_user_code
attributes.description: The unique user identifier or login name for the contact in the OEM dealer portal system. Used for authentication and access management.

attributes.name: preferred_delivery_time_slot
attributes.description: Customer preferred time slot for home deliveries.

attributes.name: primary_contact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact is the primary point of contact for their role at the dealership. True if primary; False if secondary or backup contact.

attributes.name: tenure_years
attributes.description: The number of years the contact has been employed at the dealership, calculated from hire date. Used for experience assessment and program eligibility.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date when the contact's employment at the dealership ended. Null if the contact is still active.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: The reason for the contact's departure from the dealership. Includes resignation, retirement, termination, transfer to another location, or other reasons.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this dealer contact record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

products.name: dealer_certification
products.description: Tracks OEM-issued certifications and program enrollments for a dealership, such as EV-certified dealer, ADAS service authorization, luxury brand certification, and IATF 16949 compliance status. Includes certification type, issuing body, issue date, expiry date, renewal requirements, and current status. Drives eligibility for vehicle allocation and incentive programs.
products.reference: OEM Dealer Standards and Certification Program

attributes.name: dealer_certification_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the dealer certification record. Primary key.

attributes.name: obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_obligation. Business justification: Regulatory compliance requires each dealer certification to be linked to the specific compliance obligation it satisfies, enabling audit of certification against obligations.

attributes.name: primary_dealer_dealership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealership that holds this certification. Links to the dealer master record.

attributes.name: allocation_eligibility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this certification makes the dealer eligible for preferential vehicle allocation (e.g., EV-certified dealers receive priority allocation of electric vehicles).

attributes.name: annual_maintenance_cost_amount
attributes.description: Estimated annual cost to maintain this certification, including renewal fees, ongoing training, and audit costs. Expressed in the OEM's reporting currency.

attributes.name: audit_outcome
attributes.description: Result of the most recent audit (e.g., passed, passed with conditions, failed). Determines whether certification remains in good standing.

attributes.name: audit_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dealer must undergo periodic audits to maintain this certification.

attributes.name: audit_score
attributes.description: Numerical score or rating achieved in the most recent audit (e.g., 0-100 scale, or percentage). Reflects compliance quality and performance.

attributes.name: authorized_vehicle_lines
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of vehicle model lines or platforms the dealer is authorized to sell or service under this certification (e.g., 'Model S, Model X, Model 3' for EV certification).

attributes.name: certification_level
attributes.description: Tier or grade of certification achieved by the dealer within a tiered program (e.g., Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum). Higher levels may unlock additional benefits.

attributes.name: certification_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the certification program or credential (e.g., 'Electric Vehicle Sales and Service Certification', 'Advanced Driver Assistance Systems Authorized Service Center').

attributes.name: certification_number
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric identifier assigned by the issuing body for this certification. Externally-known business identifier.

attributes.name: certification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the certification. Determines whether the dealer is currently authorized under this certification program.

attributes.name: certification_type
attributes.description: Category of certification awarded to the dealer. Defines the specialized capability or program enrollment (e.g., EV-certified dealer, ADAS service authorization, luxury brand certification).

attributes.name: compliance_standard
attributes.description: Name of the industry standard or regulatory framework this certification demonstrates compliance with (e.g., IATF 16949, ISO 9001, EPA emissions standards, NHTSA safety standards).

attributes.name: cost_amount
attributes.description: Total cost incurred by the dealer to obtain this certification, including training, equipment, facility upgrades, and application fees. Expressed in the OEM's reporting currency.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this certification record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this record (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY).

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which the certification becomes active and the dealer is authorized to operate under this certification. May differ from issue date if there is a grace period.

attributes.name: equipment_requirements
attributes.description: Description of specialized tools, diagnostic equipment, or technology the dealer must possess for this certification (e.g., high-voltage battery diagnostic tools, ADAS radar calibration systems).

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the certification expires and the dealer must renew to maintain authorization. Nullable for certifications with no expiration.

attributes.name: facility_requirements
attributes.description: Description of physical facility requirements the dealer must meet for this certification (e.g., dedicated EV charging bays, ADAS calibration equipment, climate-controlled service area).

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Geographic coverage level of this certification (e.g., global, regional, national, state/provincial, local). Defines where the certification is recognized.

attributes.name: home_delivery_certified_flag
attributes.description: Whether the dealer is certified for home delivery operations.

attributes.name: incentive_eligibility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this certification qualifies the dealer for special incentive programs, rebates, or performance bonuses.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Date when the certification was originally issued to the dealer. Marks the start of the certification validity period.

attributes.name: issuing_body
attributes.description: Name of the organization or authority that issued the certification (e.g., OEM corporate, IATF, SAE International, regional OEM division).

attributes.name: issuing_body_type
attributes.description: Classification of the entity that issued the certification (e.g., OEM corporate, industry association, regulatory body, third-party auditor).

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent audit conducted for this certification. Used to track audit compliance and schedule next audit.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this certification record was most recently updated. Audit trail for data lineage and change tracking.

attributes.name: last_renewal_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent renewal or recertification event. Tracks ongoing compliance and re-qualification.

attributes.name: minimum_certified_technicians
attributes.description: Minimum number of technicians who must hold individual certification credentials for the dealer to maintain this certification.

attributes.name: next_audit_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the next audit must be completed to maintain certification compliance.

attributes.name: next_renewal_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the dealer must complete renewal requirements to maintain active certification status. Used for proactive renewal management.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, special conditions, or contextual information about this certification record.

attributes.name: personnel_requirements
attributes.description: Description of staffing requirements for this certification (e.g., minimum number of certified technicians, specific role qualifications, training credentials).

attributes.name: reinstatement_date
attributes.description: Date when a previously suspended certification was reinstated to active status. Nullable if never suspended or not yet reinstated.

attributes.name: renewal_frequency_months
attributes.description: Number of months between required renewal cycles for this certification (e.g., 12 for annual, 24 for biennial, 36 for triennial).

attributes.name: revocation_date
attributes.description: Date when the certification was permanently revoked. Nullable if never revoked.

attributes.name: revocation_reason
attributes.description: Explanation of why the certification was permanently revoked, if applicable (e.g., serious compliance violations, fraudulent activity, repeated failures). Nullable if never revoked.

attributes.name: suspension_date
attributes.description: Date when the certification was suspended. Nullable if never suspended.

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: Explanation of why the certification was suspended, if applicable (e.g., failed audit, non-compliance with training requirements, facility deficiencies). Nullable if never suspended.

attributes.name: training_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the dealer completed the required training program for this certification. Nullable if training is not required or not yet completed.

attributes.name: training_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether dealer personnel must complete specific training programs to obtain or maintain this certification.

products.name: vehicle_allocation
products.description: Records the OEM's allocation of specific vehicle units (by VIN or allocation batch) to a dealership for a given model year and production period. Captures allocation quantity, nameplate, trim, powertrain type (ICE/HEV/PHEV/EV), allocation rule applied, priority tier, acceptance status, and delivery window. Core operational record linking manufacturing output to dealer inventory pipeline.
products.reference: OEM Vehicle Allocation and Distribution System

attributes.name: vehicle_allocation_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each vehicle allocation record linking a specific vehicle unit or allocation batch from OEM manufacturing output to a dealership inventory pipeline.

attributes.name: production_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing production order that produced the allocated vehicle units. Links manufacturing output to dealer allocation pipeline.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Allocation planning reports require linking each allocated vehicle to its SKU for capacity, cost, and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: vehicle_dealer_dealership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealership receiving this vehicle allocation. Links to the dealer master record in the dealer network.

attributes.name: vehicle_dealership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealership receiving this vehicle allocation. Links to the dealer master record in the dealer network.

attributes.name: acceptance_deadline
attributes.description: Date by which the dealer must formally accept or reject this allocation. Failure to respond by this date may result in automatic acceptance or reallocation per OEM dealer agreement terms.

attributes.name: acceptance_timestamp
attributes.description: Exact timestamp when the dealer formally accepted this vehicle allocation via the dealer portal or DMS integration. Provides precise audit trail for dealer commitment.

attributes.name: accepted_quantity
attributes.description: Number of vehicle units formally accepted by the dealer from this allocation. May be less than allocated_quantity if the dealer partially accepts or rejects units.

attributes.name: actual_delivery_date
attributes.description: Actual date the allocated vehicle(s) were physically delivered to and received by the dealership. Used for On-Time Delivery (OTD) performance measurement and dealer satisfaction tracking.

attributes.name: allocation_batch_number
attributes.description: Identifier grouping multiple allocation records issued in the same OEM allocation run or production release cycle. Enables batch-level tracking, reporting, and dealer communication.

attributes.name: allocation_date
attributes.description: The business event date on which the OEM formally allocated the vehicle unit(s) to the dealership. Represents the principal real-world event time for this transaction.

attributes.name: allocation_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this allocation transaction, used in dealer communications, DMS integration, and OEM-dealer correspondence. Format: ALLOC-{MY}-{sequence}.

attributes.name: allocation_rule_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific allocation rule or algorithm applied to determine this dealer's vehicle entitlement (e.g., turn-and-earn, market share, historical sales, regional quota). Drives transparency and auditability of allocation decisions.

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the vehicle allocation record. Tracks progression from OEM-initiated pending through dealer acceptance or rejection to final delivery confirmation.

attributes.name: allocation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the allocation purpose: standard retail inventory, priority customer order fulfillment, constrained supply allocation, fleet customer, dealer demonstrator vehicle, or loaner vehicle program.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this allocation record was first captured in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this allocation record (MSRP, dealer invoice price, incentive amounts). Supports multi-currency dealer networks in international markets.

attributes.name: dealer_invoice_price
attributes.description: The price at which the OEM invoices the dealer for the allocated vehicle, net of holdback and before dealer incentives. Represents the dealer's cost basis for inventory financing and margin calculation.

attributes.name: dms_reference_number
attributes.description: The corresponding allocation or stock order reference number in the dealer's CDK Global Dealer Management System (DMS). Enables end-to-end reconciliation between OEM allocation records and dealer inventory systems.

attributes.name: estimated_delivery_date
attributes.description: Estimated date the allocated vehicle(s) are expected to arrive at the dealership. Calculated based on production schedule, transport lead time, and PDI processing time. Communicated to dealers for inventory planning.

attributes.name: hold_code
attributes.description: Code indicating any active hold placed on the allocated vehicle(s) preventing retail sale (e.g., safety recall hold, quality hold, regulatory compliance hold, stop-sale order). Null when no hold is active. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: safety_recall|quality_hold|regulatory|stop_sale|tsb_hold|other — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: incentive_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of the dealer incentive or bonus applicable to this specific allocation record. Represents the financial benefit to the dealer for accepting and retailing this vehicle.

attributes.name: incentive_program_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the OEM dealer incentive program applicable to this allocation (e.g., volume bonus, stair-step program, conquest incentive). Links to the dealer incentive program master for payout calculation.

attributes.name: is_customer_order
attributes.description: Indicates whether this allocation is fulfilling a specific retail customer order (sold order) rather than being allocated to dealer stock inventory. Drives order fulfillment priority and customer communication workflows.

attributes.name: last_mile_delivery_method
attributes.description: Preferred last-mile delivery method for this allocation (truck, rail, self-drive).

attributes.name: msrp
attributes.description: Manufacturer Suggested Retail Price (MSRP) for the allocated vehicle unit in the base transaction currency. Used for dealer invoice calculation, incentive program application, and consumer pricing guidance.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, special handling instructions, or dealer-specific comments associated with this allocation record. Used by zone managers and dealer relations teams.

attributes.name: pdi_completed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI) has been completed for the allocated vehicle(s) at the dealership. Required before vehicle can be retailed to a customer.

attributes.name: pdi_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI) is required for the allocated vehicle(s) before retail handover. Drives dealer service scheduling and PDI cost recovery processes.

attributes.name: port_of_entry_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the port or processing compound through which imported or CKD/SKD vehicles pass before onward delivery to the dealer. Relevant for international allocation flows and customs compliance.

attributes.name: priority_tier
attributes.description: Dealer priority tier assigned for this allocation cycle, determining precedence when vehicle supply is constrained. Tier 1 dealers receive first allocation rights based on performance metrics, sales volume, or strategic importance.

attributes.name: production_plant_code
attributes.description: SAP plant code identifying the manufacturing facility where the allocated vehicle(s) were or will be produced. Used for logistics routing, transport cost calculation, and supply chain traceability.

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: OEM regional zone code (e.g., NORTHEAST, SOUTHEAST, CENTRAL, WEST) grouping territories for macro-level allocation planning, regional incentive programs, and zone manager oversight.

attributes.name: rejection_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the dealer's reason for rejecting this allocation (e.g., excess inventory, wrong specification, cash flow constraints, market demand mismatch). Null when allocation is accepted. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: excess_inventory|wrong_spec|cash_flow|demand_mismatch|facility_capacity|other — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: scheduled_production_date
attributes.description: Planned date on which the allocated vehicle unit(s) are scheduled to enter the production line. Derived from the Start of Production (SOP) schedule and used for delivery window planning.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record that originated this allocation record. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and multi-system integration auditing across SAP S/4HANA SD, CDK Global DMS, and Salesforce Automotive Cloud.

attributes.name: territory_code
attributes.description: OEM-defined sales territory code within which the dealer operates. Used for regional allocation quota management, zone-level supply balancing, and territory performance reporting.

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: Primary mode of transportation used to deliver the allocated vehicle(s) from the production plant or port of entry to the dealership. Drives logistics cost allocation and delivery lead time estimation.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this allocation record. Supports change tracking, audit compliance, and incremental data pipeline processing.

attributes.name: vin
attributes.description: 17-character Vehicle Identification Number (VIN) assigned to a specific vehicle unit within this allocation. Populated for unit-level allocations; null for batch-level allocations where VINs are not yet assigned.

products.name: allocation_rule
products.description: Business rules governing how vehicles are distributed across the dealer network. Defines rule type (volume-based, performance-based, geographic, model mix), applicable nameplates, MY (Model Year), priority weighting, minimum and maximum allocation thresholds, and effective period. Used by the allocation engine to generate vehicle_allocation records.

attributes.name: allocation_rule_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the vehicle allocation rule record in the dealer network management system.

attributes.name: dealer_incentive_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealer incentive program that this allocation rule is linked to. When allocation_basis is incentive-based, dealers enrolled in the referenced program receive preferential allocation treatment.

attributes.name: superseded_by_rule_allocation_rule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the allocation_rule_id of the newer rule that replaces this rule when it is superseded. Null if this rule has not been replaced. Enables rule lineage tracking across model year and program transitions.

attributes.name: allocation_basis
attributes.description: The primary metric or data source used to calculate each dealer's share of the total allocation pool under this rule. Retail sales uses prior-period retail units sold; wholesale_orders uses dealer order history; days_supply targets a specific inventory days-supply level; market_share uses regional market penetration; scorecard_rank uses the dealer performance scorecard ranking.

attributes.name: allocation_cycle
attributes.description: Frequency at which the allocation engine applies this rule to generate vehicle_allocation records. Determines the cadence of dealer inventory replenishment under this rule.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Workflow approval status of the allocation rule. Rules must be approved before transitioning to active status. Supports multi-level OEM approval workflows for allocation policy governance.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee ID of the OEM personnel who approved this allocation rule for activation. Supports audit trail and governance requirements.

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which this allocation rule received final approval and was authorized for activation in the allocation engine.

attributes.name: body_style
attributes.description: Body style segment to which this allocation rule applies. Used to enforce model mix targets across the dealer network. 'all' indicates the rule applies regardless of body style. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: sedan|suv|truck|van|coupe|convertible|wagon|all — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: carryover_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether unallocated units from a prior cycle can be carried over and added to the next cycle's pool under this rule. True enables carryover; False requires the pool to be reset each cycle.

attributes.name: conflict_resolution
attributes.description: Method used by the allocation engine when this rule conflicts with another active rule for the same dealer and nameplate. Highest_priority applies the rule with the highest priority_weight; sum combines allocations; average takes the mean; manual flags for human review.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this allocation rule record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.

attributes.name: dealer_tier
attributes.description: Dealer performance tier classification to which this rule applies. Tier 1 dealers (top performers) typically receive preferential allocation; Tier 2 and Tier 3 receive proportionally lower allocations. 'all' applies the rule across all tiers.

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: The calendar date from which this allocation rule becomes active and is applied by the allocation engine to generate vehicle_allocation records. Aligns with OEM model year launch or program start dates.

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: The calendar date after which this allocation rule is no longer applied by the allocation engine. Null indicates an open-ended rule with no defined expiry. Typically aligned with model year end or program end dates.

attributes.name: eop_date
attributes.description: End of Production (EOP) date for the model year and nameplate covered by this rule. Allocation rules are typically deactivated at or after EOP to manage wind-down inventory distribution.

attributes.name: external_rule_ref
attributes.description: The rule identifier or document reference as recorded in the originating source system (e.g., SAP condition record number, CDK rule ID). Enables cross-system reconciliation and traceability.

attributes.name: franchise_type
attributes.description: Dealer franchise model to which this rule applies: OEM-owned (factory store), independent franchise, dual franchise (carrying multiple OEM brands), or 'all' for rules spanning all franchise types.

attributes.name: last_mile_priority_flag
attributes.description: Whether this allocation rule prioritizes last-mile delivery optimization.

attributes.name: lookback_period_days
attributes.description: Number of historical days used to calculate the allocation basis metric (e.g., 90 days of retail sales history). Defines the rolling window for performance-based and volume-based allocation calculations.

attributes.name: max_allocation_units
attributes.description: Maximum number of vehicle units that can be allocated to a qualifying dealer under this rule per allocation cycle. Prevents over-concentration of inventory at high-volume dealers and supports equitable network distribution.

attributes.name: min_allocation_units
attributes.description: Minimum number of vehicle units that must be allocated to a qualifying dealer under this rule per allocation cycle. Ensures floor-level inventory support for smaller dealers and contractual franchise minimums.

attributes.name: min_csi_score
attributes.description: Minimum Customer Satisfaction Index (CSI) score a dealer must maintain to qualify for allocation under this rule. CSI is measured via OEM customer surveys post-purchase and post-service. Dealers below this threshold may be excluded or receive reduced allocation.

attributes.name: min_scorecard_score
attributes.description: Minimum dealer performance scorecard score required for a dealer to qualify for allocation under this rule. Used for performance-based rules to restrict allocation to dealers meeting OEM performance standards.

attributes.name: model_mix_target_pct
attributes.description: Target percentage of the allocated units that should be of the specified nameplate or powertrain type within the dealer's total inventory mix. Used for model_mix rule types to enforce portfolio balance (e.g., 20% EV mix target).

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: The vehicle Model Year (MY) to which this allocation rule applies, expressed as a four-digit calendar year (e.g., 2024, 2025). Aligns with OEM production planning cycles and SAP S/4HANA PP model year configuration.

attributes.name: nameplate_code
attributes.description: OEM-assigned code identifying the vehicle nameplate (model line) to which this allocation rule applies (e.g., F-150, Silverado, Camry, Model 3). Corresponds to the nameplate/model line in the PLM system.

attributes.name: override_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether authorized OEM personnel can manually override the allocation quantities generated by this rule for individual dealers. Supports exception handling for special dealer circumstances.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: SAP plant code identifying the manufacturing or assembly plant that is the source of vehicles allocated under this rule. Ties the allocation rule to a specific production source for supply chain planning.

attributes.name: powertrain_type
attributes.description: Powertrain technology segment to which this rule applies: ICE (Internal Combustion Engine), HEV (Hybrid Electric Vehicle), PHEV (Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle), BEV (Battery Electric Vehicle), FCEV (Fuel Cell Electric Vehicle), or 'all' for rules spanning all powertrain types. Supports EV transition planning and CAFE compliance allocation strategies.

attributes.name: priority_weight
attributes.description: Numeric weighting factor (0.00–100.00) assigned to this rule when multiple allocation rules apply simultaneously. Higher weights cause the allocation engine to favor this rule over lower-weighted rules during conflict resolution.

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: OEM-defined sales region code to which this allocation rule applies (e.g., NE for Northeast, MW for Midwest, SW for Southwest). Drives geographic allocation logic and territory-based distribution. Null indicates a national rule.

attributes.name: rule_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for the allocation rule, used in dealer communications, DMS integration, and allocation engine references (e.g., ALLOC-VOL-2024-001).

attributes.name: rule_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative description of the allocation rule's business purpose, special conditions, or exceptions. Provides context for allocation analysts and dealer network managers reviewing rule configurations.

attributes.name: rule_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for the allocation rule, used in reporting dashboards and dealer portal displays (e.g., 'Q1 2024 F-Series Volume Allocation - Northeast Region').

attributes.name: rule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the allocation rule. Draft rules are under review; active rules are used by the allocation engine; suspended rules are temporarily paused; expired rules have passed their effective end date; cancelled rules have been voided before activation.

attributes.name: rule_type
attributes.description: Classification of the allocation rule governing how vehicles are distributed. Volume-based uses historical sales volume; performance-based uses dealer scorecard metrics; geographic uses territory boundaries; model_mix enforces nameplate portfolio balance; incentive_based ties allocation to dealer incentive program participation; priority_based uses explicit dealer priority tiers. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: volume_based|performance_based|geographic|model_mix|incentive_based|priority_based — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: sop_date
attributes.description: Start of Production (SOP) date for the model year and nameplate covered by this rule. Used to align allocation rule activation with production availability and prevent premature dealer allocation commitments.

attributes.name: stackable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this allocation rule can be combined (stacked) with other active allocation rules for the same dealer, nameplate, and model year. Non-stackable rules are applied exclusively when triggered.

attributes.name: target_days_supply
attributes.description: Target inventory days-supply level that this allocation rule aims to achieve at qualifying dealers. Days supply = (current inventory units) / (average daily retail sales rate). Used when allocation_basis is 'days_supply'.

attributes.name: total_pool_units
attributes.description: Total number of vehicle units available in the allocation pool governed by this rule for the current allocation cycle. The allocation engine distributes these units across qualifying dealers according to the rule logic.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this allocation rule record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change detection in ETL pipelines and audit compliance.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number of this allocation rule, incremented each time the rule parameters are materially modified. Supports rule change history tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: zone_code
attributes.description: Sub-regional distribution zone code within the sales region to which this rule applies. Zones represent finer geographic groupings of dealers used for allocation granularity below the region level.

products.name: dealer_inventory
products.description: Real-time inventory of vehicles physically on-hand or in-transit at a dealership. Tracks VIN, nameplate, model year, trim, exterior/interior color, powertrain, days-on-lot, acquisition cost, current asking price, inventory status (available, sold, demo, loaner, in-transit), and PDI (Pre-Delivery Inspection) completion flag. Sourced from CDK Global DMS inventory module.

attributes.name: dealer_inventory_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each dealer inventory record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for this data product.

attributes.name: connected_vehicle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mobility.connected_vehicle. Business justification: Inventory Turnover Optimization monitors connectivity status of inventory vehicles to prioritize sales of connected models.

attributes.name: cpo_listing_id
attributes.description: FK to the CPO listing if this inventory item is a certified pre-owned vehicle.

attributes.name: finished_vehicle_stock_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.finished_vehicle_stock. Business justification: REQUIRED: Allocation traceability report needs to map each dealer inventory record to the originating finished‑vehicle stock for compliance and recall tracking.

attributes.name: manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Inventory manager ownership is tracked for inventory reconciliation and loss prevention reporting.

attributes.name: primary_dealer_dealership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealership that physically holds or is allocated this inventory unit. Sourced from CDK Global DMS dealer master.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Inventory management report requires linking each dealer inventory record to the SKU definition for pricing, specs, warranty and compliance.

attributes.name: vehicle_build_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.vehicle_build. Business justification: Needed for Vehicle Traceability report, connecting each inventory record to its exact build record for warranty and recall actions.

attributes.name: vehicle_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.vehicle_order. Business justification: Inventory allocation report needs to know which OEM vehicle order supplied each stocked vehicle.

attributes.name: vin_registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vehicle.vin_registry. Business justification: Dealer inventory management report requires each inventory record to be linked to the VIN registry for warranty, recall, and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: acquisition_cost
attributes.description: The dealer's total landed cost for this vehicle unit, including invoice price, transportation/destination charges, PDI costs, and any dealer-installed accessories. Used for gross profit calculation and inventory valuation.

attributes.name: allocation_order_number
