attributes.description: The OEM-assigned order or allocation number associated with this vehicle unit, linking the dealer inventory record back to the factory production order. Used for order tracking, allocation management, and OEM-dealer reconciliation.

attributes.name: asking_price
attributes.description: The dealer's current advertised or asking retail price for this vehicle unit. May differ from MSRP due to market adjustments, dealer markups, or promotional discounts. Updated dynamically based on market conditions and days-on-lot.

attributes.name: body_style
attributes.description: The vehicle body style classification (e.g., sedan, SUV, pickup truck, van). Used for inventory segmentation, lot management, and sales reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: sedan|coupe|SUV|crossover|pickup_truck|van|minivan|wagon|convertible|hatchback — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: certified_pre_owned
attributes.description: Indicates whether this used vehicle unit has been certified under the OEM's Certified Pre-Owned (CPO) program, meeting specific age, mileage, inspection, and reconditioning standards. True = CPO certified; False = not CPO certified. CPO vehicles carry extended warranty coverage and premium pricing.

attributes.name: days_on_lot
attributes.description: The number of calendar days this vehicle unit has been physically present on the dealer's lot since the received date. A key inventory aging metric used to trigger price adjustments, incentive programs, and wholesale decisions. Aged inventory (typically >60 days) incurs floor plan interest costs.

attributes.name: dms_record_reference
attributes.description: The source system record identifier from CDK Global DMS for this inventory unit. Used for data lineage, reconciliation, and incremental load processing between the DMS source and the Silver Layer lakehouse.

attributes.name: drivetrain
attributes.description: Drivetrain configuration of the vehicle: FWD (Front-Wheel Drive), RWD (Rear-Wheel Drive), AWD (All-Wheel Drive), or 4WD (Four-Wheel Drive). Key inventory search and customer preference attribute.

attributes.name: dwell_time_days
attributes.description: Number of days the vehicle has been in dealer inventory.

attributes.name: engine_description
attributes.description: Descriptive label for the engine or powertrain configuration (e.g., '2.5L 4-Cylinder', '3.5L V6 EcoBoost', '75 kWh Electric Motor'). Supports customer consultation and technical service identification.

attributes.name: estimated_arrival_date
attributes.description: The estimated date the vehicle unit is expected to arrive at the dealership from the OEM or transport carrier. Relevant for in-transit inventory. Used for customer pre-order management and lot planning.

attributes.name: exterior_color_code
attributes.description: OEM-assigned paint/exterior color code for this vehicle unit (e.g., 'NH-883P' for Sonic Gray Pearl). Used for inventory search, customer matching, and lot locator functions within CDK Global DMS.

attributes.name: exterior_color_name
attributes.description: Human-readable marketing name of the exterior paint color (e.g., 'Sonic Gray Pearl', 'Midnight Black Metallic'). Used for customer-facing display and sales consultation.

attributes.name: floor_plan_date
attributes.description: The date on which floor plan financing commenced for this vehicle unit. Used to calculate accrued floor plan interest costs and curtailment schedules. Null for vehicles not financed via floor plan.

attributes.name: floor_plan_lender
attributes.description: Name of the financial institution providing floor plan (wholesale) financing for this vehicle unit (e.g., 'Ford Motor Credit', 'Ally Financial', 'Chase Auto Finance'). Floor plan financing is the short-term credit line dealers use to fund vehicle inventory.

attributes.name: fuel_economy_city_mpg
attributes.description: EPA-rated city fuel economy for this vehicle configuration in miles per gallon (MPG), or MPGe for electric/hybrid vehicles. Required disclosure on the Monroney label and used for CAFE compliance reporting.

attributes.name: fuel_economy_highway_mpg
attributes.description: EPA-rated highway fuel economy for this vehicle configuration in miles per gallon (MPG), or MPGe for electric/hybrid vehicles. Required disclosure on the Monroney label and used for CAFE compliance reporting.

attributes.name: in_service_date
attributes.description: The date the vehicle was placed into service (sold and delivered to a retail customer, or placed into demo/loaner service). Marks the start of the OEM warranty period. Null if the vehicle has not yet been placed in service.

attributes.name: interior_color_code
attributes.description: OEM-assigned interior color/trim code for this vehicle unit (e.g., 'BK' for Black). Used for inventory matching and customer preference alignment.

attributes.name: interior_color_name
attributes.description: Human-readable marketing name of the interior color and material (e.g., 'Black Leather', 'Sandstone Cloth'). Used for customer-facing display and sales consultation.

attributes.name: inventory_status
attributes.description: Current disposition status of the vehicle unit within the dealer inventory lifecycle. 'available' = on-lot and saleable; 'sold' = retail sale completed; 'demo' = dealer demonstration unit; 'loaner' = service loaner vehicle; 'in_transit' = allocated but not yet physically received; 'reserved' = held for a specific customer; 'wholesale' = designated for wholesale/auction disposal. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: available|sold|demo|loaner|in_transit|reserved|wholesale — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: inventory_type
attributes.description: Classification of the vehicle unit by its condition and ownership history: 'new' = new vehicle never titled; 'used' = previously owned/titled vehicle; 'certified_pre_owned' = OEM-certified used vehicle meeting specific age/mileage criteria; 'demo' = dealer demonstration vehicle; 'loaner' = service loaner vehicle. Governs applicable pricing, warranty, and financing programs.

attributes.name: invoice_price
attributes.description: The OEM invoice price charged to the dealer for this vehicle unit, representing the dealer's acquisition cost from the manufacturer before holdback, dealer cash, or other incentives. Confidential commercial pricing data.

attributes.name: last_price_update_date
attributes.description: The date on which the asking price for this vehicle unit was most recently updated in the CDK Global DMS. Used to track pricing strategy cadence and ensure market-aligned pricing for aged inventory.

attributes.name: location_code
attributes.description: The physical lot or storage location code within the dealership where this vehicle is parked (e.g., 'LOT-A-12', 'SHOWROOM-3', 'OVERFLOW-B'). Used for lot management, vehicle locator, and PDI workflow routing within CDK Global DMS.

attributes.name: msrp
attributes.description: The Manufacturer Suggested Retail Price (MSRP) for this specific vehicle unit including all factory-installed options and packages, expressed in the local currency (USD). Established by the OEM and used as the baseline for dealer pricing and incentive calculations.

attributes.name: odometer_reading
attributes.description: Current odometer reading of the vehicle in miles at the time of inventory check-in or last update. Critical for used, demo, and loaner vehicles to determine CPO eligibility, warranty coverage, and pricing. For new vehicles, reflects delivery mileage.

attributes.name: pdi_completed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI) has been completed for this vehicle unit. PDI is a mandatory dealer quality check performed before vehicle delivery to a customer, verifying all systems, fluids, and accessories meet OEM standards. True = PDI completed; False = PDI pending.

attributes.name: pdi_completed_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI) was completed and signed off by the dealer's service technician. Null if PDI has not yet been performed.

attributes.name: recall_campaign_number
attributes.description: The NHTSA-assigned recall campaign number if this vehicle is subject to an active safety recall (e.g., '23V-123'). Null if no active recall. Used for recall remedy tracking and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: recall_hold
attributes.description: Indicates whether this vehicle unit is subject to an active NHTSA safety recall that prevents retail sale or delivery until the recall remedy has been performed. True = vehicle is on recall hold and cannot be sold; False = no active recall hold. Critical for regulatory compliance and consumer safety.

attributes.name: received_date
attributes.description: The date the vehicle unit was physically received and checked into the dealer's inventory from the OEM transport carrier or trade-in. Marks the start of the days-on-lot aging clock and floor plan financing period.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this dealer inventory record was first created in the Silver Layer lakehouse, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this dealer inventory record was most recently updated in the Silver Layer lakehouse, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports change tracking, incremental processing, and audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: source_type
attributes.description: Indicates how the dealer acquired this vehicle unit: 'factory_order' = ordered directly from OEM; 'dealer_trade' = acquired via dealer-to-dealer trade; 'auction' = purchased at wholesale auction; 'trade_in' = accepted as customer trade-in; 'fleet_return' = returned from fleet/rental program; 'lease_return' = returned at end of lease term.

attributes.name: stock_number
attributes.description: Dealer-assigned internal stock number used within the CDK Global DMS to identify and locate this vehicle on the lot. Unique within a dealership but not globally unique.

attributes.name: transmission_type
attributes.description: Type of transmission fitted to the vehicle: automatic, manual, CVT (Continuously Variable Transmission), DCT (Dual-Clutch Transmission), or single_speed (for BEV). Used for inventory filtering and customer preference matching.

attributes.name: transport_status
attributes.description: Current transportation status for vehicles in the delivery pipeline from OEM plant to dealership: 'not_shipped' = awaiting dispatch from plant; 'in_transit' = en route via carrier; 'delivered' = arrived at dealer; 'rail' = currently on rail transport; 'truck' = currently on truck transport.

attributes.name: window_sticker_url
attributes.description: URL link to the digital Monroney window sticker (required by the Automobile Information Disclosure Act) for this vehicle unit, hosted by the OEM or a third-party service. Contains MSRP, standard equipment, options, fuel economy ratings, and safety information.

attributes.name: yard_slot_code
attributes.description: Yard slot code where the vehicle is parked at the dealership.

products.name: parts_inventory
products.description: Dealer-level parts and accessories inventory managed through the CDK Global DMS parts module. Tracks OEM part number, SKU, description, quantity on hand, quantity on order, bin location, reorder point, supersession chain, price, and parts classification (mechanical, body, electrical, accessories). Supports service operations and parts counter sales.

attributes.name: parts_inventory_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each parts inventory record at the dealer location. Primary key for the dealer parts inventory entity in the Silver Layer lakehouse.

attributes.name: inbound_part_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.inbound_part. Business justification: Traceability for recalls and quality requires linking each dealer part stock item to its inbound part record.

attributes.name: parts_dealer_dealership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealer location where this parts inventory record is maintained. Links to the dealer master entity in the dealer domain.

attributes.name: parts_dealership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealer location where this parts inventory record is maintained. Links to the dealer master entity in the dealer domain.

attributes.name: procurement_supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supplier. Business justification: Needed for Parts Inventory Management to associate each part stock with its supplying vendor for ordering, pricing, and compliance.

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.sku_master. Business justification: REQUIRED: Parts pricing, valuation and regulatory compliance reports require linking dealer parts stock to the master SKU definition.

attributes.name: spare_parts_catalog_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.spare_parts_catalog. Business justification: Parts inventory must reference the master parts catalog for pricing, compliance, and warranty reporting; this is required for the Parts Pricing & Compliance Report.

attributes.name: average_monthly_demand
attributes.description: Rolling average monthly sales or usage quantity for this part at the dealer location, as calculated and stored by the CDK DMS parts analysis engine. Used for reorder point setting and stocking level optimization. Stored as a DMS-sourced field, not a lakehouse-computed metric.

attributes.name: bin_location
attributes.description: Physical storage bin, shelf, or rack location code within the dealer parts warehouse or stockroom where this part is stored. Used by parts staff for picking, receiving, and cycle counting. Managed within CDK Global DMS warehouse management.

attributes.name: core_charge_amount
attributes.description: The refundable deposit amount charged to the customer for the return of the old/used core part. Applicable only when is_core_part is true. Tracked separately in CDK DMS for core deposit liability accounting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this parts inventory record was first created in the CDK Global DMS parts module. Represents the business record creation event, not the ETL load time. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to all monetary price fields (dealer cost price, list price, retail price) for this parts inventory record. Supports multi-currency dealer networks in international markets.

attributes.name: dealer_cost_price
attributes.description: The price at which the dealer procures this part from the OEM or authorized distributor, net of any dealer program discounts. Used for gross margin calculation and parts profitability analysis. Confidential commercial pricing data.

attributes.name: inventory_snapshot_date
attributes.description: The business date as of which this inventory record reflects the parts quantities and status. Represents the effective date of the CDK DMS data extract loaded into the Silver Layer. Enables point-in-time inventory reporting and trend analysis.

attributes.name: inventory_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the part in the dealer inventory. Active parts are available for sale and service. Discontinued parts are no longer manufactured. Superseded parts have been replaced by a newer part number. Backordered parts are on order but not yet received. Restricted parts require special authorization. Obsolete parts are no longer supported. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: active|discontinued|superseded|backordered|restricted|obsolete — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: is_core_part
attributes.description: Indicates whether this part has a core charge associated with it, requiring the customer to return the old/used part (core) for a refund. Common for remanufactured parts such as alternators, starters, and brake calipers. Drives core deposit tracking in CDK DMS.

attributes.name: is_hazardous_material
attributes.description: Indicates whether this part or fluid is classified as a hazardous material requiring special handling, storage, and disposal procedures under EPA, DOT, and OSHA regulations. Affects shipping documentation and storage bin assignment.

attributes.name: is_serialized
attributes.description: Indicates whether individual units of this part are tracked by unique serial number for warranty, recall, and traceability purposes. Serialized parts (e.g., ECUs, airbag modules) require serial number capture at point of sale and installation.

attributes.name: last_count_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent physical inventory count or cycle count was performed for this part at the dealer location. Used to assess inventory accuracy and schedule next count per IATF 16949 inventory control requirements.

attributes.name: last_receipt_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent stock receipt (goods receipt) was posted for this part at the dealer location. Used to assess inventory freshness, identify slow-moving stock, and support cycle count scheduling.

attributes.name: last_sale_date
attributes.description: Date on which this part was most recently sold or issued from the dealer's parts inventory, either over the parts counter or via a repair order. Key metric for identifying slow-moving and non-moving (dead stock) inventory.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this parts inventory record in the CDK Global DMS, including quantity adjustments, price updates, bin location changes, or status changes. Used for change detection in incremental Silver Layer loads.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Expected number of calendar days from purchase order placement to receipt of this part at the dealer location. Used to set reorder points and manage customer promise dates for back-ordered parts.

attributes.name: list_price
attributes.description: OEM published list price for this part as defined in the official parts price book. Serves as the baseline for retail pricing and customer quotations at the parts counter. Updated periodically via OEM price file updates in CDK DMS.

attributes.name: lost_sales_quantity
attributes.description: Cumulative quantity of lost sales recorded for this part when a customer requested the part but it was not available in stock. Tracked in CDK DMS to support stocking level adjustments and identify demand not captured by sales history.

attributes.name: maximum_stock_level
attributes.description: Upper inventory limit for this part at the dealer location. Prevents over-stocking and excess capital tied up in slow-moving parts. Used in conjunction with reorder point for min-max inventory management in CDK DMS.

attributes.name: model_year_applicability
attributes.description: The vehicle Model Year (MY) range for which this part is applicable, expressed as a single year (e.g., 2022) or a range (e.g., 2019-2024). Used by parts counter staff to verify fitment and avoid incorrect part installation.

attributes.name: months_supply
attributes.description: Number of months the current on-hand quantity is expected to last based on the trailing average monthly demand. Sourced directly from CDK DMS parts analysis module. Used to identify overstocked and understocked parts for return-to-OEM decisions.

attributes.name: oem_part_number
attributes.description: The official OEM-assigned part number as defined in the parts catalog and PLM system. This is the primary catalog identifier used for ordering, supersession tracking, and warranty claims. Sourced from Siemens Teamcenter PLM and SAP MM material master.

attributes.name: parts_classification
attributes.description: High-level classification category of the part used for inventory segmentation, reporting, and stocking strategy. Categories include mechanical (engine, drivetrain, suspension), body (panels, glass, trim), electrical (ECU, sensors, wiring), accessories (OEM-approved add-ons), fluids, and consumables. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mechanical|body|electrical|accessories|fluids|consumables — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: parts_group_code
attributes.description: OEM-defined parts group or commodity code that further classifies the part within the parts classification hierarchy. Used for bulk ordering, supplier management, and warranty analysis. Aligns with SAP MM material group.

attributes.name: quantity_available
attributes.description: Net quantity available for immediate sale or service fulfillment, calculated as quantity on hand minus quantity reserved. Represents the unreserved, physically present stock. Stored as a business field from CDK DMS to avoid real-time recalculation in reporting.

attributes.name: quantity_on_hand
attributes.description: Current physical quantity of the part available in the dealer's parts stockroom as recorded in the CDK DMS. Represents the actual counted or system-tracked stock level used for service fulfillment and parts counter sales.

attributes.name: quantity_on_order
attributes.description: Total quantity of this part currently on open purchase orders submitted to the OEM or aftermarket supplier but not yet received at the dealer. Used for demand planning and avoiding duplicate orders.

attributes.name: quantity_reserved
attributes.description: Quantity of this part that has been reserved or allocated to open repair orders, customer back-orders, or service appointments but not yet consumed. Reduces available-to-promise quantity for new service requests.

attributes.name: recall_campaign_number
attributes.description: NHTSA or OEM-assigned recall campaign identifier associated with this part when recall_flag is true. Used to link parts inventory to specific recall campaigns for compliance tracking and OEM reimbursement claims.

attributes.name: recall_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this part is associated with an active NHTSA safety recall or OEM field action. Recall-flagged parts may have restricted sale or mandatory installation requirements. Supports compliance with NHTSA recall management obligations.

attributes.name: reorder_point
attributes.description: Minimum stock level threshold at which a replenishment order should be triggered for this part. When quantity on hand falls to or below this level, the DMS generates a replenishment recommendation. Set based on historical demand and lead time.

attributes.name: reorder_quantity
attributes.description: Standard order quantity to be placed when the reorder point is reached. Represents the economic order quantity (EOQ) or OEM-mandated minimum order quantity for this part at this dealer location.

attributes.name: retail_price
attributes.description: Dealer-set retail selling price for this part at the parts counter or in service repair orders. May differ from OEM list price based on dealer markup strategy, local market conditions, or promotional pricing.

attributes.name: returnable_container_code
attributes.description: Code of the returnable container holding this inventory.

attributes.name: sku
attributes.description: Dealer-level Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) code used within the CDK Global DMS parts module for inventory tracking, bin management, and point-of-sale transactions. May differ from OEM part number when dealer applies local stocking codes.

attributes.name: storage_condition
attributes.description: Required storage condition for this part to maintain quality and safety compliance. Drives bin assignment and warehouse layout decisions. Flammable and hazardous parts require segregated storage per EPA and DOT regulations.

attributes.name: superseded_by_date
attributes.description: The date on which this part number was officially superseded by the superseding part number as communicated by the OEM. Used to manage transition inventory and inform service advisors of part number changes.

attributes.name: superseding_part_number
attributes.description: The OEM part number that replaces this part when it has been superseded. Populated when inventory_status is 'superseded'. Enables the parts counter to automatically redirect orders to the current valid part number. Part of the supersession chain managed in the OEM parts catalog.

attributes.name: supplier_part_number
attributes.description: The part number assigned by the OEM distributor or aftermarket supplier for cross-reference purposes. Used when ordering from non-OEM sources or when the dealer stocks approved aftermarket alternatives alongside OEM parts.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit of measure in which the part is stocked, ordered, and sold. EA (each) is most common for discrete parts; KG/L for fluids and chemicals; SET/PAIR for grouped components. Aligns with SAP MM base unit of measure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|KG|L|M|SET|BOX|PAIR|ROLL — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: vehicle_model_applicability
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of vehicle model names or platform codes for which this part is applicable (e.g., F-150, Explorer, Mustang). Supports fitment verification at the parts counter and in service repair order creation.

attributes.name: warranty_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this part is eligible for OEM warranty claim submission when installed during a warranty repair. Non-warranty-eligible parts (e.g., customer-pay accessories) are excluded from warranty billing to the OEM.

products.name: order
products.description: Dealer stock orders and customer-specific vehicle orders placed by the dealership with the OEM. Captures order type (stock vs retail), nameplate, MY, configuration (trim, options, packages), order date, requested delivery date, order status (submitted, confirmed, scheduled, produced, shipped, delivered), and OTD (On-Time Delivery) tracking. Integrates with SAP SD and CDK Global DMS.

attributes.name: order_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each dealer order record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for the dealer_order data product.

attributes.name: connected_vehicle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mobility.connected_vehicle. Business justification: Order‑to‑OTA Mapping links each vehicle order to its connected vehicle record for OTA update eligibility tracking.

attributes.name: order_customer_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the retail customer for whom this order is placed. Populated for retail (customer-specific) orders; null for stock orders.

attributes.name: order_dealer_dealership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealership that placed this order. Links to the dealer master record in the dealer domain.

attributes.name: order_dealership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealership that placed this order. Links to the dealer master record in the dealer domain.

attributes.name: order_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the retail customer for whom this order is placed. Populated for retail (customer-specific) orders; null for stock orders.

attributes.name: production_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.production_order. Business justification: Required for Dealer Order Fulfillment report linking each dealer order to the specific production order that will build the vehicle.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Dealer order processing and financing depend on the exact SKU to calculate MSRP, incentives, and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: vehicle_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.vehicle_order. Business justification: Dealer order reconciliation report matches each dealer purchase order to the OEM vehicle order that fulfills it.

attributes.name: vin_registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vehicle.vin_registry. Business justification: Dealer order processing must associate each order with the specific VIN to enable production tracking and post‑sale service.

attributes.name: actual_delivery_date
attributes.description: The actual date the vehicle was physically delivered to the dealership. Used to calculate On-Time Delivery (OTD) performance against the confirmed delivery date.

attributes.name: actual_ship_date
attributes.description: The actual date the vehicle departed the production plant or port for transit to the dealership. Used to measure logistics performance and update OTD tracking.

attributes.name: allocation_pool_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the vehicle allocation pool or program from which this order is fulfilled (e.g., regional allocation, fleet pool, dealer stock pool). Governs allocation rules and constraints.

attributes.name: body_style
attributes.description: The body style classification of the ordered vehicle. Used for production scheduling, logistics planning, and sales mix reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: sedan|coupe|SUV|truck|van|wagon|convertible — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: cancellation_reason_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the reason for order cancellation (e.g., customer withdrawal, dealer over-allocation, duplicate order). Populated only when order_status is cancelled.

attributes.name: confirmed_delivery_date
attributes.description: The OEM-confirmed delivery date communicated back to the dealer after production scheduling. May differ from the requested delivery date.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the dealer order record was first created in the system. Audit trail field conforming to IATF 16949 data traceability requirements.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this order (e.g., USD, EUR, CAD). Enables multi-currency reporting across dealer networks in different markets.

attributes.name: days_late
attributes.description: Number of calendar days the actual delivery date exceeded the confirmed delivery date. Zero or negative values indicate on-time or early delivery. Used for OTD variance analysis and dealer penalty calculations.

attributes.name: dealer_invoice_amount
attributes.description: The wholesale invoice price charged by the OEM to the dealer for this vehicle order. Represents the net amount the dealer pays before any holdback or incentive adjustments.

attributes.name: dms_order_number
attributes.description: Order reference number assigned by the CDK Global Dealer Management System at the dealership level. Enables reconciliation between OEM and dealer systems.

attributes.name: estimated_ship_date
attributes.description: The estimated date the vehicle is expected to depart the production plant or port for transit to the dealership. Used for logistics planning and dealer communication.

attributes.name: exterior_color_code
attributes.description: OEM-assigned paint color code for the exterior of the ordered vehicle. Used for production scheduling, paint shop sequencing, and inventory matching.

attributes.name: field_service_info
attributes.description: Generic field service info placeholder

attributes.name: hold_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason an order has been placed on hold, such as parts shortage, regulatory hold, credit hold, or customer change request. Null when order is not on hold.

attributes.name: home_delivery_requested_flag
attributes.description: Whether the customer requested home delivery for this order.

attributes.name: homologation_variant
attributes.description: The regulatory homologation variant code specifying market-specific compliance configurations (e.g., US-spec, EU-spec, CARB-spec). Ensures the vehicle meets applicable NHTSA, EPA, UNECE, or CARB standards for the destination market.

attributes.name: incentive_amount
attributes.description: Total OEM incentive or discount amount applied to this order, including dealer cash, consumer cash, and program incentives. Reduces the effective dealer cost.

attributes.name: interior_color_code
attributes.description: OEM-assigned interior trim and color code for the ordered vehicle. Used for production configuration and dealer inventory matching.

attributes.name: market_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the market where the vehicle will be sold. Determines applicable regulatory standards (NHTSA, EPA, CARB, Euro NCAP, UNECE), homologation requirements, and pricing.

attributes.name: msrp_amount
attributes.description: The Manufacturer Suggested Retail Price (MSRP) for the fully configured vehicle as ordered, in the base currency. Represents the gross base amount before dealer adjustments, incentives, or taxes.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or special instructions associated with the order, entered by the dealer or OEM order management team. May include customer preferences, special handling requirements, or escalation notes.

attributes.name: order_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the dealer submitted the order to the OEM. This is the principal business event date for the order transaction.

attributes.name: order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the dealer order tracking progression from submission through delivery. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: submitted|confirmed|scheduled|produced|shipped|delivered|cancelled — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: order_type
attributes.description: Classification of the order indicating whether it is a dealer stock replenishment order, a retail customer-specific order, a demonstration vehicle order, a fleet order, or a courtesy vehicle order.

attributes.name: otd_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vehicle was delivered on or before the confirmed delivery date. True = delivered on time; False = delivered late. Core metric for OTD performance reporting and dealer satisfaction.

attributes.name: pdi_completed_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI) was completed at the dealership. Null if PDI has not yet been performed.

attributes.name: pdi_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI) is required before the vehicle is handed over to the customer. True = PDI mandatory; False = PDI not required.

attributes.name: priority_code
attributes.description: Priority classification assigned to the order for production scheduling and allocation purposes. Higher priority orders are scheduled earlier in the production sequence.

attributes.name: production_plant_code
attributes.description: SAP plant code identifying the manufacturing facility assigned to produce the vehicle for this order. Determined during production scheduling.

attributes.name: production_week
attributes.description: ISO 8601 production week (e.g., 2025-W23) in which the vehicle is scheduled to be built. Used for production scheduling, capacity planning, and OTD tracking.

attributes.name: requested_delivery_date
attributes.description: The date by which the dealer has requested the vehicle to be delivered to the dealership. Used for On-Time Delivery (OTD) target setting and production scheduling.

attributes.name: sales_region_code
attributes.description: OEM sales region code associated with the ordering dealer. Used for regional sales performance reporting, allocation management, and incentive program eligibility.

attributes.name: sap_sales_order_number
attributes.description: Externally-known SAP SD sales order number assigned by the OEM ERP system upon order confirmation. Used for cross-system traceability between the lakehouse and SAP S/4HANA.

attributes.name: shipping_method
attributes.description: The logistics mode used to transport the vehicle from the production plant to the dealership: rail, truck (auto carrier), ocean vessel, or a combination.

attributes.name: source
attributes.description: The channel or system through which the dealer order was submitted to the OEM: dealer portal, CDK Global DMS integration, EDI transmission, manual entry, or API.

attributes.name: transmission_type
attributes.description: The transmission type specified for the ordered vehicle: automatic, manual, Continuously Variable Transmission (CVT), or Dual-Clutch Transmission (DCT).

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the dealer order record was most recently modified. Used for change tracking, data lineage, and incremental ETL processing in the Databricks lakehouse.

products.name: retail_sale
products.description: Records the retail sale of a new or used vehicle by a dealership to an end customer. Captures VIN, sale date, sale price, MSRP, discount amount, trade-in details, financing type (cash, retail finance, lease), F&I products sold, salesperson, and deal status. Sourced from CDK Global DMS F&I module. SSOT for dealer-level vehicle sales transactions.

attributes.name: retail_sale_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each retail vehicle sale transaction record in the dealer domain. Primary key for the retail_sale data product.

attributes.name: fi_contract_id
attributes.description: FK to the Finance & Insurance contract associated with this retail sale.

attributes.name: opportunity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.opportunity. Business justification: Retail sale conversion analysis links the final sale back to the originating sales opportunity for win‑loss tracking.

attributes.name: retail_customer_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the retail customer (buyer) who purchased the vehicle. Links to the customer master record.

attributes.name: retail_dealer_dealership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealership that executed the retail sale transaction. Links to the dealer master record in the dealer domain.

attributes.name: retail_dealership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealership that executed the retail sale transaction. Links to the dealer master record in the dealer domain.

attributes.name: retail_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealership salesperson (finance and insurance associate or sales consultant) who managed and closed the retail deal.

attributes.name: retail_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the retail customer (buyer) who purchased the vehicle. Links to the customer master record.

attributes.name: retail_salesperson_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealership salesperson (finance and insurance associate or sales consultant) who managed and closed the retail deal.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Retail sale transaction must reference the SKU for warranty registration, service history, and post‑sale reporting.

attributes.name: vin_registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vehicle.vin_registry. Business justification: Retail sale reporting and warranty registration depend on linking the sold vehicle to its VIN registry entry.

attributes.name: apr
attributes.description: The Annual Percentage Rate (APR) on the retail installment contract as disclosed to the customer under Regulation Z. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0699 for 6.99%). Null for cash and lease deals.

attributes.name: back_end_gross
attributes.description: Gross profit earned from F&I products and dealer reserve on the financing (back-end), representing the total F&I department contribution to the deal. Key dealer profitability metric.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the retail sale record was first created in the data platform (Silver Layer ingestion). Conforms to ISO 8601 format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this retail sale record (e.g., USD, CAD, EUR). Supports multi-market dealer network operations.

attributes.name: deal_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric deal reference number assigned by the CDK Global DMS F&I module at the time the deal is opened. Used for cross-referencing with dealer records, lender submissions, and OEM reporting.

attributes.name: deal_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the retail sale deal. 'draft' indicates deal is being structured; 'pending' indicates awaiting lender funding approval; 'funded' indicates lender has funded the deal; 'unwound' indicates a previously funded deal that was reversed; 'cancelled' indicates deal was voided before funding.

attributes.name: delivery_date
attributes.description: The date the vehicle was physically delivered to the customer following Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI). May differ from sale_date when delivery is deferred. Used for warranty start date determination and OEM retail reporting.

attributes.name: delivery_method
attributes.description: Method of vehicle delivery to customer (dealer_pickup, home_delivery, compound_pickup).

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total discount applied to the vehicle sale, calculated as MSRP minus sale price. Includes dealer discounts, OEM incentive discounts, and employee pricing adjustments. Used for dealer margin analysis and OEM incentive reconciliation.

attributes.name: dms_deal_reference
attributes.description: The native deal identifier assigned by the CDK Global DMS F&I module. Used for source system traceability, reconciliation, and integration with downstream OEM reporting and lender portals.

attributes.name: doc_fee
attributes.description: Dealer-charged documentation and processing fee included in the deal. Subject to state-level regulatory caps in many jurisdictions. Disclosed on the buyer's order.

attributes.name: down_payment
attributes.description: Cash down payment made by the customer at the time of sale, excluding trade-in allowance. Reduces the amount financed. Used for deal structure analysis and lender submission.

attributes.name: fi_product_revenue
attributes.description: Total gross revenue generated from Finance and Insurance (F&I) aftermarket products sold as part of the deal, including extended service contracts, GAP insurance, paint protection, tire and wheel protection, and credit life/disability insurance.

attributes.name: finance_amount
attributes.description: The total amount financed by the customer under the retail installment contract, including vehicle price, F&I products, taxes, and fees, less down payment and trade-in allowance. Null for cash deals.

attributes.name: financing_type
attributes.description: The method by which the customer is financing the vehicle purchase. 'cash' = outright purchase; 'retail_finance' = retail installment contract through a lender; 'lease' = closed-end consumer lease; 'balloon' = balloon payment retail contract.

attributes.name: fleet_sale
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vehicle was sold as part of a fleet or commercial account transaction rather than a retail consumer sale. Fleet sales are tracked separately for CAFE compliance, OEM fleet incentive programs, and sales mix reporting.

attributes.name: front_end_gross
attributes.description: Gross profit earned on the vehicle sale itself (front-end), calculated as sale price minus dealer invoice cost and pack. Excludes F&I product revenue. Key dealer profitability metric reported in DMS and OEM dealer scorecards.

attributes.name: lender_name
attributes.description: Name of the financial institution (captive finance company, bank, credit union) that approved and funded the retail installment contract or lease. Null for cash deals. Used for lender mix reporting and dealer reserve analysis.

attributes.name: loan_term_months
attributes.description: The contractual term of the retail installment contract expressed in months (e.g., 36, 48, 60, 72, 84). Used for lender mix analysis, payment affordability reporting, and portfolio risk assessment.

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: The Model Year (MY) of the vehicle sold, as defined by the OEM and NHTSA. Used for CAFE compliance reporting, incentive program eligibility, and sales mix analytics.

attributes.name: monthly_payment
attributes.description: The customer's contracted monthly payment amount under the retail installment contract or lease agreement. Used for affordability analysis and customer financial profiling.

attributes.name: msrp_amount
attributes.description: The Manufacturer Suggested Retail Price (MSRP) of the vehicle as stickered, inclusive of all factory-installed options and destination charges. Expressed in the local currency (USD). Used as the baseline for discount calculation, incentive reporting, and dealer margin analysis.

attributes.name: oem_incentive_amount
attributes.description: Total value of OEM-funded customer incentives applied to the deal, including cash-back rebates, conquest bonuses, loyalty bonuses, and special program pricing. Sourced from OEM incentive program data and reconciled against dealer statements.

attributes.name: oem_program_code
attributes.description: OEM-assigned program code identifying the specific incentive or sales program under which the vehicle was sold (e.g., employee pricing, conquest, loyalty, fleet, rental). Used for OEM incentive claim submission and program performance reporting.

attributes.name: pdi_completed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI) was completed and signed off by the dealer technician prior to vehicle delivery to the customer. PDI completion is required for warranty activation and OEM delivery standards compliance.

attributes.name: sale_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the retail vehicle sale was consummated — i.e., the date the buyer signed the retail installment contract or cash purchase agreement. This is the principal business event date used for sales reporting, OEM incentive eligibility, and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: sale_price
attributes.description: The agreed-upon selling price of the vehicle as negotiated between the dealer and the customer, before trade-in allowance, taxes, and fees. This is the gross capitalized cost for lease deals or the selling price for retail finance and cash deals.

attributes.name: sales_tax_amount
attributes.description: State and local sales tax assessed on the vehicle sale transaction. Calculated based on the taxable selling price and the applicable jurisdiction tax rate. Used for tax remittance reporting and deal cost reconciliation.

attributes.name: stock_number
attributes.description: Dealer-assigned inventory stock number for the vehicle unit at the time of sale. Used for dealer inventory management and reconciliation with CDK Global DMS inventory records.

attributes.name: trade_in_allowance
attributes.description: The agreed trade-in value credited to the customer for a vehicle traded in as part of the deal. Reduces the amount financed or cash due. Null if no trade-in vehicle was involved in the transaction.

attributes.name: trade_in_payoff_amount
attributes.description: The outstanding loan or lease payoff balance on the customer's trade-in vehicle at the time of the deal. If payoff exceeds trade-in allowance, the difference (negative equity) is typically rolled into the new deal.

attributes.name: trade_in_vin
attributes.description: The 17-character VIN of the customer's trade-in vehicle, if applicable. Used for used vehicle inventory intake, auction disposition tracking, and trade-in equity analysis.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the retail sale record was last modified in the data platform, reflecting deal amendments, status changes, or corrections sourced from CDK Global DMS. Conforms to ISO 8601 format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: vehicle_condition
attributes.description: Condition classification of the vehicle at point of sale. 'new' indicates a new, untitled vehicle; 'used' indicates a previously titled vehicle; 'certified_pre_owned' indicates a manufacturer-certified pre-owned vehicle meeting OEM CPO program standards.

attributes.name: warranty_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the OEM new vehicle limited warranty period commences, typically aligned with the delivery_date or sale_date per OEM warranty policy. Used for warranty claim eligibility determination.

products.name: dealer_service_appointment
products.description: Scheduled service appointments at a dealership for vehicle maintenance, warranty repair, recall service, or customer-pay work. Tracks appointment date/time, customer, VIN, service type, advisor assigned, estimated duration, appointment status (scheduled, checked-in, in-progress, completed, no-show), and transportation option (loaner, shuttle, wait). Sourced from CDK Global DMS service scheduling module. This product is the single source of truth (SSOT) for its concept in the ECM Lakehouse.

attributes.name: dealer_service_appointment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the dealer_service_appointment data product (auto-inserted pre-linking).

attributes.name: aftersales_service_appointment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to aftersales.service_appointment. Business justification: Business process: Dealer DMS schedules service appointments; aftersales processes them. Linking ensures appointment sync for parts, labor, and warranty tracking.

attributes.name: connected_vehicle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mobility.connected_vehicle. Business justification: Service Appointment Optimization uses real‑time vehicle location from the connected vehicle; required for scheduling and parts readiness.

attributes.name: dealership_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to dealer.dealership. Business justification: Dealer service appointments belong to a dealership; add dealership_id FK to link to dealership and remove redundant dealer_id column.

attributes.name: maintenance_work_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.maintenance_work_center. Business justification: Service appointments are scheduled against specific service bays (work centers); linking supports the Service Capacity Planning report.

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.party. Business justification: Service appointment scheduling needs to associate the customer (party) with the appointment for service history and follow‑up.

attributes.name: service_advisor_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Service appointments are assigned to a service advisor; required for labor costing and service KPI dashboards.

attributes.name: vin_registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vehicle.vin_registry. Business justification: Service appointment scheduling must reference the specific vehicle VIN to allocate resources and track service history.

attributes.name: appointment_date
attributes.description: Date of the service appointment

attributes.name: appointment_status
attributes.description: Status (scheduled, confirmed, in-progress, completed, cancelled, no-show)

attributes.name: appointment_time
attributes.description: Scheduled time of appointment

attributes.name: customer_concern
attributes.description: Customer-reported concern or issue

attributes.name: customer_name
attributes.description: Name of the customer

attributes.name: customer_phone
attributes.description: Customer phone number

attributes.name: drop_off_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when vehicle was dropped off

attributes.name: estimated_duration_hours
attributes.description: Estimated service duration in hours

attributes.name: home_service_flag
attributes.description: Whether this appointment is for mobile/home service delivery.

attributes.name: loaner_required_flag
attributes.description: Whether a loaner vehicle is needed

attributes.name: mileage_at_service
attributes.description: Vehicle mileage at time of service

attributes.name: pickup_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when vehicle was picked up

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: Type of service (maintenance, repair, recall, warranty)

products.name: dealer_repair_order
products.description: Detailed repair order (RO) record for each vehicle service event at a dealership. Captures RO number, open/close dates, VIN, mileage-in, complaint/cause/correction (3C), labor operations, technician assignments, parts consumed, warranty vs customer-pay vs internal split, total labor hours, total parts cost, and RO status. Core operational record for dealer service operations sourced from CDK Global DMS. This product is the single source of truth (SSOT) for its concept in the ECM Lakehouse.

attributes.name: dealer_repair_order_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the dealer_repair_order data product (auto-inserted pre-linking).

attributes.name: aftersales_repair_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to aftersales.repair_order. Business justification: Process: Dealer creates a repair order in DMS; it must reference the central aftersales repair order for warranty validation and labor costing.

attributes.name: connected_vehicle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mobility.connected_vehicle. Business justification: Repair Order Diagnostic Integration pulls live diagnostic data from the connected vehicle to streamline repair workflow.

attributes.name: maintenance_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.maintenance_order. Business justification: Dealer repair orders are executed using the plant's maintenance order system, enabling unified cost, warranty, and downtime analysis.

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.party. Business justification: Repair orders must be linked to the owning customer for warranty claim processing and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: technician_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Repair orders must record the technician performing work for warranty compliance and labor allocation.

attributes.name: vin_registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vehicle.vin_registry. Business justification: Repair orders must be tied to the VIN registry to manage warranty repairs and parts usage per vehicle.

attributes.name: cause_description
attributes.description: Diagnosed cause

attributes.name: close_date
attributes.description: Date repair order was closed

attributes.name: complaint_description
attributes.description: Customer complaint description

attributes.name: correction_description
attributes.description: Correction performed

attributes.name: labor_amount
attributes.description: Total labor charges

attributes.name: mileage
attributes.description: Vehicle mileage at time of repair

attributes.name: open_date
attributes.description: Date repair order was opened

attributes.name: parts_amount
attributes.description: Total parts charges

attributes.name: payment_type
attributes.description: Payment type (customer pay, warranty, internal, insurance)

attributes.name: pickup_delivery_flag
attributes.description: Whether vehicle pickup and delivery service is included.

attributes.name: ro_number
attributes.description: Repair order number

attributes.name: ro_status
attributes.description: Status (open, in-progress, parts-on-order, completed, invoiced)

attributes.name: total_amount
attributes.description: Total repair order amount

products.name: dealer_incentive_program
products.description: OEM-sponsored dealer incentive and bonus programs including volume bonuses, stair-step programs, customer satisfaction bonuses, EV adoption incentives, and floor plan assistance. Defines program name, type, eligible nameplates, MY, performance tiers, payout structure, measurement period, and eligibility criteria. Managed by OEM regional sales operations.

attributes.name: dealer_incentive_program_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the OEM-sponsored dealer incentive program record in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: announcement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the incentive program was formally announced to the dealer network via the dealer portal or official OEM communications. Precedes effective_start_date to allow dealer preparation.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee ID of the OEM finance or sales leadership authority who formally approved this incentive program. Required for SOX compliance and internal audit purposes.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the incentive program was formally approved by OEM finance and sales leadership, transitioning from draft to active status. Required for SOX compliance audit trail.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the incentive program record was first created in the OEM system of record (Salesforce Automotive Cloud or SAP S/4HANA). Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX per enterprise data standards.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this incentive program (e.g., USD, CAD, EUR, MXN). Supports multi-market OEM operations.

attributes.name: dealer_tier_eligibility
attributes.description: Specifies which dealer performance tier classification is eligible to participate in this program. Platinum/Gold/Silver/Bronze tiers are OEM-assigned based on prior-year sales volume and CSI scores. 'All' indicates no tier restriction.

attributes.name: dealer_type_eligibility
attributes.description: Restricts program participation to specific dealer ownership models: franchise dealers, OEM-owned stores, or independent dealers. 'All' applies to both OEM-owned and independent franchise dealer models.

attributes.name: dms_program_reference
attributes.description: The corresponding program identifier as recorded in CDK Global DMS used by dealer locations. Enables reconciliation between OEM master incentive records and dealer-side DMS reporting.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the incentive program measurement period closes and no further dealer performance accrual is accepted. Nullable for open-ended programs.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the incentive program becomes active and dealers begin accruing credit toward performance tiers. Aligns with the measurement period start.

attributes.name: eligible_dealer_count
attributes.description: Number of dealer locations determined to be eligible for participation in this incentive program at the time of program launch. Used for budget planning and program reach analysis by OEM sales operations.

attributes.name: eligible_nameplates
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of vehicle nameplates (brand/model lines) eligible for this incentive program (e.g., 'F-150|Mustang Mach-E|Explorer'). Null if program applies to all nameplates. Managed in Salesforce Automotive Cloud vehicle catalog.

attributes.name: eligible_powertrain_types
attributes.description: Powertrain technology types eligible for this program. ICE (Internal Combustion Engine), EV (Electric Vehicle), HEV (Hybrid Electric Vehicle), PHEV (Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle), or all. Critical for EV adoption incentive programs aligned with CAFE and EPA compliance targets.

attributes.name: floor_plan_rate_pct
attributes.description: For floor plan assistance programs, the percentage of dealer inventory financing cost subsidized by the OEM. Expressed as an annual percentage rate (APR) subsidy. Null for non-floor-plan program types.

attributes.name: home_delivery_bonus_flag
attributes.description: Whether this incentive program includes home delivery bonuses.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the incentive program record in the source system. Used for incremental data pipeline processing and audit trail in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: max_payout_amount
attributes.description: The maximum total monetary payout a single dealer can earn under this incentive program during the measurement period. Acts as a cap to control OEM financial exposure. Null if no cap is defined.

attributes.name: measurement_period_type
attributes.description: Defines the cadence over which dealer performance is measured for incentive qualification. Monthly and quarterly are most common for volume bonuses; annual for loyalty programs; custom for special campaigns.

attributes.name: min_dealer_tenure_months
attributes.description: Minimum number of months a dealer must have been an active franchisee to be eligible for this program. Ensures new dealers meet a baseline operational maturity requirement.

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: The vehicle Model Year (MY) to which this incentive program applies. Restricts eligible vehicles to a specific MY production cycle (e.g., MY2024, MY2025). Null if program applies across all model years.

attributes.name: oem_program_sponsor
attributes.description: Name or organizational unit of the OEM department sponsoring and funding this incentive program (e.g., 'North America Sales Operations', 'EV Business Unit', 'Truck Division'). Used for internal cost allocation.

attributes.name: payout_date
attributes.description: Scheduled calendar date on which OEM processes and disburses earned incentive payments to qualifying dealers. May differ from effective_end_date due to reconciliation periods.

attributes.name: payout_structure_type
attributes.description: Defines how the incentive payout is calculated. Flat bonus: fixed dollar amount per tier. Per unit: dollar amount multiplied by units sold. Percentage of MSRP (Manufacturer Suggested Retail Price): payout as a percentage of vehicle MSRP. Percentage of invoice: payout as a percentage of dealer invoice price.

attributes.name: performance_metric
attributes.description: The primary KPI used to measure dealer performance for this incentive program. Units sold for volume bonuses; NPS (Net Promoter Score) or CSAT score for satisfaction bonuses; EV units sold for EV adoption programs; PDI (Pre-Delivery Inspection) compliance rate for quality programs. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: units_sold|nps_score|csat_score|ev_units_sold|market_share_pct|pdi_compliance_rate|revenue|floor_plan_days — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: program_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code assigned by OEM regional sales operations to uniquely identify the incentive program across systems including Salesforce Automotive Cloud and CDK Global DMS.

attributes.name: program_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the program objectives, eligibility rules, and payout mechanics as communicated to the dealer network. Sourced from OEM regional sales operations documentation.

attributes.name: program_manager_name
attributes.description: Full name of the OEM regional sales operations manager responsible for administering this incentive program. Used for dealer escalation and program governance.

attributes.name: program_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the dealer incentive program (e.g., 'Q3 2024 EV Adoption Bonus', 'Stair-Step Volume Bonus – Truck MY2024'). Used in dealer communications and DMS reporting.

attributes.name: program_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the incentive program. Draft: under design by OEM regional sales ops. Active: open for dealer participation and accrual. Suspended: temporarily paused. Closed: measurement period ended, payouts being processed. Cancelled: terminated before completion.

attributes.name: program_type
attributes.description: Classification of the incentive program structure. Volume bonus rewards unit sales thresholds; stair-step provides escalating payouts per tier; CSAT bonus rewards customer satisfaction scores; EV adoption incentivizes electric vehicle sales; floor plan assistance subsidizes dealer inventory financing costs; market representation rewards geographic coverage. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: volume_bonus|stair_step|csat_bonus|ev_adoption|floor_plan_assistance|market_representation|loyalty_retention|conquest — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: OEM-defined regional sales territory code identifying the geographic scope of the incentive program (e.g., 'NE', 'SE', 'MW', 'SW', 'W', 'NATIONAL'). Managed by OEM regional sales operations.

attributes.name: requires_pdi_compliance
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dealer must maintain a minimum PDI (Pre-Delivery Inspection) compliance rate as a prerequisite for incentive eligibility. True enforces PDI compliance gating; False means PDI compliance is not a condition.

attributes.name: requires_training_certification
attributes.description: Indicates whether dealer sales or service staff must hold current OEM-mandated training certifications (e.g., EV product training, ADAS certification) as an eligibility prerequisite for this program.

attributes.name: retroactive_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the stair-step payout structure applies retroactively to all units sold once a higher tier is achieved (True), or only incrementally to units sold above each threshold (False). Critical for stair-step program financial modeling.

attributes.name: salesforce_program_reference
attributes.description: The Salesforce Automotive Cloud record ID for this incentive program. Enables bi-directional synchronization between the Databricks Silver Layer and Salesforce CRM for dealer portal visibility.

attributes.name: stackable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this incentive program can be combined (stacked) with other concurrent OEM incentive programs for the same dealer and vehicle. True allows stacking; False means the program is mutually exclusive with other programs.

attributes.name: terms_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the program terms and conditions document (e.g., 'v1.0', 'v2.1'). Tracks amendments to program rules and ensures dealers are evaluated against the correct version of terms.

attributes.name: tier1_payout_amount
attributes.description: Monetary payout amount (in program currency) awarded to dealers achieving Tier 1 performance threshold. May represent a flat bonus or per-unit amount depending on payout_structure_type.

attributes.name: tier1_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum performance metric value a dealer must achieve to qualify for Tier 1 (entry-level) payout. Units depend on performance_metric (e.g., number of vehicles sold, NPS score points).

attributes.name: tier2_payout_amount
attributes.description: Monetary payout amount (in program currency) awarded to dealers achieving Tier 2 performance threshold. Null if program has fewer than 2 tiers.

attributes.name: tier2_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum performance metric value a dealer must achieve to qualify for Tier 2 payout. Must be greater than tier1_threshold. Null if program has fewer than 2 tiers.

attributes.name: tier3_payout_amount
attributes.description: Monetary payout amount (in program currency) awarded to dealers achieving Tier 3 performance threshold. Null if program has fewer than 3 tiers.

attributes.name: tier3_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum performance metric value a dealer must achieve to qualify for Tier 3 payout. Must be greater than tier2_threshold. Null if program has fewer than 3 tiers.

attributes.name: tier_count
attributes.description: Number of performance tiers defined within this incentive program (e.g., 3 for Bronze/Silver/Gold, 5 for stair-step programs). Determines the granularity of the payout structure.

attributes.name: total_program_budget
attributes.description: Total OEM-allocated budget for this incentive program across all participating dealers. Used by OEM regional sales operations for financial planning and CapEx/OpEx tracking in SAP S/4HANA CO.

products.name: dealer_incentive_claim
products.description: Individual dealer claims submitted against OEM incentive programs. Tracks claim submission date, program, claim period, claimed units or metric, supporting evidence, claim status (submitted, under review, approved, rejected, paid), approved amount, and payment reference. Integrates with SAP FI for payout processing.

attributes.name: dealer_incentive_claim_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each dealer incentive claim record. Primary key for the incentive_claim data product.

attributes.name: dealer_incentive_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the OEM incentive program against which this claim is submitted. Links to the incentive program master record.

attributes.name: primary_dealer_dealership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealer submitting this incentive claim. Links to the dealer master record in the dealer domain.

attributes.name: reviewer_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier of the OEM staff member who reviewed and approved or rejected the claim. Supports audit trail, segregation of duties compliance, and workload reporting for the dealer incentive operations team.

attributes.name: accrual_posted
attributes.description: Indicates whether a financial accrual has been posted in SAP FI for this incentive claim liability. True = accrual posted; False = accrual not yet posted. Used for period-end financial close management and EBITDA reporting accuracy.

attributes.name: adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Net monetary adjustment applied by the OEM during claim review, representing the difference between claimed_amount and approved_amount. A negative value indicates a reduction; positive indicates an upward correction. Supports audit trail and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: adjustment_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why the approved_amount differs from the claimed_amount. Populated by the OEM reviewer when an adjustment is applied. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ineligible_units|duplicate_claim|missing_evidence|calculation_error|program_cap_exceeded|other — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: approved_amount
attributes.description: Monetary amount approved by the OEM after review and validation of the dealer's claim. May differ from claimed_amount due to adjustments, disallowed units, or partial approvals. This is the amount committed for payment processing in SAP FI.

attributes.name: approved_units
attributes.description: Number of vehicle units or qualifying transactions validated and approved by the OEM reviewer. May be less than claimed_units if some units are found ineligible during audit. Used to calculate the approved_amount for volume-based programs.

attributes.name: claim_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable unique claim reference number assigned at submission. Used by dealers and OEM finance teams to track and reference the claim across systems including CDK Global DMS and SAP FI.

attributes.name: claim_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the performance or sales period covered by this incentive claim. Defines the close of the measurement window. Together with claim_period_start_date, establishes the claim period boundary for audit and reconciliation.

attributes.name: claim_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the performance or sales period covered by this incentive claim. Defines the beginning of the measurement window for which the dealer is claiming the incentive.

attributes.name: claim_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the incentive claim through the OEM review and payment lifecycle. Valid states: submitted (initial dealer submission), under_review (OEM audit in progress), approved (claim validated and approved for payment), rejected (claim denied), paid (payment disbursed via SAP FI), cancelled (withdrawn by dealer or voided by OEM).

attributes.name: claim_type
attributes.description: Category of incentive claim being submitted, reflecting the nature of the OEM incentive program. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: volume_bonus|retail_incentive|floor_plan|marketing_support|customer_satisfaction|parts_sales|service_absorption — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: claimed_amount
attributes.description: Gross monetary amount claimed by the dealer against the incentive program, expressed in the transaction currency. This is the dealer-submitted figure prior to OEM review and approval. Used for financial accrual and liability estimation.

attributes.name: claimed_metric_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the claimed_metric_value field, indicating how the performance metric is expressed (e.g., units for vehicle count, percentage for service absorption rate, score for NPS/CSI, amount for revenue-based claims).

attributes.name: claimed_metric_value
attributes.description: The quantitative performance metric value being claimed by the dealer, applicable for non-unit-based programs such as customer satisfaction scores (NPS), service absorption rates, or parts sales amounts. Complements claimed_units for metric-driven incentive types.

attributes.name: claimed_units
attributes.description: Number of vehicle units or qualifying transactions the dealer is claiming against the incentive program for the claim period. Applicable for volume-based incentive programs such as volume bonus and retail incentive programs.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: SAP CO cost center code to which the incentive payout is charged. Used for internal cost allocation and management accounting of dealer incentive expenditure by brand, region, or program type.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the market in which the dealer operates and the claim is filed. Supports multi-market OEM operations and ensures correct regulatory and tax treatment of incentive payouts.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the incentive claim record was first created in the system. Represents the audit creation time (distinct from submission_date which is the business event date). Used for data lineage, audit trail, and Silver layer ingestion tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this claim (claimed_amount, approved_amount, paid_amount). Supports multi-currency dealer networks operating in different markets.

attributes.name: dealer_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the dealer representative responsible for this claim. Used for claim status notifications, evidence requests, and dispute correspondence. Classified as confidential PII per GDPR and applicable privacy regulations.

attributes.name: dealer_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the dealer-side representative who submitted or is responsible for this incentive claim. Used for communication, follow-up, and audit correspondence between OEM and dealer.

attributes.name: delivery_type
attributes.description: Type of delivery associated with this incentive claim.

attributes.name: dispute_date
attributes.description: Date on which the dealer formally raised a dispute against the OEM's claim decision. Populated only when dispute_flag is True. Used to track dispute aging and compliance with contractual dispute resolution timelines.

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dealer has formally disputed the OEM's decision on this claim (e.g., disputed rejection or adjusted amount). True = claim is under dispute; False = no dispute raised. Triggers escalation workflow in Salesforce Automotive Cloud.

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting the outcome and resolution of a dealer dispute on this claim. Captures the agreed resolution, any revised approved amount, and the basis for the final decision. Supports audit trail and dealer relationship management.

attributes.name: dms_claim_reference
attributes.description: Claim reference number as recorded in the dealer's CDK Global DMS system. Enables cross-system reconciliation between the OEM's incentive claim record and the dealer's own DMS records. Critical for audit and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: evidence_document_ref
attributes.description: Reference identifier or URL pointing to the supporting evidence package submitted by the dealer with the claim (e.g., sales invoices, PDI records, customer satisfaction survey results, parts purchase orders). Stored in the document management system linked from CDK Global DMS or Salesforce Automotive Cloud.

attributes.name: evidence_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the OEM reviewer has verified the supporting evidence submitted with the claim. True = evidence reviewed and confirmed valid; False = evidence not yet verified or found insufficient. Used to gate claim approval workflow.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: SAP FI general ledger account code used to classify the incentive payout for financial reporting. Ensures correct P&L treatment of dealer incentive costs in accordance with IFRS 15 and OEM chart of accounts.

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: The vehicle model year (MY) associated with the units or transactions being claimed. Used to align incentive claims with specific model year programs and OEM production cycles (e.g., MY2024, MY2025).

attributes.name: paid_amount
attributes.description: Actual monetary amount disbursed to the dealer for this claim. May differ from approved_amount due to netting, offsets, or partial payment arrangements. Populated upon payment confirmation from SAP FI.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the approved incentive amount was disbursed to the dealer's bank account. Populated upon payment confirmation from SAP FI. Used for cash flow reporting and dealer payment aging analysis.

attributes.name: payment_reference
attributes.description: SAP FI payment document number or bank transfer reference assigned when the approved claim is paid. Links the incentive claim to the corresponding financial transaction in SAP FI Accounts Payable for reconciliation and audit.

attributes.name: powertrain_type
attributes.description: Powertrain technology category of the vehicles covered by this claim. Values: ICE (Internal Combustion Engine), HEV (Hybrid Electric Vehicle), PHEV (Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle), EV (Electric Vehicle), FCEV (Fuel Cell Electric Vehicle). Used to track EV/electrification incentive program uptake and CAFE compliance reporting.

attributes.name: program_quarter
attributes.description: Fiscal quarter of the OEM incentive program period covered by this claim (Q1–Q4). Used for quarterly accrual reporting, dealer performance benchmarking, and incentive budget variance analysis.

attributes.name: program_year
