attributes.description: Fiscal or calendar year of the OEM incentive program under which this claim is filed. Used to segregate claims by annual program cycle for budget tracking, accrual management, and year-end financial close in SAP FI.

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: OEM sales region or zone code to which the submitting dealer belongs. Used for regional incentive program management, territory-based performance benchmarking, and regional finance reporting.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded explanation provided by the OEM reviewer when a claim is rejected (claim_status = rejected). Documents the specific grounds for denial to support dealer dispute resolution and compliance with IATF 16949 dealer management requirements.

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the OEM completed the review of the incentive claim and updated the claim_status to approved or rejected. Used for SLA tracking of claim processing turnaround time.

attributes.name: sap_fi_document_number
attributes.description: SAP FI accounting document number generated when the incentive claim liability or payment is posted in the general ledger. Provides direct traceability between the incentive claim and the SAP FI financial posting for audit and reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the dealer formally submitted the incentive claim to the OEM. This is the principal business event date for the claim lifecycle and is used for period-end cut-off and aging analysis.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the incentive claim record. Tracks the last modification for change data capture (CDC), audit trail, and Silver layer incremental processing in the Databricks Lakehouse.

attributes.name: vehicle_line_code
attributes.description: OEM product line or nameplate code identifying the vehicle model family associated with this claim (e.g., F-150, Silverado, Model 3). Used to segment incentive claims by vehicle line for program performance analysis and brand-level reporting.

products.name: performance_scorecard
products.description: Periodic (monthly/quarterly) dealer performance scorecard capturing KPIs across sales, service, parts, customer satisfaction, and facility standards. attributes.name: delivery_satisfaction_score

attributes.name: facility_standards_score
attributes.description: The score measuring dealer compliance with OEM facility image and standards requirements (showroom, service bays, signage, etc.).

attributes.name: fiscal_year

attributes.name: franchise_compliance_status

attributes.name: incentive_eligibility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dealer met the minimum performance thresholds to qualify for OEM incentive programs during this scorecard period.

attributes.name: inventory_turn_rate

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: market_share_pct

attributes.name: new_vehicle_sales_actual

attributes.name: new_vehicle_sales_attainment_pct

attributes.name: new_vehicle_sales_objective

attributes.name: nps_benchmark

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: The Net Promoter Score measuring customer loyalty and likelihood to recommend the dealer, calculated as percentage of promoters minus percentage of detractors.

attributes.name: parts_fill_rate_pct
attributes.description: The percentage of parts orders fulfilled from dealer inventory without backorder during the scorecard period.

attributes.name: parts_revenue_actual

attributes.name: performance_tier

attributes.name: period_type
attributes.description: The frequency of the scorecard evaluation period.

attributes.name: published_date

attributes.name: reviewer_name

attributes.name: scorecard_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last day of the evaluation period covered by this scorecard.

attributes.name: scorecard_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first day of the evaluation period covered by this scorecard (monthly or quarterly).

attributes.name: scorecard_status

attributes.name: service_absorption_rate_pct
attributes.description: The percentage of fixed operations expenses covered by service and parts gross profit, a key profitability metric for dealer operations.

attributes.name: service_revenue_objective

attributes.name: training_compliance_pct

attributes.description: The percentage of warranty claims submitted by the dealer that were approved by the OEM during the scorecard period.

products.name: floor_plan
products.description: Dealer vehicle floor plan financing records tracking the financing of new vehicle inventory. Captures financing institution, credit line amount, outstanding balance, per-unit floor plan cost, curtailment schedule, aged inventory flags, and floor plan audit dates. attributes.name: floor_plan_id

attributes.description: Total credit line amount approved by the financing institution for the dealer's floor plan facility. Represents the maximum borrowing capacity.

attributes.description: Number of days the vehicle has been in dealer inventory under floor plan financing, calculated from financing start date to current date or sale date.

attributes.description: Original dealer invoice amount for the vehicle, typically the basis for the floor plan financed amount.

attributes.name: default_date

attributes.name: financing_end_date

attributes.name: financing_institution_name

attributes.name: financing_start_date

attributes.description: Annual interest rate percentage charged by the financing institution on the outstanding floor plan balance for this vehicle.

attributes.description: Date of the most recent floor plan audit conducted by the financing institution or OEM to verify physical inventory and compliance with financing terms.

attributes.name: msrp_amount
attributes.description: Manufacturer Suggested Retail Price for the financed vehicle. Used for margin analysis and dealer financial health assessment.

attributes.name: next_audit_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next floor plan audit. Used for audit planning and dealer notification.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or special circumstances related to this floor plan financing record (e.g., audit exceptions, payment arrangements, OEM approvals).

attributes.name: oem_assistance_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of OEM assistance provided for this floor plan record, such as interest rate buy-down or direct payment subsidy.

attributes.name: oem_assistance_program_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) Assistance Program Code

attributes.description: Total amount paid to the financing institution to settle the floor plan obligation for this vehicle, including principal and accrued interest.

attributes.description: Date when the floor plan financing for this vehicle was fully paid off, typically upon retail sale or dealer buyout.

attributes.name: per_unit_floor_plan_cost
attributes.description: The financed amount for this individual vehicle unit, typically equal to dealer invoice or a percentage thereof. Basis for interest calculation.

attributes.description: SAP financial document number associated with the floor plan financing transaction in the OEM's ERP system (SAP S/4HANA FI module).

attributes.name: total_interest_paid
attributes.description: Cumulative interest amount paid to the financing institution over the life of the floor plan financing for this vehicle unit.

attributes.description: Timestamp when this floor plan financing record was last modified. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: dms_integration_log_id

attributes.name: business_impact_severity

attributes.name: dms_version

attributes.name: encryption_protocol

attributes.name: error_category

attributes.name: error_message

attributes.name: integration_batch_reference
attributes.description: Unique batch identifier assigned to group related synchronization events. Used to correlate multiple sync operations within a single integration cycle.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: max_retry_attempts

attributes.name: next_retry_timestamp

attributes.name: oem_transaction_reference

attributes.name: payload_size_kb

attributes.name: region_code

attributes.name: resolution_notes

attributes.name: resolution_timestamp

attributes.name: retry_attempt_number

attributes.name: sla_compliance_flag

attributes.name: sla_target_duration_seconds

attributes.name: sync_status

products.name: facility_standard

attributes.description: Identifier of the customer who owns the vehicle being appraised for trade-in or sale.

attributes.name: appraisal_date

attributes.name: appraisal_number

domains.name: aftersales
domains.description: Post-sale customer support including warranty management, service campaigns, recall execution, and parts distribution. Manages service appointments, repair orders, TSB (Technical Service Bulletin) distribution, DTC (Diagnostic Trouble Code) analysis, and labor time standards. Tracks warranty claims, parts consumption, service revenue, and customer retention. Includes field service operations and authorized service center network management. Integrates with CDK Global DMS and OBD (On-Board Diagnostics) systems.

products.name: feature_content
products.description: Defines the commercial feature content associated with a trim level or option package — the consumer-facing feature descriptions used in marketing, window stickers, and configurators. Captures feature code, feature name, feature category (safety/technology/comfort/performance/exterior/interior), feature description, standard vs. optional flag, ADAS (Advanced Driver Assistance Systems) classification flag, EV/HEV-specific flag, regulatory-mandated flag, and content source system reference. Bridges the commercial product catalog to consumer-facing communications.

attributes.name: feature_content_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the feature content record. Primary key.

attributes.name: aftersales_trim_level_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.trim_level. Business justification: Feature content is defined per trim level; linking provides a proper hierarchy and removes any need for duplicate trim identifiers in feature_content.

attributes.name: design_specification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.design_specification. Business justification: Feature‑to‑Design traceability matrix requires linking each product feature to its engineering design specification for validation and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this feature content record was approved for publication. Used for audit trail and compliance verification.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the product manager or marketing manager who approved this feature content for publication. Used for accountability and content governance.

attributes.name: availability_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the feature is included as standard equipment, available as a standalone option, only available within a package, or not available for a given trim or market.

attributes.name: content_source_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this feature content record in the source system, used for traceability and data lineage.

attributes.name: content_source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system from which this feature content record originates, such as PLM (Product Lifecycle Management), PIM (Product Information Management), or marketing content management system.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this feature content record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: customer_demand_score
attributes.description: Quantitative score (0-100) representing customer demand or take-rate for this feature based on market research, configurator analytics, and sales data. Used for product planning and inventory optimization.

attributes.name: dealer_cost_impact_amount
attributes.description: The incremental dealer invoice cost when this feature is included. Used for dealer margin calculations and incentive program design.

attributes.name: ecu_dependency_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this feature requires specific ECU (Electronic Control Unit) hardware or software configuration. Used for manufacturing planning and service diagnostics.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date when this feature content record is no longer effective. Null if the record is currently active with no planned end date.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date when this feature content record becomes effective and available for use in configurators, ordering systems, and marketing materials.

attributes.name: feature_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the feature grouping for marketing segmentation and consumer navigation. Categories align with consumer decision-making patterns.

attributes.name: feature_code
attributes.description: Standardized alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the feature within the product catalog system. Used for cross-system integration and configurator mapping.

attributes.name: feature_description_long
attributes.description: Comprehensive consumer-facing description of the feature including benefits, technical highlights, and usage scenarios. Used in brochures, website detail pages, and dealer training materials.

attributes.name: feature_description_short
attributes.description: Brief consumer-facing description of the feature, typically 50-100 characters, used in configurator tooltips and mobile applications.

attributes.name: feature_name
attributes.description: Consumer-facing marketing name of the feature as displayed in brochures, window stickers, and online configurators.

attributes.name: feature_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the feature content record. Active features are available for configuration; discontinued features are retained for historical reference; pending features are awaiting approval; under_review features are being evaluated for changes.

attributes.name: feature_subcategory
attributes.description: Detailed sub-classification within the feature category for granular filtering and reporting (e.g., within safety: active safety, passive safety, driver assistance).

attributes.name: field_service_info
attributes.description: Field service related information, consolidating field service concepts.

attributes.name: fuel_economy_impact_percent
attributes.description: The estimated percentage impact on fuel economy (positive or negative) when this feature is included. Used for EPA fuel economy label calculations and CAFE compliance.

attributes.name: installation_time_minutes
attributes.description: Standard time in minutes required to install this feature on the production line. Used for manufacturing capacity planning and line balancing in MES (Manufacturing Execution System).

attributes.name: is_adas_feature
attributes.business_glossary_term: Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) Feature Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this feature is classified as an ADAS (Advanced Driver Assistance Systems) technology, such as adaptive cruise control, lane keeping assist, or automated emergency braking.

tag_set.value: Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) Feature Flag

attributes.name: is_ev_specific
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this feature is specific to electric vehicle (EV) or plug-in hybrid electric vehicle (PHEV) powertrains, such as regenerative braking display, charging port, or battery thermal management.

attributes.name: is_hev_specific
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hybrid Electric Vehicle (HEV) Specific Feature Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this feature is specific to hybrid electric vehicle (HEV) powertrains, such as hybrid system display, EV mode selector, or hybrid battery cooling.

tag_set.value: Hybrid Electric Vehicle (HEV) Specific Feature Flag

attributes.name: is_regulatory_mandated
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this feature is mandated by regulatory requirements such as NHTSA Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standards (FMVSS), EPA emissions standards, or regional safety regulations (e.g., backup camera, tire pressure monitoring system).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this feature content record was last modified. Used for change tracking and synchronization with downstream systems.

attributes.name: market_availability_region
attributes.description: Geographic region or market where this feature is available, using standardized region codes (e.g., NAM for North America, EUR for Europe, CHN for China). Multiple regions may be pipe-separated.

attributes.name: marketing_priority_rank
attributes.description: Numerical ranking indicating the marketing priority of this feature for promotional campaigns and sales emphasis. Lower numbers indicate higher priority.

attributes.name: model_year_discontinued
attributes.description: The model year (MY) when this feature was discontinued or phased out. Null if the feature is still active in the current lineup.

attributes.name: model_year_introduced
attributes.description: The model year (MY) when this feature was first introduced into the product lineup. Used for product evolution tracking and historical analysis.

attributes.name: msrp_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the MSRP impact amount (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY).

attributes.name: msrp_impact_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Manufacturer Suggested Retail Price (MSRP) Impact Amount
attributes.description: The incremental MSRP (Manufacturer Suggested Retail Price) value added when this feature is included as an option. Zero for standard features. Used for pricing calculations and configurator display.

tag_set.value: Manufacturer Suggested Retail Price (MSRP) Impact Amount

attributes.name: ota_updateable_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this feature can be enabled, updated, or modified via OTA (Over-the-Air) software updates post-production.

attributes.name: regulatory_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the specific regulatory standard or requirement that mandates this feature, such as FMVSS number, EPA regulation code, or Euro NCAP protocol. Populated only when is_regulatory_mandated is true.

attributes.name: safety_rating_impact
attributes.description: Indicates the level of impact this feature has on vehicle safety ratings such as NCAP (New Car Assessment Programme) star ratings or IIHS Top Safety Pick awards.

attributes.name: supplier_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary supplier or OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) partner providing the component or system that delivers this feature. Used for supply chain traceability and warranty management.

attributes.name: technology_level
attributes.description: Classification of the feature's technology sophistication level, used for market positioning and trim-level differentiation strategies.

attributes.name: warranty_extension_months
attributes.description: Number of additional warranty months provided specifically for this feature beyond the base vehicle warranty. Zero if no extension applies.

attributes.name: weight_impact_kg
attributes.description: The incremental vehicle weight in kilograms added by this feature. Used for CAFE (Corporate Average Fuel Economy) calculations, performance modeling, and engineering analysis.

products.name: program_milestone
products.description: Tracks key program milestones and gate reviews for each MY program (e.g., Program Approval, Design Freeze, PPAP completion, SOP, Job 1, EOP). Captures milestone type, planned date, actual date, milestone status (pending/achieved/delayed/waived), responsible function, gate review outcome, and variance days. Enables program management tracking, cross-functional alignment, and executive reporting on program health.
products.reference: Program Gate / APQP Milestone (APQP Phase Gate)

attributes.name: program_milestone_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the program milestone record. Primary key for the program milestone entity.

attributes.name: aftersales_model_year_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent MY (Model Year) program to which this milestone belongs. Links to the program master entity.

attributes.name: nameplate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vehicle nameplate (brand/model) associated with this program milestone. Links to nameplate master data in the product domain.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant where this milestone applies. Relevant for production-related milestones (SOP, Job 1, EOP). Null for program-level milestones. Links to plant master data.

attributes.name: predecessor_milestone_program_milestone_id
attributes.description: Reference to the immediately preceding milestone that must be achieved before this milestone can begin. Null for the first milestone in the program sequence. Enables critical path analysis.

attributes.name: program_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or program manager accountable for delivering this milestone. Links to workforce/employee master data.

attributes.name: program_responsible_person_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or program manager accountable for delivering this milestone. Links to workforce/employee master data.

attributes.name: actual_date
attributes.description: Actual date the milestone was achieved. Populated when milestone_status transitions to achieved. Used for variance analysis and lessons learned.

attributes.name: baseline_date
attributes.description: Approved baseline date after program approval or re-baseline. Used as the official target for performance measurement and variance calculation.

attributes.name: budget_impact_amount
attributes.description: Estimated financial impact (in base currency) if this milestone is delayed. Used for prioritization and executive escalation. Null if no quantified impact.

attributes.name: completion_percentage
attributes.description: Estimated percentage of work completed toward achieving this milestone (0.00 to 100.00). Updated during program reviews. 100.00 when milestone_status is achieved.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this milestone record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage.

attributes.name: critical_path_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this milestone is on the program critical path. True if any delay to this milestone will delay the overall program SOP date. Used for prioritization and risk management.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for budget_impact_amount (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY). Null if budget_impact_amount is null.

attributes.name: deliverable_completed_count
attributes.description: Number of deliverables that have been completed and approved. Used to calculate completion_percentage and assess readiness for gate review.

attributes.name: deliverable_count
attributes.description: Number of formal deliverables (documents, approvals, test results) required to achieve this milestone. Used to track completion progress.

attributes.name: external_dependency_description
attributes.description: Description of external dependencies, including supplier names, partner organizations, or regulatory agencies. Null if external_dependency_flag is false.

attributes.name: external_dependency_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this milestone depends on external parties (suppliers, partners, regulatory agencies) for completion. True if external coordination required, false if fully internal.

attributes.name: field_service_info
attributes.description: Field service related information, consolidating field service concepts.

attributes.name: forecast_date
attributes.description: Current forecast date for milestone achievement based on latest program status. Updated regularly during program reviews. Null if milestone already achieved.

attributes.name: gate_review_comments
attributes.description: Executive comments, conditions, or action items resulting from the gate review meeting. Captures key decisions and follow-up requirements.

attributes.name: gate_review_date
attributes.description: Date the formal gate review meeting was held. Null if gate_review_required is false or review not yet conducted.

attributes.name: gate_review_outcome
attributes.description: Result of the formal gate review meeting: approved (proceed to next phase), approved_with_conditions (proceed with action items), deferred (reschedule review), rejected (do not proceed). Null if gate_review_required is false or review not yet held.

attributes.name: gate_review_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal gate review (executive approval meeting) is required before this milestone can be marked as achieved. True for major program gates (e.g., Program Approval, SOP), false for intermediate checkpoints.

attributes.name: milestone_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the milestone type (e.g., PROG_APPR, DESIGN_FREEZE, PPAP_COMP, SOP, JOB1, EOP). Used for system integration and reporting.

attributes.name: milestone_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the milestone (e.g., Program Approval, Design Freeze, PPAP Completion, Start of Production, Job 1, End of Production).

attributes.name: milestone_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the milestone: pending (not started), in_progress (activities underway), achieved (completed on time), delayed (missed target), waived (skipped by exception), cancelled (no longer required).

attributes.name: milestone_type
attributes.description: Classification of the milestone by functional category: program_gate (strategic approval), design_gate (engineering freeze), quality_gate (PPAP/APQP), production_gate (SOP/EOP), regulatory_gate (homologation), commercial_gate (launch readiness).

attributes.name: mitigation_plan
attributes.description: Action plan to address identified risks and recover schedule. Includes specific actions, owners, and target dates. Null if risk_level is low.

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: Model Year for which this program milestone applies (e.g., 2024, 2025). Aligns with automotive industry MY planning cycles.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or system account that last modified this milestone record. Audit trail for data governance.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this milestone record was last updated. Audit trail for change tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, context, or historical information about this milestone. Free-text field for program team collaboration.

attributes.name: planned_date
attributes.description: Originally planned target date for achieving this milestone, as defined in the program master schedule. Baseline for variance tracking.

attributes.name: program_phase
attributes.description: High-level program phase in which this milestone occurs: concept (initial planning), design (engineering), development (prototyping), validation (testing/PPAP), launch (SOP/Job 1), production (volume ramp), end_of_life (EOP). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: concept|design|development|validation|launch|production|end_of_life — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: regulatory_body
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory authority or governing body requiring this milestone (e.g., NHTSA, EPA, Euro NCAP, CARB, UNECE). Null if regulatory_requirement_flag is false.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this milestone is driven by regulatory or homologation requirements (e.g., NHTSA, EPA, Euro NCAP, WLTP certification). True for regulatory gates, false for internal program milestones.

attributes.name: responsible_function
attributes.description: Primary functional organization accountable for achieving this milestone: engineering (design/CAE), manufacturing (plant readiness), quality (PPAP/APQP), supply_chain (supplier readiness), regulatory (homologation), commercial (launch), program_management (gate reviews). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: engineering|manufacturing|quality|supply_chain|regulatory|commercial|program_management — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: risk_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of risks, issues, or blockers that may prevent timely achievement of this milestone. Updated during program status reviews.

attributes.name: risk_level
attributes.description: Current risk assessment for achieving this milestone on time: low (on track, no issues), medium (minor concerns), high (significant risk of delay), critical (delay highly likely or already occurred).

attributes.name: variance_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days between baseline_date and actual_date. Positive values indicate delay, negative values indicate early completion. Null if milestone not yet achieved.

attributes.name: waiver_approved_by
attributes.description: Reference to the executive who approved the milestone waiver. Links to workforce/employee master data. Null if milestone not waived.

attributes.name: waiver_approved_date
attributes.description: Date the milestone waiver was formally approved. Null if milestone not waived.

attributes.name: waiver_reason
attributes.description: Business justification for waiving this milestone. Populated when milestone_status is set to waived. Requires executive approval.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or system account that created this milestone record. Audit trail for data governance.

products.name: product_engineering_change
products.description: Commercial product domain record of engineering changes (ECNs/ECOs) that impact the commercial product catalog — affecting BOM structures, SKU configurations, option availability, or MSRP pricing. Captures change request number, change type (cost reduction/quality improvement/regulatory/customer-driven), affected SKUs and BOM lines, effective MY and date, commercial impact assessment (price change/feature change/availability change), approval status, and Teamcenter PLM reference. Distinct from the engineering domain's full ECN lifecycle — this is the commercial impact view.
products.reference: ECN / ECO (Siemens Teamcenter Engineering Change / SAP PLM)

attributes.name: product_engineering_change_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the product_engineering_change data product (auto-inserted pre-linking).

attributes.name: aftersales_model_year_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.model_year_program. Business justification: Engineering changes are scoped to a model year program; linking provides traceability and prevents orphan change records.

attributes.name: engineer_employee_id

attributes.name: nameplate_id

attributes.name: affected_part_numbers

attributes.name: change_description

attributes.name: change_type

attributes.name: product_engineering_change_description
attributes.description: Description of the entity

attributes.name: effective_date

attributes.name: field_service_info

attributes.name: implementation_cost_estimate

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority classification of the change (critical, high, medium, low) indicating urgency of implementation

attributes.name: reason_for_change

attributes.name: service_impact

attributes.name: product_engineering_change_status

attributes.name: superseded_part_number

products.name: option_constraint
products.description: Defines the business rules governing option and package compatibility — which options require, exclude, or are included with other options on a given trim level and MY. Captures constraint type (requires/excludes/includes/upgrades), source option/package, target option/package, applicable trim levels, applicable markets, effective date range, and constraint priority. Enforces valid vehicle configurations in dealer ordering systems and consumer configurators, preventing invalid build combinations.
products.reference: Option Constraint / Configuration Rule (SAP SD / Configurator Rules)

attributes.name: option_constraint_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the option constraint rule. Primary key.

attributes.name: aftersales_option_package_id
attributes.description: Reference to the option or package that triggers this constraint rule. The 'if' side of the constraint logic.

attributes.name: aftersales_trim_level_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific trim level to which this constraint applies. Nullable if constraint applies across all trims for the nameplate/MY.

attributes.name: nameplate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vehicle nameplate (brand/model family) to which this constraint applies.

attributes.name: primary_aftersales_option_package_id
attributes.description: Reference to the option or package that triggers this constraint rule. The 'if' side of the constraint logic.

attributes.name: target_option_aftersales_option_package_id
attributes.description: Reference to the option or package that is affected by this constraint rule. The 'then' side of the constraint logic.

attributes.name: target_option_option_package_aftersales_option_package_id
attributes.description: Reference to the option or package that is affected by this constraint rule. The 'then' side of the constraint logic.

attributes.name: applies_to_fleet
attributes.description: Indicates whether this constraint applies to fleet orders. Some constraints are relaxed or different for high-volume fleet customers.

attributes.name: applies_to_retail
attributes.description: Indicates whether this constraint applies to retail customer orders through dealer networks.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Workflow approval status for this constraint rule. Only approved constraints are activated in production ordering systems.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this constraint rule was approved for production use.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the product manager or engineering lead who approved this constraint for production use.

attributes.name: bom_impact
attributes.description: Indicates the severity of Bill of Materials changes triggered by this constraint. Critical impacts may require PPAP or APQP review.

attributes.name: change_request_number
attributes.description: Reference to the Engineering Change Request or Product Change Notice that authorized the creation or modification of this constraint.

attributes.name: configurator_display_order
attributes.description: Numeric sequence controlling the order in which constraint messages are displayed in consumer and dealer configurators.

attributes.name: constraint_code
attributes.description: Business-readable code identifying this constraint rule, often used in dealer ordering systems and configurators.

attributes.name: constraint_description
attributes.description: Detailed business explanation of why this constraint exists, including engineering, regulatory, or commercial rationale.

attributes.name: constraint_priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority for resolving conflicts when multiple constraints apply to the same option combination. Lower numbers indicate higher priority.

attributes.name: constraint_source
attributes.description: The business function or domain that originated this constraint rule (e.g., engineering for technical incompatibility, regulatory for compliance, commercial for pricing strategy).

attributes.name: constraint_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the constraint rule. Active constraints are enforced in ordering systems; inactive/deprecated constraints are retained for historical reference.

attributes.name: constraint_type
attributes.description: The type of constraint relationship: requires (source option mandates target), excludes (source option prohibits target), includes (source option automatically bundles target), upgrades (source option supersedes target), replaces (source option substitutes target), prerequisite (target requires source to be selected first).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this constraint record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this constraint rule becomes active and enforceable in dealer ordering and consumer configurator systems.

attributes.name: error_message
attributes.description: User-facing error or warning message displayed in dealer ordering systems or consumer configurators when this constraint is violated.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date after which this constraint rule is no longer active. Nullable for constraints with indefinite validity.

attributes.name: field_service_info
attributes.description: Field service related information, consolidating field service concepts.

attributes.name: fmea_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) Reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier to the FMEA document that analyzed the risk associated with this option constraint.

tag_set.value: Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) Reference

attributes.name: homologation_region
attributes.description: Regulatory region code (e.g., EPA, CARB, EURO6, UNECE) for which this constraint is applicable. Some option combinations are prohibited or required by regional emissions or safety standards.

attributes.name: is_hard_constraint
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a hard constraint (cannot be violated under any circumstances) or a soft constraint (generates warning but can be overridden).

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the person who last modified this constraint rule.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this constraint record.

attributes.name: lead_time_impact_days
attributes.description: The number of additional production days required when this constraint is triggered, impacting On-Time Delivery (OTD) commitments.

attributes.name: manufacturing_complexity_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (1-10) indicating the manufacturing complexity introduced by this constraint. Higher scores may impact production scheduling and Just-in-Sequence (JIS) logistics.

attributes.name: market_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country or regional market code indicating where this constraint applies. Constraints may vary by market due to regulatory or feature availability differences.

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: The model year for which this option constraint is applicable. Constraints may vary by MY due to engineering changes or regulatory updates.

attributes.name: msrp_impact_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Manufacturer Suggested Retail Price (MSRP) Impact Amount
attributes.description: The incremental MSRP change (positive or negative) resulting from this constraint being applied. Used for dynamic pricing in configurators.

tag_set.value: Manufacturer Suggested Retail Price (MSRP) Impact Amount

attributes.name: msrp_impact_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the MSRP impact amount.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, special instructions, or historical notes about this constraint rule.

attributes.name: override_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether authorized users (e.g., fleet sales managers, product planners) can override this constraint in special circumstances.

attributes.name: override_approval_level
attributes.description: The minimum authorization level required to override this constraint, if override_allowed is true.

attributes.name: ppap_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this constraint triggers a PPAP requirement due to significant engineering or supplier changes.

tag_set.value: Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) Required Flag

attributes.name: supplier_constraint
attributes.description: Indicates whether this constraint is driven by supplier capacity, tooling, or material availability limitations.

attributes.name: created_by

products.name: fleet_spec
products.description: Defines fleet-specific vehicle specifications and configurations negotiated for fleet customers (government, corporate, rental). Captures fleet spec code, fleet customer segment (government/corporate/rental/utility), applicable nameplate and MY, approved trim levels, approved option packages, fleet MSRP discount structure, minimum order quantity, delivery lead time commitment, and spec approval status. Distinct from retail SKU configurations — fleet specs represent negotiated commercial configurations with volume commitments.

products.name: product_lifecycle_event
products.description: Captures significant lifecycle state transitions for nameplates, model year programs, and SKUs (e.g., program approval, design freeze, SOP, Job 1, mid-cycle refresh announcement, EOP, nameplate discontinuation). Captures event type, affected entity type and ID, event date, prior state, new state, triggering authority, announcement type (internal/public), and associated press release or regulatory filing reference. Provides a complete audit trail of commercial product lifecycle decisions.

attributes.name: odometer_at_sale_km

attributes.name: parts_coverage_type

attributes.name: payment_method

attributes.name: provider_contract_reference

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_flag

attributes.name: rental_reimbursement_daily_limit

attributes.name: rental_reimbursement_included

attributes.name: repair_facility_restriction

attributes.name: roadside_assistance_included

attributes.name: sale_date

attributes.name: transfer_fee

attributes.name: transferable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this warranty contract can be transferred to a subsequent vehicle owner, which may affect resale value.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.name: extended_warranty_provider_id

attributes.name: parent_provider_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the parent provider record for providers that are subsidiaries or regional entities of a larger warranty group. Enables hierarchical provider reporting and consolidated claims analysis.

attributes.name: adas_coverage_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider's extended warranty products include coverage for Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) components such as radar, lidar, cameras, and control modules.

attributes.name: auto_renewal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the master provider agreement automatically renews at the contract end date unless explicitly terminated. True = auto-renews; False = requires active renewal action.

attributes.name: cancellation_refund_policy
attributes.description: Policy governing refund of extended warranty premiums upon early cancellation: pro_rata (refund proportional to unused term), flat_fee (fixed cancellation charge deducted), non_refundable, or tiered (schedule-based). Drives customer refund calculations.

attributes.name: claims_authorisation_limit
attributes.description: Maximum monetary value (in contract currency) of a single warranty claim that the provider can authorise without requiring OEM or reinsurer pre-approval. Drives claims routing and escalation logic in the DMS.

attributes.name: claims_contact_email
attributes.description: Dedicated email address for the provider's claims processing department. Used by dealers and service centres to submit warranty claims, request authorisations, and receive claim status updates.

attributes.name: claims_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which claims are settled and financial limits are denominated for this provider (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: claims_portal_url
attributes.description: Web address of the provider's online claims submission and management portal. Integrated with dealer management systems (DMS) for electronic claims lodgement and real-time authorisation.

attributes.name: contract_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the master agreement with the extended warranty provider expires. Null indicates an open-ended arrangement. Triggers renewal or re-tendering workflow when approaching.

attributes.name: contract_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which the master agreement with the extended warranty provider becomes effective and new warranty contracts can be issued under this provider.

attributes.name: country_of_incorporation
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the jurisdiction in which the provider is legally incorporated. Determines applicable contract law, regulatory framework, and tax treaty treatment.

attributes.name: coverage_categories
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of vehicle system categories covered under extended warranty products offered by this provider (e.g., powertrain, electrical, infotainment, ADAS, EV_battery). Defines the scope of coverage available for product configuration.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp (ISO 8601 with timezone offset) when the extended warranty provider record was first created in the Lakehouse silver layer. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and GDPR record-keeping obligations.

attributes.name: data_sharing_agreement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal data sharing agreement (DSA) is in place between the OEM and the extended warranty provider governing the exchange of vehicle telematics, claims, and customer data. Required for GDPR-compliant data processing.

attributes.name: dealer_commission_rate
attributes.description: Standard commission rate (expressed as a decimal fraction, e.g., 0.15 = 15%) paid to the selling dealer upon issuance of an extended warranty contract under this provider. Subject to individual dealer agreements.

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_mechanism
attributes.description: Contractually agreed mechanism for resolving claims disputes between the OEM/dealer and the extended warranty provider: arbitration, mediation, litigation, or referral to an industry ombudsman.

attributes.name: ev_coverage_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider offers extended warranty products specifically covering electric vehicle (EV) high-voltage battery systems and EV-specific components. True = EV coverage available; False = ICE/HEV only.

attributes.name: financial_rating
attributes.description: Credit or financial strength rating assigned by a recognised rating agency (e.g., AM Best, S&P, Moody's) to the provider or its underwriter. Used to assess counterparty risk and compliance with OEM supplier financial standards.

attributes.name: gdpr_dpa_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier of the GDPR-compliant Data Processing Agreement (DPA) executed with this provider. Required where the provider processes personal data on behalf of the OEM as a data processor.

attributes.name: governing_law_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the jurisdiction whose laws govern the master provider agreement and any disputes arising from it.

attributes.name: insurance_licence_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the provider's insurance or warranty administration licence expires. Triggers renewal workflow and suspension of new contract issuance if not renewed before this date.

attributes.name: insurance_licence_number
attributes.description: Regulatory licence or authorisation number issued by the financial services regulator (e.g., FCA, BaFin, NAIC) permitting the provider to underwrite or administer extended warranty / mechanical breakdown insurance products.

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent compliance or performance audit conducted on the extended warranty provider by the OEM or an appointed third party. Used to schedule next audit and monitor compliance cadence.

attributes.name: lei_code
attributes.description: 20-character ISO 17442 Legal Entity Identifier assigned by a GLEIF-accredited Local Operating Unit. Mandatory for financial regulatory reporting and cross-border contract compliance in applicable jurisdictions.

attributes.name: max_coverage_duration_months
attributes.description: Maximum number of months of extended warranty coverage that this provider can offer on a single contract, measured from the original vehicle in-service date. Used to validate warranty product configuration.

attributes.name: max_coverage_mileage_km
attributes.description: Maximum odometer reading in kilometres up to which extended warranty coverage is valid under contracts issued by this provider. Contracts expire at the earlier of duration or mileage limit.

attributes.name: next_audit_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date by which the next compliance or performance audit of the extended warranty provider must be completed. Triggers audit planning workflow when approaching.

attributes.name: notice_period_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days' written notice required by either party to terminate or not renew the master provider agreement. Used to trigger advance notification workflows.

attributes.name: onboarding_date
attributes.description: Date on which the extended warranty provider was formally onboarded and approved for use in the OEM's aftersales network. Marks the start of the operational relationship.

attributes.name: operating_countries
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes in which the provider is authorised to offer extended warranty products. Used to validate market eligibility when issuing new warranty contracts.

attributes.name: payment_terms_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days from claim approval to payment settlement agreed with the provider (e.g., 30, 45, 60 days). Used for accounts payable scheduling and cash flow forecasting.

attributes.name: preferred_provider_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this provider has been designated as a preferred or recommended extended warranty partner by the OEM. Preferred providers may receive priority placement in dealer sales tools and incentive programmes.

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Business email address of the primary contact at the extended warranty provider. Used for claims notifications, contract correspondence, and escalation communications. Must be masked in non-production environments.

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary business contact person at the extended warranty provider for day-to-day operational liaison, claims escalation, and contract management.

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Business telephone number of the primary contact at the extended warranty provider. Used for urgent claims escalation and operational communications. Must be masked in non-production environments.

attributes.name: provider_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business code uniquely identifying the extended warranty provider across systems (e.g., SAP vendor code, DMS provider code). Used as the operational cross-system reference key.

attributes.name: provider_name
attributes.description: Full legal trading name of the extended warranty provider organisation as registered with the relevant regulatory authority. Used for contract documents, invoicing, and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: provider_short_name
attributes.description: Abbreviated or trading name of the provider used in UI displays, reports, and dealer-facing communications where the full legal name is impractical.

attributes.name: provider_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the provider relationship. Controls whether new extended warranty contracts can be issued under this provider. Active = eligible for new business; Suspended = under review; Terminated = no new or renewal contracts permitted.

attributes.name: provider_type
attributes.description: Classification of the provider by operational model: OEM-captive (manufacturer-backed), third-party insurer, dealer-administered fund, reinsurer, or third-party administrator (TPA). Drives contract terms, claims routing, and regulatory treatment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: oem_captive|third_party_insurer|dealer_administered|reinsurer|administrator — promote to reference product if additional types emerge]

attributes.name: rating_agency
attributes.description: Name of the credit or financial strength rating agency that issued the financial_rating for this provider. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: AM_Best|SP_Global|Moodys|Fitch|DBRS|internal — promote to reference product if additional agencies are required]

attributes.name: registered_address_city
attributes.description: City or municipality of the provider's registered legal address. Used for regulatory jurisdiction determination and contract documentation.

attributes.name: registered_address_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the provider's registered legal address. Determines applicable legal jurisdiction for contract disputes and regulatory oversight.

attributes.name: registered_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the provider's registered legal address (street number and name). Required for contract documentation, regulatory filings, and legal correspondence.

attributes.name: registered_address_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the provider's registered legal address. Used for geographic routing, tax jurisdiction assignment, and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: registration_number
attributes.description: Official company registration or incorporation number issued by the national business registry (e.g., Companies House UK, Handelsregister DE, SEC CIK US). Required for regulatory compliance and contract validation.

attributes.name: reimbursement_model
attributes.description: Financial settlement model used for warranty claims: direct_pay (provider pays dealer directly), reimbursement (dealer pays then claims back), pooled_fund (OEM-managed reserve), or captive_reserve (self-insured OEM fund). Determines cash flow and accounting treatment.

attributes.name: roadside_assistance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether roadside assistance (breakdown recovery, towing, emergency fuel) is bundled with the extended warranty products offered by this provider.

attributes.name: solvency_ratio_percent
attributes.description: Provider's solvency capital ratio expressed as a percentage, as reported under Solvency II or equivalent regulatory framework. Monitored to ensure the provider maintains adequate reserves to honour future claims.

attributes.name: tax_identification_number
attributes.description: Tax identification number (TIN) or VAT registration number of the provider as issued by the relevant tax authority. Required for invoice processing, withholding tax calculations, and statutory reporting.

attributes.name: transferability_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether extended warranty contracts issued by this provider can be transferred to a subsequent vehicle owner upon private sale. True = transferable; False = non-transferable. Impacts used-vehicle residual value.

attributes.name: underwriter_name
attributes.description: Name of the insurance underwriter or reinsurer that carries the financial risk for extended warranty claims administered by this provider. Relevant where the provider acts as administrator rather than risk carrier.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp (ISO 8601 with timezone offset) when the extended warranty provider record was most recently modified. Used for change data capture (CDC), incremental loads, and audit trail maintenance.

domains.name: billing
domains.description: SSOT for all revenue transactions and receivables. Owns dealer invoices, retail customer billing, fleet account statements, parts and service charges, payment records, credit notes, and dispute management. Handles invoicing, payment receipt, credit memos, and financial settlement for vehicle sales and services. Integrates with SAP SD/FI and supports MSRP-based and negotiated pricing models.

products.name: invoice
products.description: Core billing document representing a formal demand for payment issued to dealers, retail customers, fleet accounts, or corporate buyers for vehicle sales, parts, or services. Captures invoice number, invoice date, due date, invoice type (dealer/retail/fleet/parts/service), billing entity, billing address, currency, total amount, tax amount, discount amount, net amount, payment terms, invoice status (draft/issued/partially_paid/paid/cancelled/disputed), SAP SD billing document reference, MSRP-based or negotiated pricing flag, and model year context. SSOT for all outbound billing documents in the enterprise.

attributes.name: invoice_id

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.billing_account. Business justification: Invoicing is performed per billing account; needed for account‑level revenue reporting and statement generation.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.carrier. Business justification: Invoice includes carrier charges; linking to carrier enables carrier performance reporting and compliance with freight cost audits.

attributes.name: compliance_emissions_certification_id

attributes.name: employee_id

attributes.name: homologation_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.homologation_record. Business justification: Required for sales invoicing to verify each vehicle model is homologated for the market, supporting the Homologation Compliance Report.

attributes.name: invoice_customer_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer (dealer, retail buyer, fleet account, or corporate buyer) to whom this invoice is issued.

attributes.name: invoice_dealer_dealership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealer entity when the invoice is issued to a dealer for wholesale vehicle or parts transactions. Null for retail and fleet invoices.

attributes.name: invoice_dealership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealer entity when the invoice is issued to a dealer for wholesale vehicle or parts transactions. Null for retail and fleet invoices.

attributes.name: invoice_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer (dealer, retail buyer, fleet account, or corporate buyer) to whom this invoice is issued.

attributes.name: maintenance_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.maintenance_order. Business justification: Invoices for maintenance services must link to the originating maintenance order for audit trail and revenue recognition.

attributes.name: payment_term_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.payment_term. Business justification: Invoice references a payment term; using a foreign key to payment_term provides full term details and removes the redundant code column.

attributes.name: rep_id
attributes.description: Reference to the salesperson or account manager responsible for this sale, used for commission and performance tracking.

attributes.name: service_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to aftersales.service_contract. Business justification: REQUIRED: Service‑contract billing generates periodic invoices; linking enables contract‑level revenue and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: supply_purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.supply_purchase_order. Business justification: AP process matches supplier purchase orders to invoices for payment reconciliation; experts expect a PO FK on invoice.

attributes.name: vin_registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vehicle.vin_registry. Business justification: Invoices for vehicle sales need to reference the exact vehicle VIN; adding vin_id creates a direct link between billing and the vehicle master.

attributes.name: billing_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the billing address to which the invoice is sent.

attributes.name: billing_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the billing address (suite, building, department).

attributes.name: billing_city
attributes.description: City of the billing address.

attributes.name: billing_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code of the billing address.

attributes.name: billing_entity_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the legal entity or business unit issuing the invoice (e.g., regional sales company, parts distribution center, service center).

attributes.name: billing_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the billing address.

attributes.name: billing_state_province
attributes.description: State or province of the billing address.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Description of the reason for invoice cancellation (order cancelled, billing error, duplicate invoice).

attributes.name: cancelled_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the invoice was cancelled, if applicable. Null for active invoices.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this invoice record was first created in the system. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: credit_memo_reference
attributes.description: Reference to a credit memo document number if this invoice has been partially or fully credited.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code in which the invoice is denominated.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total discount amount applied to the invoice (volume discounts, promotional discounts, early payment discounts).

attributes.name: dispute_date
attributes.description: Date when the invoice was flagged as disputed by the customer or internal review.

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Description of the reason for dispute if the invoice status is disputed (pricing error, quantity mismatch, quality issue, delivery issue).

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The date by which payment is expected per the agreed payment terms.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Fiscal period (month or quarter) within the fiscal year when the invoice was issued.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year in which the invoice was issued, used for financial reporting and period closing.

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: Total invoice amount before taxes, discounts, and adjustments.

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: The date the invoice was formally issued to the customer. Principal business event timestamp for the billing transaction.

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique invoice document number issued to the customer. Business identifier for the invoice.

attributes.name: invoice_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the invoice in the billing and collection workflow.

attributes.name: invoice_type
attributes.description: Classification of the invoice based on the customer segment and transaction nature (dealer wholesale, retail customer, fleet account, parts sale, service work, warranty claim).

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: Model year of the vehicle or product being invoiced, providing context for pricing and product configuration.

attributes.name: msrp_based_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Manufacturer Suggested Retail Price (MSRP) Based Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the invoice pricing is based on MSRP (true) or negotiated/contracted pricing (false).

tag_set.value: Manufacturer Suggested Retail Price (MSRP) Based Flag

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: Final invoice amount payable after applying taxes, discounts, and all adjustments. This is the amount due from the customer.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments related to the invoice (special instructions, payment arrangements, delivery notes).

attributes.name: outstanding_amount
attributes.description: Remaining unpaid balance on the invoice (net_amount minus paid_amount).

attributes.name: paid_amount
attributes.description: Total amount paid against this invoice to date. Used to track partial payments.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The payment instrument or method expected or used for settling this invoice.

attributes.name: payment_received_date
attributes.description: Date when the full or final payment was received for this invoice. Null if not yet fully paid.

attributes.name: sales_order_number
attributes.description: Reference to the originating sales order or service order that this invoice bills for.

attributes.name: sales_region_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the sales region or territory to which this invoice is attributed for revenue reporting.

attributes.name: sap_billing_document_number
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP SD billing document number from which this invoice was generated. System of record identifier.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount applied to the invoice (sales tax, VAT, GST, etc.).

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this invoice record was last modified. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: vin
attributes.description: 17-character Vehicle Identification Number of the vehicle being invoiced, if applicable (for vehicle sales invoices).

products.name: billing_invoice_line
products.description: Individual line item on a billing invoice representing a specific charge for a vehicle unit, parts SKU, labor operation, accessory, or service fee. Captures line number, item type (vehicle/part/labor/accessory/fee), item code, item description, VIN reference for vehicle lines, part number for parts lines, quantity, unit price, MSRP, negotiated price, discount amount, tax code, tax amount, line total, and revenue category. Supports multi-line invoices for mixed vehicle and parts/service billing. SUPERSEDED: Use procurement.procurement_invoice_line as the single source of truth.

attributes.name: billing_invoice_line_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the invoice line item. Primary key for the invoice_line product.

attributes.name: aftersales_service_appointment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to aftersales.service_appointment. Business justification: REQUIRED: Service appointments generate billable items; linking appointment to invoice line provides appointment‑level financial reporting.

attributes.name: billing_price_condition_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.price_condition. Business justification: Invoice line items can be priced by a pricing condition; linking to price_condition normalizes pricing logic.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Needed to allocate line‑level costs to the correct cost center for internal cost tracking and reporting.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the salesperson who completed this transaction. Used for sales commission calculation and performance tracking.

attributes.name: equipment_registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.equipment_registry. Business justification: Invoice line items for parts/labor need equipment reference to allocate charges to the correct asset.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Required for General Ledger posting of each invoice line revenue to the appropriate GL account for financial reporting.

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent invoice header. Links this line item to the billing invoice document.

attributes.name: part_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.part_master. Business justification: Required for warranty claim and recall tracking: each invoice line must reference the engineering part master to associate sold parts with design, compliance, and cost data.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Supports profit‑center profitability analysis by linking each sales line to its profit center.

attributes.name: rep_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the salesperson who completed this transaction. Used for sales commission calculation and performance tracking.

attributes.name: repair_order_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to aftersales.repair_order_line. Business justification: REQUIRED: Each invoice line originates from a repair‑order line; the link supports detailed cost‑to‑service analysis.

attributes.name: service_contract_claim_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to aftersales.service_contract_claim. Business justification: REQUIRED: Claims under service contracts are billed; linking claim to invoice line enables claim settlement and audit.

attributes.name: service_subscription_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mobility.service_subscription. Business justification: Needed for the 'Usage‑Based Service Billing' report, linking each invoice line to the subscription that produced the charge.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Invoice line items represent sold SKUs; linking each invoice_line to the product SKU provides traceability from billing to product catalog.

attributes.name: supply_po_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.supply_po_line. Business justification: Invoice line validation against PO line items is required for accurate cost allocation and audit; standard in automotive AP.

attributes.name: tax_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.tax_code. Business justification: Invoice line tax details should reference the tax_code master; the tax rate can be derived, so the string code and rate columns are redundant.

attributes.name: vin_registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vehicle.vin_registry. Business justification: Invoice line items are allocated to a specific vehicle for warranty and service charge tracking; linking ensures accurate vehicle‑level financial reporting.

attributes.name: billing_date
attributes.description: Date when this line item was billed. Represents the accounting date for revenue recognition and the invoice document date.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Reason code or description if this line was cancelled. Provides audit trail for cancelled billing lines and supports dispute analysis.

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: Cost center responsible for this revenue line. Used for internal cost accounting and profitability analysis by organizational unit.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this invoice line record was first created in the billing system. Provides audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: credit_memo_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the credit memo document if this line was credited. Links to the reversing document for returns, adjustments, or billing corrections.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts on this line. Indicates the currency in which the line is billed (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY, GBP, CAD).

attributes.name: dealer_code
attributes.description: Dealer or distribution partner code responsible for this sale. Identifies the selling dealer location for dealer network reporting and commission calculation.

attributes.name: delivery_number
attributes.description: Reference to the delivery document that fulfilled this line. Links the billing to the physical shipment or service delivery event.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total discount applied to this line item. Represents the monetary reduction from the base unit price, including promotional discounts, volume discounts, and negotiated reductions.

attributes.name: discount_percentage
attributes.description: Discount expressed as a percentage of the unit price. Provides the rate of discount applied to calculate the discount_amount.

attributes.name: item_code
attributes.description: Universal item identifier for the billed product or service. May represent a vehicle model code, part number, labor operation code, accessory SKU (Stock Keeping Unit), or fee code depending on line_item_type.

attributes.name: item_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the billed item. Provides detailed text explaining the product, service, or charge represented by this line.

attributes.name: labor_operation_code
attributes.description: Standardized labor operation code for service work. Identifies the specific repair or maintenance task performed. Populated only when line_item_type is labor.

attributes.name: line_item_type
attributes.description: Classification of the invoice line item. Distinguishes between vehicle units, parts, labor operations, accessories, service fees, freight charges, warranty products, and insurance products. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: vehicle|part|labor|accessory|fee|freight|warranty|insurance — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the invoice. Determines the ordering and display sequence of line items on the invoice document.

attributes.name: line_status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the invoice line. Tracks the lifecycle state from initial billing through payment or dispute resolution.

attributes.name: line_total_amount
attributes.description: Total amount for this line item including all charges and taxes. Calculated as subtotal_amount + tax_amount. Represents the final billable amount for this line.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier of the person or system that last modified this invoice line record. Supports audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this invoice line record was last modified. Tracks the most recent update to the record for audit and data quality purposes.

attributes.name: msrp
attributes.description: Manufacturer Suggested Retail Price for the item. The list price recommended by the OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer). Primarily applicable to vehicle and accessory line items.

attributes.name: negotiated_price
attributes.description: Final negotiated price per unit after dealer or customer negotiations. May differ from MSRP (Manufacturer Suggested Retail Price) based on market conditions, promotions, or customer agreements.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about this invoice line. Captures special instructions, explanations, or additional context for the billing line item.

attributes.name: profit_center
attributes.description: Profit center for internal P&L (Profit and Loss) reporting. Enables profitability analysis by business segment, product line, or geographic region.

attributes.name: promotion_code
attributes.description: Marketing promotion or incentive program code applied to this line. Tracks the specific promotional campaign that influenced the pricing or discount.

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of items or units billed on this line. For vehicles typically 1, for parts the number of units, for labor the number of hours.

attributes.name: revenue_category
attributes.description: Revenue classification for financial reporting and analytics. Categorizes the line item into major revenue streams for P&L (Profit and Loss) reporting and business intelligence. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: new_vehicle|used_vehicle|parts|service|warranty|finance|insurance — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: sales_order_line_number
attributes.description: Line number on the originating sales order. Provides traceability from the invoice line back to the specific sales order line item.

attributes.name: sales_order_number
attributes.description: Reference to the originating sales order document. Links the invoice line back to the sales order that authorized this billing.

attributes.name: service_date
attributes.description: Date when the service or delivery occurred. For labor lines, the date the work was performed; for parts, the date the parts were delivered; for vehicles, the delivery date.

attributes.name: subtotal_amount
attributes.description: Line subtotal before taxes. Calculated as (quantity × unit_price) - discount_amount. Represents the net selling amount before tax.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax charged on this line item. Calculated by applying the tax_rate to the subtotal_amount. Includes sales tax, VAT (Value Added Tax), or GST (Goods and Services Tax) as applicable.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the quantity. EA=Each (for countable items), HR=Hour (for labor), KG=Kilogram, LB=Pound, L=Liter, GAL=Gallon, M=Meter, FT=Foot. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|HR|KG|LB|L|GAL|M|FT — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: Price per unit before discounts and taxes. Represents the base selling price for one unit of the item.

attributes.name: warranty_code
attributes.description: Warranty program code if this line represents warranty coverage. Identifies the specific warranty plan or extended service contract being billed.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User identifier of the person or system that created this invoice line record. Supports audit trail and accountability.

products.name: payment
products.description: Record of a payment received against an invoice or account balance from a dealer, retail customer, fleet operator, or corporate account.
