products.description: Pricing condition record defining the applicable price, discount, surcharge, or tax condition for a billing transaction based on customer type, vehicle model, region, and validity period. Captures condition type (MSRP/negotiated/fleet_discount/dealer_margin/volume_rebate/freight/PDI_charge/tax), condition value, condition unit, scale basis, validity start/end dates, pricing procedure reference, and SAP SD condition record reference (KONP/KONV). Supports both MSRP-based and negotiated pricing models as required by the billing domain. SUPERSEDED: Use procurement.procurement_price_condition as the single source of truth.

attributes.name: billing_price_condition_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the price condition record. Primary key.

attributes.name: approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether application of this pricing condition requires managerial or pricing authority approval before being applied to a billing transaction. True requires approval workflow.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the pricing authority or manager who approved this condition for use in billing transactions. Null if approval is not required or pending.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this pricing condition was approved for use. Null if approval is not required or still pending. Part of the governance audit trail.

attributes.name: calculation_type
attributes.description: Method used to calculate the condition value in the billing transaction. Defines whether the condition is applied as a fixed amount, percentage of base, quantity-dependent, or using a tiered/formula approach.

attributes.name: condition_class
attributes.description: High-level classification of the condition type grouping similar pricing elements together for reporting and analysis purposes.

attributes.name: condition_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the pricing condition, including its business purpose, applicability rules, and any special terms or restrictions. Provides context for pricing analysts and auditors.

attributes.name: condition_exclusion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this condition is marked for exclusion from certain pricing scenarios or customer groups. True means the condition should be excluded under specific business rules.

attributes.name: condition_record_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the pricing condition record, typically sourced from SAP SD condition record (KONP table). Used for external reference and traceability.

attributes.name: condition_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the pricing condition record. Active conditions are available for use in billing; inactive, expired, or suspended conditions are not applied.

attributes.name: condition_step_number
attributes.description: Sequence number within the pricing procedure that defines the order in which this condition is evaluated and applied during billing calculation.

attributes.name: condition_type
attributes.description: Type of pricing condition applied to the billing transaction. Defines whether this is a base price (MSRP), negotiated price, discount, surcharge, tax, or other pricing element. Aligns with SAP SD condition types. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: msrp|negotiated|fleet_discount|dealer_margin|volume_rebate|freight|pdi_charge|tax|surcharge|promotional_discount — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: condition_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the condition value. Indicates whether the value is an absolute amount, a percentage, or a per-unit rate.

attributes.name: condition_value
attributes.description: Monetary or percentage value of the pricing condition. For absolute amounts, represents the price or adjustment in the condition currency. For percentage-based conditions, represents the rate (e.g., 5.5 for 5.5%).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this pricing condition record was first created in the system. Part of the audit trail for master data lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the condition value when expressed as an absolute amount (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY).

attributes.name: customer_type
attributes.description: Type of customer for which this pricing condition is applicable. Enables customer segment-specific pricing strategies (retail, fleet, dealer, government, commercial).

attributes.name: dealer_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the dealer or dealership for which this pricing condition is applicable. Enables dealer-specific pricing agreements and margin structures. Null indicates condition applies to all dealers.

attributes.name: distribution_channel_code
attributes.description: SAP SD distribution channel code indicating the sales channel (e.g., retail, fleet, online) for which this condition applies. Enables channel-specific pricing strategies.

attributes.name: effective_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when this pricing condition record version is superseded or becomes inactive in the lakehouse. Null indicates the current active version. Used for SCD Type 2 tracking.

attributes.name: effective_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when this pricing condition record becomes effective in the lakehouse. Used for temporal queries and slowly changing dimension (SCD) Type 2 tracking.

attributes.name: is_current_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this record represents the current active version of the pricing condition. True for the latest version, False for historical versions. Supports SCD Type 2 queries.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified this pricing condition record. Supports change tracking and accountability.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this pricing condition record was last modified. Enables change detection and version control for pricing master data.

attributes.name: manual_override_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether sales or billing personnel are permitted to manually override this condition value during transaction processing. True allows manual adjustment, False enforces system-determined value.

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: Model year of the vehicle for which this pricing condition is applicable. Enables year-over-year pricing adjustments and end-of-model-year promotions.

attributes.name: pricing_procedure_code
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP SD pricing procedure that governs the sequence and logic of condition application. Links this condition to the broader pricing determination framework.

attributes.name: sales_organization_code
attributes.description: SAP SD sales organization code that owns this pricing condition. Defines the organizational unit responsible for pricing governance and approval.

attributes.name: sales_region_code
attributes.description: Geographic sales region or market code for which this pricing condition is valid. Enables region-specific pricing strategies to account for market conditions, competition, and regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: sap_condition_table
attributes.description: Name of the SAP SD condition table (e.g., A001, A002) from which this condition record is sourced. Provides traceability to the source system configuration.

attributes.name: sap_konp_record_number
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP SD KONP table record number that stores the condition record master data. Enables direct linkage to the source system for audit and reconciliation.

attributes.name: sap_konv_counter
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP SD KONV table counter that tracks condition application instances in sales and billing documents. Used for transaction-level traceability.

attributes.name: scale_basis
attributes.description: Basis for scale-based pricing conditions. Defines the dimension (quantity, value, weight, volume) used to determine tiered pricing or volume-based discounts.

attributes.name: scale_quantity_from
attributes.description: Lower bound of the scale range for tiered pricing conditions. Defines the minimum quantity or value at which this condition rate applies.

attributes.name: scale_quantity_to
attributes.description: Upper bound of the scale range for tiered pricing conditions. Defines the maximum quantity or value at which this condition rate applies. Null indicates no upper limit.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the source system from which this pricing condition record was extracted (e.g., SAP_SD, SFDC, DMS). Supports multi-system integration and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: Start date from which this pricing condition becomes effective and can be applied to billing transactions. Part of the condition validity period.

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: End date until which this pricing condition remains effective. Null indicates the condition is valid indefinitely. Part of the condition validity period.

attributes.name: vehicle_model_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific vehicle model to which this pricing condition applies. Enables model-specific pricing and promotional strategies. Null indicates condition applies across all models.

attributes.name: vehicle_trim_level
attributes.description: Trim or configuration level of the vehicle model for which this condition applies (e.g., base, sport, luxury, premium). Enables trim-specific pricing differentiation.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who created this pricing condition record in the system. Supports audit trail and accountability.

products.name: payment_term
products.description: Reference master for standard payment terms offered to billing accounts, defining due date calculation rules, early payment discount percentages, and penalty terms. Captures payment term code, description, net due days, discount percentage 1 and 2, discount days 1 and 2, penalty rate, penalty grace days, applicable account types (dealer/fleet/retail/corporate), and SAP FI payment term reference (T052). Used to standardize billing terms across all invoice types.

attributes.name: payment_term_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the payment term record. Primary key.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.account. Business justification: Accounts often have a default payment term; linking provides a normalized reference.

attributes.name: applicable_account_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of billing account types to which this payment term applies (e.g., dealer, fleet, retail, corporate, OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer)).

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which this payment term was approved by finance or credit management. Null if not yet approved.

attributes.name: approval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether finance or credit manager approval is required before this payment term can be assigned to a customer account.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or user ID of the finance or credit manager who approved this payment term for use. Null if no approval required or pending.

attributes.name: auto_dunning_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether automatic dunning (collection reminder) process is enabled for invoices using this payment term.

attributes.name: baseline_date_rule
attributes.description: Rule defining the baseline date from which net due days and discount days are calculated (invoice date, delivery date, end of month, or custom).

attributes.name: business_unit_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the business unit or division that owns and manages this payment term (e.g., DEALER, FLEET, PARTS).

attributes.name: payment_term_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code representing the payment term (e.g., NET30, 2/10N30, COD). Maps to SAP FI payment term key in table T052.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this payment term record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: credit_check_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a credit check is required before this payment term can be assigned to a billing account.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for which this payment term is defined (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY). Null if applicable to all currencies.

attributes.name: payment_term_description
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of the payment term conditions, including discount and penalty clauses.

attributes.name: discount_days_1
attributes.description: Number of days from invoice date within which discount percentage 1 applies.

attributes.name: discount_days_2
attributes.description: Number of days from invoice date within which discount percentage 2 applies (typically longer than discount days 1).

attributes.name: discount_percentage_1
attributes.description: First early payment discount percentage offered if payment is made within discount days 1 (e.g., 2.00 for 2%).

attributes.name: discount_percentage_2
attributes.description: Second early payment discount percentage offered if payment is made within discount days 2 (typically lower than discount 1).

attributes.name: dunning_level
attributes.description: Default dunning level (escalation stage) for collection reminders associated with this payment term. Null if auto dunning is disabled.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which this payment term is no longer valid for new assignments. Null if no end date is defined.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this payment term becomes valid and available for assignment to billing accounts.

attributes.name: fixed_day_of_month
attributes.description: If baseline date rule is custom, specifies a fixed day of the month for payment due date (e.g., 15 for the 15th of each month). Null if not applicable.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified this payment term record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this payment term record was last updated.

attributes.name: maximum_order_value
attributes.description: Maximum invoice or order value for which this payment term is applicable. Null if no maximum.

attributes.name: minimum_order_value
attributes.description: Minimum invoice or order value required for this payment term to be applicable. Null if no minimum.

attributes.name: payment_term_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the payment term (e.g., Net 30 Days, 2% 10 Net 30, Cash on Delivery).

attributes.name: net_due_days
attributes.description: Number of days from invoice date by which full payment is due without penalty.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, special conditions, or internal comments about this payment term.

attributes.name: payment_method_restriction
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of allowed payment methods for this term (e.g., wire_transfer, check, ACH, credit_card). Empty if no restriction.

attributes.name: payment_term_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the payment term: active (in use), inactive (not available for new assignments), deprecated (legacy term), or pending approval (awaiting finance approval).

attributes.name: penalty_calculation_method
attributes.description: Method used to calculate late payment penalties: daily accrual, monthly accrual, flat fee, or none.

attributes.name: penalty_grace_days
attributes.description: Number of days after net due date before penalty charges begin to accrue.

attributes.name: penalty_rate
attributes.description: Late payment penalty rate applied after grace period expires, expressed as percentage per period (e.g., 1.5% per month).

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: Three-letter geographic region code where this payment term is applicable (e.g., USA, EUR, JPN). Null if globally applicable.

attributes.name: sap_fi_payment_term_key
attributes.business_glossary_term: SAP FI (Financial Accounting) Payment Term Key
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP FI payment term key in table T052 for ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) integration and synchronization.

tag_set.value: SAP FI (Financial Accounting) Payment Term Key

attributes.name: usage_count
attributes.description: Number of active billing accounts or invoices currently using this payment term. Used for impact analysis before deprecation.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who created this payment term record.

products.name: tax_code
products.description: Reference master for tax codes applicable to automotive billing transactions across jurisdictions, capturing tax code identifier, tax type (VAT/GST/sales_tax/excise/luxury_tax/environmental_levy), jurisdiction (federal/state/local/EU/APAC), applicable transaction types, tax rate percentage, effective date, expiry date, tax authority reference, and SAP FI/SD tax code mapping. Supports multi-jurisdiction billing for domestic and export vehicle sales, parts, and services.

attributes.name: tax_code_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the tax code record. Primary key.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.account. Business justification: Accounts may have a default tax code; linking normalizes tax code usage.

attributes.name: applicable_transaction_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of transaction types to which this tax code applies. Examples: vehicle_sale, parts_sale, service_labor, warranty_repair, fleet_lease, export_sale, dealer_invoice, retail_invoice. Supports multi-transaction applicability.

attributes.name: calculation_method
attributes.description: The method used to calculate the tax amount. Percentage for rate-based calculation, fixed_amount for flat fees, tiered for progressive rates based on value bands, formula_based for complex calculations (e.g., emissions-based environmental levies).

attributes.name: tax_code_code
attributes.description: The alphanumeric tax code identifier used in billing and invoicing systems. Maps to SAP FI/SD tax code field (MWSKZ). Examples: VAT_STD, GST_18, SALES_TX_CA, EXCISE_LUX.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this tax code record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which tax amounts are calculated and reported (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, INR, CNY). Supports multi-currency billing operations.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this tax code and rate become active and applicable to transactions. Supports time-based tax rate changes and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: exemption_certificate_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a tax exemption certificate must be on file to apply this code for exempt transactions. True if certificate is mandatory, False otherwise. Supports compliance with exemption documentation requirements.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which this tax code and rate cease to be valid. Nullable for indefinite validity. Supports sunset provisions and temporary tax measures.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The GL account number to which tax amounts calculated using this code are posted in the financial ledger. Supports automated accounting entries and financial reporting.

attributes.name: is_deductible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the tax is deductible as a business expense for income tax purposes. Relevant for excise duties and certain non-recoverable taxes.

attributes.name: is_recoverable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the tax paid under this code can be recovered or reclaimed from the tax authority (e.g., input VAT). True for recoverable taxes, False for non-recoverable taxes.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code or extended jurisdiction identifier (e.g., USA-CA for California, DEU for Germany, IND-MH for Maharashtra). Identifies the specific geographic area where this tax applies.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_level
attributes.description: The governmental or regional level at which this tax is levied. Federal for national taxes, state for US state or equivalent provincial taxes, local for city/county taxes, EU for European Union-wide directives, APAC for Asia-Pacific regional harmonized taxes, multi_jurisdiction for taxes spanning multiple levels.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the person who last modified this tax code record. Supports change management and audit compliance.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this tax code record was most recently updated. Supports change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: tax_code_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or description of the tax code for display and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional information, special instructions, or clarifications regarding the application of this tax code. May include references to specific regulations, exemptions, or business rules.

attributes.name: reporting_code
attributes.description: The code or box number used when reporting this tax on statutory returns (e.g., VAT return box 1, GST return line 3A). Supports automated regulatory reporting and compliance.

attributes.name: reverse_charge_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reverse charge mechanism applies, where the customer rather than the supplier accounts for VAT. Common in B2B cross-border EU transactions and certain domestic supplies.

attributes.name: rounding_precision
attributes.description: The number of decimal places to which tax amounts are rounded (e.g., 2 for cents/pence, 0 for whole currency units). Supports multi-currency precision requirements.

attributes.name: rounding_rule
attributes.description: The rounding method applied to calculated tax amounts. Round_up for ceiling, round_down for floor, round_nearest for standard rounding, no_rounding for exact amounts. Ensures compliance with jurisdiction-specific rounding regulations.

attributes.name: sap_fi_tax_code
attributes.description: The corresponding tax code identifier in SAP FI module (table T007A, field MWSKZ). Typically 1-2 character alphanumeric. Enables integration and reconciliation between lakehouse and SAP ERP.

attributes.name: sap_sd_tax_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: SAP Sales and Distribution (SD) Tax Code
attributes.description: The corresponding tax code identifier in SAP SD module used in sales orders and billing documents. May differ from FI code in some implementations. Supports sales-specific tax determination.

tag_set.value: SAP Sales and Distribution (SD) Tax Code

attributes.name: tax_authority_name
attributes.description: The name of the governmental or regulatory body responsible for administering this tax. Examples: Internal Revenue Service (IRS), HM Revenue & Customs (HMRC), Goods and Services Tax Network (GSTN), California Department of Tax and Fee Administration.

attributes.name: tax_authority_reference
attributes.description: The official reference number, code, or identifier assigned by the tax authority for this tax type or rate. Used for regulatory reporting and audit trail.

attributes.name: tax_basis
attributes.description: The base amount on which the tax rate is applied. Net_amount for taxes on pre-tax subtotal, gross_amount for taxes on total including other taxes (cascading), MSRP (Manufacturer Suggested Retail Price) for luxury taxes, invoice_value for dealer invoices, customs_value for import duties.

attributes.name: tax_category
attributes.description: The accounting treatment category for this tax. Input_tax for recoverable VAT on purchases, output_tax for VAT charged on sales, withholding_tax for taxes deducted at source, reverse_charge for customer-remitted VAT, exempt for tax-exempt transactions, zero_rated for 0% taxable supplies.

attributes.name: tax_code_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the tax code. Active for codes in use, inactive for retired codes, pending for codes awaiting regulatory approval, superseded for codes replaced by newer versions.

attributes.name: tax_rate_percentage
attributes.description: The tax rate as a percentage (e.g., 19.0000 for 19% VAT, 5.5000 for 5.5% GST). Precision to four decimal places supports fine-grained rates. Used to calculate tax amount from taxable base.

attributes.name: tax_type
attributes.description: The category of tax represented by this code. VAT (Value Added Tax) for EU and similar jurisdictions, GST (Goods and Services Tax) for India/Australia/Canada, sales_tax for US state-level, excise for fuel/alcohol/tobacco duties, luxury_tax for high-value vehicles, environmental_levy for emissions-based charges.

attributes.name: withholding_tax_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether withholding tax provisions apply to transactions using this code. Relevant for cross-border payments and certain domestic transactions where tax is deducted at source.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the person who created this tax code record. Supports accountability and audit trail.

products.name: dunning_record
products.description: Dunning activity record tracking collection notices sent to billing accounts with overdue receivables. Captures dunning run date, billing account reference, dunning level (1/2/3/legal), dunning notice type (reminder/warning/final_demand/legal_notice), total overdue amount, number of overdue items, dunning notice delivery method (email/post/portal), response received flag, response date, and SAP FI dunning document reference. Supports escalating collections workflow for dealer and fleet accounts.

attributes.name: dunning_record_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the dunning record. Primary key.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the billing account that is subject to dunning activity due to overdue receivables.

attributes.name: dunning_collector_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the collections specialist or team responsible for managing this dunning case and follow-up actions.

attributes.name: dunning_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the collections specialist or team responsible for managing this dunning case and follow-up actions.

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: The classification of the billing account subject to dunning. Dealer accounts are franchise dealerships, fleet accounts are corporate fleet customers, retail accounts are individual consumers, commercial accounts are business customers, government accounts are public sector entities.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this dunning record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: credit_exposure
attributes.description: The total outstanding receivables for the account at the time of the dunning run, including both overdue and current amounts. Confidential business data.

attributes.name: credit_limit
attributes.description: The approved credit limit for the billing account at the time of the dunning run. Confidential business data.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the overdue amount (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY).

attributes.name: customer_segment
attributes.description: The business segment or risk classification of the customer, influencing dunning strategy and escalation path.

attributes.name: days_overdue
attributes.description: The number of days between the oldest overdue date and the dunning run date, representing the age of the oldest delinquency.

attributes.name: delivery_address
attributes.description: The email address, postal address, or portal user ID to which the dunning notice was sent. Confidential organizational contact data.

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has raised a dispute regarding the overdue charges (True) or not (False).

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason provided by the customer for disputing the overdue charges.

attributes.name: dunning_block_date
attributes.description: The date on which the dunning block was applied to the account. Null if not blocked.

attributes.name: dunning_block_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether further dunning activity for this account has been temporarily blocked (True) due to dispute, payment arrangement, or other reason, or is active (False).

attributes.name: dunning_block_reason
attributes.description: The reason why dunning activity has been blocked for this account. Null if not blocked.

attributes.name: dunning_fee_amount
attributes.description: The administrative fee charged to the customer for this dunning notice, if applicable. Zero if no fee charged.

attributes.name: dunning_level
attributes.description: The escalation level of the dunning notice. Level 1 is initial reminder, Level 2 is warning, Level 3 is final demand, Legal indicates legal action initiated.

attributes.name: dunning_notice_delivery_method
attributes.description: The channel through which the dunning notice was delivered to the customer.

attributes.name: dunning_notice_sent_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the dunning notice was successfully transmitted to the customer.

attributes.name: dunning_notice_type
attributes.description: The type of dunning communication sent to the customer. Reminder is courtesy notice, warning indicates escalation, final demand is last notice before legal action, legal notice indicates attorney involvement, suspension notice warns of service suspension, account hold indicates credit freeze.

attributes.name: dunning_run_date
attributes.description: The date on which the dunning run was executed and this dunning notice was generated.

attributes.name: dunning_run_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the dunning run batch that generated this notice. Format: DUN-YYYYMMDD-NNNN.

attributes.name: dunning_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of this dunning record. Sent indicates notice generated, delivered indicates successful transmission, bounced indicates delivery failure, responded indicates customer reply received, escalated indicates moved to higher level, resolved indicates payment received or dispute settled, cancelled indicates dunning withdrawn. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: sent|delivered|bounced|responded|escalated|resolved|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: interest_amount
attributes.description: The late payment interest accrued on the overdue amount as of the dunning run date, if applicable. Zero if no interest charged.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this dunning record was last updated.

attributes.name: next_action_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next follow-up action or escalation if payment is not received.

attributes.name: next_action_type
attributes.description: The type of follow-up action planned for the next action date.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and comments from collections staff regarding this dunning case, customer interactions, and follow-up actions.

attributes.name: oldest_overdue_date
attributes.description: The due date of the oldest unpaid invoice included in this dunning action, indicating how long the account has been delinquent.

attributes.name: overdue_item_count
attributes.description: The number of individual overdue invoices or line items included in this dunning notice.

attributes.name: payment_promise_amount
attributes.description: The amount the customer has committed to pay by the promise date. May be partial or full overdue amount.

attributes.name: payment_promise_date
attributes.description: The date by which the customer has promised to remit payment, if a payment promise was received. Null otherwise.

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: The date on which the dunning case was resolved through payment, dispute settlement, or write-off. Null if still open.

attributes.name: resolution_type
attributes.description: The manner in which the dunning case was resolved. Null if still open.

attributes.name: response_date
attributes.description: The date on which the customer responded to the dunning notice. Null if no response received.

attributes.name: response_received_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has responded to this dunning notice (True) or not (False).

attributes.name: response_type
attributes.description: The nature of the customer response to the dunning notice. Payment promise indicates commitment to pay, dispute raised indicates disagreement with charges, payment plan request indicates request for installment arrangement, contact request indicates need for discussion.

attributes.name: sap_dunning_document_number
attributes.description: The SAP FI dunning document number generated by the dunning program. 10-digit numeric identifier.

attributes.name: total_overdue_amount
attributes.description: The total amount of receivables that are overdue and subject to this dunning action, in the billing currency.

products.name: rebate_agreement
products.description: Dealer or fleet rebate agreement defining the terms under which volume-based or performance-based rebates are accrued and settled. Captures agreement number, agreement type (volume_rebate/loyalty_bonus/conquest_bonus/fleet_incentive/model_mix_bonus), beneficiary account, vehicle model scope, agreement period, target volume, achieved volume, rebate rate or amount, accrual method (periodic/milestone), settlement frequency (monthly/quarterly/annual), settlement status, and SAP SD rebate agreement reference (BO01/BO02). Drives credit memo generation upon settlement.

attributes.name: rebate_agreement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the rebate agreement record. Primary key.

attributes.name: beneficiary_account_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the dealer or fleet customer account that is the recipient of the rebate. Links to dealer or customer master data.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: Rebate programs are tied to specific regulatory incentives; linking enables tracking of compliance‑driven rebates.

attributes.name: vehicle_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.vehicle_program. Business justification: Rebate agreements are defined per vehicle program; linking to vehicle_program allows accurate accruals, compliance reporting, and program‑specific financial analysis.

attributes.name: accrual_method
attributes.description: Method by which rebate amounts are calculated and accrued: periodic (monthly/quarterly calculation), milestone (triggered when target is reached), transaction_based (accrued per invoice).

attributes.name: achieved_volume
attributes.description: Actual number of vehicle units sold or delivered under this agreement as of the last accrual calculation. Updated periodically based on billing transactions.

attributes.name: agreement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the rebate agreement, typically generated by SAP SD rebate management (BO01/BO02) or dealer management system.

attributes.name: agreement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the rebate agreement: draft (under negotiation), active (in force), suspended (temporarily paused), expired (validity period ended), terminated (cancelled before expiry), settled (final payment completed).

attributes.name: agreement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the rebate agreement defining the incentive structure: volume_rebate (quantity-based), loyalty_bonus (retention incentive), conquest_bonus (new customer acquisition), fleet_incentive (commercial fleet programs), model_mix_bonus (product mix targets), early_payment_discount (payment terms incentive).

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the rebate agreement was approved by authorized personnel. Null if not yet approved.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Approval workflow status for the rebate agreement: pending_approval (awaiting management sign-off), approved (authorized for execution), rejected (not approved).

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or user ID of the manager or executive who approved the rebate agreement. Null if not yet approved.

attributes.name: beneficiary_type
attributes.description: Classification of the rebate recipient: dealer (franchise dealership), fleet_customer (commercial fleet operator), distributor (regional distributor), broker (third-party intermediary).

attributes.name: contract_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or file path to the signed legal contract or agreement document supporting this rebate arrangement. Used for audit and compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the rebate agreement record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this agreement (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY).

attributes.name: dealer_tier
attributes.description: Performance tier classification of the dealer beneficiary, used to determine rebate eligibility and rate structure. Higher tiers may receive enhanced rebate terms.

attributes.name: dispute_description
attributes.description: Description of the dispute or disagreement related to the rebate agreement terms, calculation, or settlement. Null if no dispute exists.

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the rebate agreement or its settlement is currently under dispute. True if disputed, False otherwise. Used to flag agreements requiring resolution.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the rebate agreement expires and no further transactions accrue rebates. Nullable for open-ended agreements subject to annual renewal.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the rebate agreement becomes active and eligible transactions begin accruing rebates. Aligns with fiscal year (FY) or model year (MY) boundaries.

attributes.name: is_retroactive
attributes.description: Indicates whether the rebate agreement applies retroactively to transactions that occurred before the agreement effective start date. True if retroactive, False otherwise.

attributes.name: last_accrual_calculation_date
attributes.description: Date when the rebate accrual amounts were last recalculated based on eligible transactions. Used to track data freshness and trigger next calculation cycle.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the rebate agreement record was last updated. Used for change tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: last_settlement_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent rebate settlement payment or credit memo issuance. Null if no settlements have occurred.

attributes.name: next_settlement_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next rebate settlement payment or credit memo generation. Null if agreement is settled or terminated.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, special terms, or clarifications related to the rebate agreement. Used for operational context and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: outstanding_balance
attributes.description: Remaining rebate amount accrued but not yet settled. Calculated as total_accrued_amount minus total_settled_amount.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Method by which rebate is settled: credit_memo (issued against future purchases), direct_payment (bank transfer or check), offset_against_invoice (deducted from current receivables).

attributes.name: powertrain_scope
attributes.description: Powertrain types eligible for the rebate: all (any powertrain), ICE (Internal Combustion Engine), HEV (Hybrid Electric Vehicle), PHEV (Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle), EV (Electric Vehicle). Used to target electrification incentives.

attributes.name: rebate_amount_per_unit
attributes.description: Fixed rebate amount paid per vehicle unit sold. Used for flat-rate rebate structures. Null if percentage-based rebate is used.

attributes.name: rebate_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage rate applied to eligible transaction amounts to calculate rebate accrual. Used for percentage-based rebate structures. Null if fixed amount rebate is used.

attributes.name: sales_region
attributes.description: Geographic sales region or territory to which this rebate agreement applies. Used for regional incentive programs and performance tracking.

attributes.name: sap_rebate_agreement_number
attributes.description: SAP SD rebate agreement reference number from transaction codes BO01 (create) or BO02 (change). Used for system integration and traceability.

attributes.name: settlement_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which accrued rebates are paid out to the beneficiary: monthly, quarterly, semi_annual, annual, or upon_completion (at agreement end).

attributes.name: settlement_status
attributes.description: Current status of rebate settlement: not_started (no payments made), in_progress (settlement cycle active), partially_settled (some payments made), fully_settled (all accruals paid), disputed (settlement under review).

attributes.name: target_volume
attributes.description: Target number of vehicle units that must be sold or delivered to qualify for the rebate. Null for non-volume-based agreements.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the rebate agreement was terminated early, if applicable. Null for agreements that expired naturally or are still active.

attributes.name: total_accrued_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative rebate amount accrued under this agreement as of the last calculation date. Represents the liability owed to the beneficiary.

attributes.name: total_settled_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative rebate amount paid out to the beneficiary through credit memos or direct payments. Used to track settlement progress.

attributes.name: vehicle_model_scope
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of vehicle models or model families eligible for this rebate agreement. May reference SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) codes or model year (MY) designations. Empty indicates all models are eligible.

products.name: rebate_accrual
products.description: Periodic accrual record tracking the accumulation of rebate entitlements under a rebate agreement based on actual sales volumes or performance milestones achieved within a period. Captures accrual period, rebate agreement reference, accrued units, accrued amount, cumulative accrued amount, accrual basis (invoiced_units/registered_units), accrual status (open/posted/reversed), and SAP CO-PA accrual posting reference. Enables accurate liability provisioning and rebate settlement forecasting.

attributes.name: rebate_accrual_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the rebate accrual record. Primary key for the rebate accrual entity.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Cost‑center assignment for rebate accruals enables internal cost tracking.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Rebate accruals must be posted to a GL account; replaces denormalized gl_account_code.

attributes.name: primary_rebate_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the finance manager or controller who approved this accrual for posting. Null if not yet approved.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Profit‑center linkage required for rebate profitability analysis.

attributes.name: rebate_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent rebate agreement under which this accrual is recorded. Links to the master rebate agreement contract.

attributes.name: rebate_created_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: System user ID of the person or automated process that created this accrual record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: rebate_customer_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fleet or retail customer who is the beneficiary of this rebate accrual. Null if the rebate is for a dealer.

attributes.name: rebate_dealer_dealership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealer or distributor who is the beneficiary of this rebate accrual. Null if the rebate is for a fleet customer or other non-dealer party.

attributes.name: rebate_dealership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealer or distributor who is the beneficiary of this rebate accrual. Null if the rebate is for a fleet customer or other non-dealer party.

attributes.name: rebate_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the finance manager or controller who approved this accrual for posting. Null if not yet approved.

attributes.name: rebate_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fleet or retail customer who is the beneficiary of this rebate accrual. Null if the rebate is for a dealer.

attributes.name: rebate_updated_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: System user ID of the person or automated process that last modified this accrual record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: REQUIRED: Rebate accruals are calculated per SKU sold; linking enables accurate accrual reporting per vehicle configuration.

attributes.name: tertiary_rebate_updated_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: System user ID of the person or automated process that last modified this accrual record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: accrual_basis
attributes.description: The measurement basis used to calculate the accrual. Invoiced_units uses billed quantities; registered_units uses vehicle registrations; shipped_units uses factory shipments; delivered_units uses dealer deliveries; retail_sales uses end-customer sales.

attributes.name: accrual_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding this accrual, such as calculation methodology, special adjustments, or reconciliation remarks. Used for audit trail and internal documentation.

attributes.name: accrual_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the accrual record, typically generated by the financial system. Used for audit trail and reconciliation.

attributes.name: accrual_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last day of the period during which sales or performance milestones were achieved that triggered this accrual. Defines the end of the measurement window.

attributes.name: accrual_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first day of the period during which sales or performance milestones were achieved that triggered this accrual. Defines the beginning of the measurement window.

attributes.name: accrual_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the accrual record. Open indicates accrual is calculated but not yet posted to the general ledger; posted indicates the liability has been recorded; reversed indicates the accrual was backed out; settled indicates payment has been made; cancelled indicates the accrual was voided; pending_approval indicates awaiting finance approval.

attributes.name: accrued_amount
attributes.description: The rebate liability amount accrued for this specific period, calculated based on the accrued units and the rebate rate defined in the agreement. Represents the incremental accrual for this period only.

attributes.name: accrued_units
attributes.description: The quantity of units (vehicles, parts, or other items) that qualified for rebate during this accrual period. Measured in the unit of measure specified in the rebate agreement.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Workflow approval status for this accrual. Pending indicates awaiting finance approval; approved indicates cleared for posting; rejected indicates the accrual was not approved and should be cancelled.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this accrual was approved for posting. Null if not yet approved.

attributes.name: copa_posting_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the CO-PA posting document created when this accrual was posted to the profitability analysis module. Used for traceability between accrual and profitability reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this accrual record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: cumulative_accrued_amount
attributes.description: The total rebate liability accrued from the start of the rebate agreement through the end of this accrual period. Used for tracking progress toward tiered rebate thresholds and total liability exposure.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the accrued amounts are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY, CNY).

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month or quarter) within the fiscal year in which this accrual period falls. Typically 1-12 for monthly periods or 1-4 for quarterly periods.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which this accrual period falls. Used for financial reporting and year-end accrual reconciliation.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which this accrual was posted to the general ledger. May differ from the accrual period end date due to month-end close timing.

attributes.name: rebate_rate
attributes.description: The per-unit rebate rate applied to calculate the accrued amount for this period. May be a fixed amount per unit or a percentage of the transaction value, depending on the agreement structure.

attributes.name: rebate_rate_type
attributes.description: The structure of the rebate rate. Fixed_per_unit is a flat amount per unit; percentage is a percentage of sales value; tiered uses different rates at different volume thresholds; volume_based varies continuously with volume.

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: The date on which this accrual was reversed, if applicable. Null if the accrual has not been reversed.

attributes.name: reversal_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for reversing this accrual (e.g., calculation error, agreement termination, duplicate entry). Null if not reversed.

attributes.name: sales_region_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the sales region or territory in which the qualifying sales occurred. Used for regional rebate program segmentation and reporting.

attributes.name: sap_document_number
attributes.description: The SAP financial document number generated when this accrual was posted to the general ledger. Used for audit trail and reconciliation with SAP FI.

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the rebate liability was settled through payment or credit memo issuance. Null if not yet settled.

attributes.name: settlement_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the payment document or credit memo that settled this accrual. Null if not yet settled.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which accrued quantities are measured. EA=each (parts), VEH=vehicle, KG=kilogram, LTR=liter, M3=cubic meter, TON=metric ton, SET=set of components. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|VEH|KG|LTR|M3|TON|SET — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this accrual record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

products.name: run
products.description: Batch billing run record representing a scheduled or ad-hoc execution of the invoice generation process for a defined set of billing accounts, order types, or billing dates. Captures run ID, run type (periodic/manual/correction), billing date, billing category (vehicle_sales/parts/service/fleet/export), number of invoices generated, total billed amount, run status (scheduled/in_progress/completed/failed/cancelled), error count, run initiated by, and SAP SD billing due list execution reference (VF04). Provides operational traceability for mass billing cycles.

attributes.name: run_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the billing run batch execution. Primary key.

attributes.name: approved_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: User ID of the supervisor or manager who approved the billing run for execution, required for high-value or correction runs.

attributes.name: billing_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.billing_period. Business justification: A billing run belongs to a billing period; linking run to billing_period clarifies the period context.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: User ID or system account that triggered the billing run, used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: primary_run_approved_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: User ID of the supervisor or manager who approved the billing run for execution, required for high-value or correction runs.

attributes.name: actual_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the billing run execution completed or failed, used for duration calculation and operational reporting.

attributes.name: actual_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the billing run execution began, used for performance monitoring and variance analysis against scheduled time.

attributes.name: batch_job_reference
attributes.description: SAP batch job ID or scheduler job reference for the billing run execution, used for technical troubleshooting and job monitoring.

attributes.name: billing_category
attributes.description: Business classification of the billing scope: vehicle_sales (retail and dealer vehicle invoices), parts (OEM parts and accessories), service (after-sales maintenance and repair), fleet (corporate fleet accounts), export (international sales), warranty (warranty claim reimbursements), lease (leasing contracts), or rental (vehicle rental charges). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: vehicle_sales|parts|service|fleet|export|warranty|lease|rental — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: billing_date
attributes.description: The business date on which invoices in this run are dated and become effective for accounting and payment terms calculation. Determines invoice due dates and fiscal period assignment.

attributes.name: billing_due_list_reference
attributes.description: SAP SD transaction VF04 billing due list execution reference number, linking this run to the SAP billing due list selection and processing log.

attributes.name: billing_entity_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the legal entity or company code issuing the invoices in this run, used for multi-entity OEM structures and regional billing organizations.

attributes.name: billing_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the billing period covered by this run, defining the cutoff for transactions included in the batch.

attributes.name: billing_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the billing period covered by this run, used for periodic billing cycles (e.g., monthly vehicle sales, service contracts).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the billing run record was first created in the system, used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the total billed amount (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY), representing the reporting currency for this run.

attributes.name: distribution_channel_code
attributes.description: SAP SD distribution channel code for the billing run (e.g., dealer network, direct sales, online, fleet).

attributes.name: division_code
attributes.description: SAP SD division code representing the product line or business segment (e.g., passenger vehicles, commercial trucks, parts, service).

attributes.name: edi_transmission_status
attributes.description: Status of EDI 810 invoice transmission for this billing run: not_applicable (no EDI invoices), pending (queued), transmitted (sent to trading partners), acknowledged (receipt confirmed), or failed (transmission error).

attributes.name: error_count
attributes.description: Total number of errors encountered during the billing run execution, including validation errors, data quality issues, and system exceptions.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Fiscal period (month or quarter) within the fiscal year to which the billing run is assigned, used for period-based revenue reporting.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year to which the billing run and generated invoices are assigned for financial reporting and period closing.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and comments about the billing run execution, including special instructions, known issues, or manual interventions performed.

attributes.name: output_format
attributes.description: Primary output format for invoices generated in this run: pdf (electronic document), xml (structured data), edi (EDI 810 invoice), print (physical mail), or email (direct delivery).

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: Date on which the billing run invoices are posted to the financial ledger in SAP FI, determining the accounting period for revenue recognition.

attributes.name: print_queue_name
attributes.description: Name of the SAP output device or print queue to which invoices were sent for physical printing and mailing.

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: Date on which the billing run was reversed and credit memos were issued to cancel the original invoices.

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this billing run was subsequently reversed or cancelled, requiring credit memo generation and financial adjustment.

attributes.name: reversal_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for billing run reversal (e.g., pricing error, wrong billing date, duplicate run, system error).

attributes.name: run_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the billing run, typically formatted as BR-YYYYMMDD-NNNN for traceability and audit purposes.

attributes.name: run_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the billing run: scheduled (queued for execution), in_progress (actively processing), completed (successfully finished), failed (terminated with errors), cancelled (aborted by user), or partially_completed (finished with some errors).

attributes.name: run_type
attributes.description: Classification of the billing run execution mode: periodic (scheduled recurring), manual (user-initiated), correction (error fix), rerun (retry after failure), ad_hoc (one-time special), or final (end-of-period closing).

attributes.name: sales_organization_code
attributes.description: SAP SD sales organization responsible for the billing run, representing the commercial unit (e.g., North America Automotive, Europe Commercial Vehicles).

attributes.name: scheduled_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Planned date and time when the billing run was scheduled to begin execution, used for batch job planning and SLA tracking.

attributes.name: selection_criteria
attributes.description: Business rules and filters applied to select billing-eligible documents for this run (e.g., customer group, sales order type, delivery date range, billing block status).

attributes.name: total_billed_amount
attributes.description: Sum of all net invoice amounts generated in this billing run, representing the total revenue recognized in the batch.

attributes.name: total_discount_amount
attributes.description: Sum of all discounts, rebates, and allowances applied across invoices in this run, used for pricing analytics and margin analysis.

attributes.name: total_gross_amount
attributes.description: Sum of all gross invoice amounts before discounts and taxes across all invoices in this run, representing the list-price revenue.

attributes.name: total_invoices_failed
attributes.description: Number of invoice generation attempts that failed due to data errors, validation failures, or system issues during this run.

attributes.name: total_invoices_generated
attributes.description: Total number of invoice documents successfully created during this billing run, used for volume tracking and reconciliation.

attributes.name: total_tax_amount
attributes.description: Sum of all tax amounts (VAT, sales tax, GST) across all invoices generated in this run, used for tax reporting and reconciliation.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the billing run record was last modified, capturing status changes, error updates, and completion events.

attributes.name: warning_count
attributes.description: Total number of warnings generated during the billing run, indicating non-critical issues that did not prevent invoice creation but require review.

products.name: write_off
products.description: Bad debt write-off record documenting the formal decision to write off an uncollectable receivable balance from a billing account. Captures write-off date, billing account reference, original invoice references, write-off amount, write-off reason (bankruptcy/insolvency/uncontactable/statute_of_limitations/commercial_settlement), approval authority, approval date, write-off category (full/partial), recovery flag, recovery amount if subsequently collected, and SAP FI write-off document reference. Supports credit risk management and bad debt provisioning.

attributes.name: write_off_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the bad debt write-off record. Primary key.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the billing account from which the receivable is being written off.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Cost‑center linkage for write‑offs supports expense analysis of bad‑debt.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Write‑off entries must be posted to a GL account; replaces denormalized code.

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary invoice associated with this write-off. Links to the original billing document.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Profit‑center association for write‑offs enables profitability impact assessment.

attributes.name: vin_registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vehicle.vin_registry. Business justification: Write‑offs of vehicle invoices must be tied to the underlying vehicle for loss analysis and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: write_approval_authority_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or manager who authorized the write-off. Links to workforce/employee master data.

attributes.name: write_customer_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the retail customer or fleet account associated with the written-off receivable. Links to customer master data.

attributes.name: write_dealer_dealership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealership if the write-off relates to dealer invoicing or dealer-originated receivables. Nullable for direct retail transactions.

attributes.name: write_dealership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealership if the write-off relates to dealer invoicing or dealer-originated receivables. Nullable for direct retail transactions.

attributes.name: write_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or manager who authorized the write-off. Links to workforce/employee master data.

attributes.name: write_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the retail customer or fleet account associated with the written-off receivable. Links to customer master data.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The total monetary value of the receivable being written off. Represents the net uncollectable balance.

attributes.name: approval_authority_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual who approved the write-off, captured for audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the write-off was formally approved by the authorized authority.

attributes.name: approval_level
attributes.description: The organizational level at which the write-off was approved, typically based on write-off amount thresholds. Values: manager, director, vp (vice president), cfo (chief financial officer).

attributes.name: business_unit_code
attributes.description: The business unit or division responsible for the original sale (e.g., vehicle sales, parts, service). Used for divisional bad debt reporting.

attributes.name: write_off_category
attributes.description: Indicates whether the write-off is for the full outstanding balance or a partial amount. Values: full (entire balance written off), partial (portion of balance written off).

attributes.name: collection_agency_code
attributes.description: Reference to the third-party collection agency assigned to pursue recovery of the written-off debt. Nullable if no agency was engaged.

attributes.name: collection_status
attributes.description: Current status of collection efforts for the written-off debt. Values: not_assigned (no collection action), assigned (sent to agency), in_progress (active collection), recovered (payment received), closed (collection efforts ceased).

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: The user ID or username of the system user who created the write-off record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The system timestamp when the write-off record was first created in the database. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the write-off amount (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY).

attributes.name: days_past_due_at_write_off
attributes.description: The number of days the receivable was overdue at the time of write-off. Used for aging analysis and credit policy evaluation.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month or quarter) within the fiscal year when the write-off was recorded.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which the write-off was recorded, used for financial reporting and period analysis.

attributes.name: legal_case_reference
attributes.description: Reference number for any associated legal case, bankruptcy filing, or court proceeding related to the write-off. Nullable if no legal action was involved.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, supporting documentation references, or special circumstances related to the write-off decision.

attributes.name: original_due_date
attributes.description: The original payment due date of the invoice before it became delinquent and was subsequently written off.

attributes.name: original_invoice_amount
attributes.description: The original gross amount of the invoice before any payments, credits, or write-offs were applied. Provides context for the write-off magnitude.

attributes.name: outstanding_balance_before_write_off
attributes.description: The receivable balance that was outstanding immediately before the write-off was applied. May differ from original invoice amount if partial payments were received.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The accounting period date when the write-off was posted to the general ledger. May differ from write_off_date for period-end adjustments.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the primary reason for the write-off. Values: bankruptcy (customer filed for bankruptcy), insolvency (customer insolvent), uncontactable (customer cannot be reached), statute_of_limitations (debt legally uncollectable), commercial_settlement (negotiated settlement), fraud (fraudulent transaction).

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative explanation of the circumstances leading to the write-off decision. Provides additional context beyond the reason code.

attributes.name: recovery_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount recovered after the write-off was recorded. Null if no recovery has occurred. Used to track bad debt recovery income.

attributes.name: recovery_date
attributes.description: The date on which a recovery payment was received for a previously written-off receivable. Null if no recovery has occurred.

attributes.name: recovery_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether any portion of the written-off amount was subsequently recovered. True if recovery occurred, False otherwise.

attributes.name: sales_region_code
attributes.description: The sales region or geographic territory associated with the original sale. Used for regional bad debt analysis.

attributes.name: sap_accounting_document_number
attributes.description: The SAP accounting document number for the general ledger posting of the write-off. May differ from the write-off document number in multi-step posting scenarios.

attributes.name: sap_write_off_document_number
attributes.description: The SAP FI document number generated when the write-off was posted to the financial system. Used for reconciliation and audit trail.

attributes.name: updated_by_user
attributes.description: The user ID or username of the system user who last modified the write-off record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The system timestamp when the write-off record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: write_off_date
attributes.description: The date on which the formal decision to write off the uncollectable receivable was executed. This is the business event date for the write-off.

attributes.name: write_off_number
attributes.description: Business-readable unique identifier for the write-off transaction, typically following organizational numbering convention (e.g., WO-20240001234).

products.name: intercompany_invoice
products.description: Internal billing document issued between Automotive legal entities or subsidiaries for intercompany vehicle transfers, CKD/SKD kit supply, shared services, or royalty charges. Captures intercompany invoice number, issuing entity, receiving entity, transaction type (vehicle_transfer/CKD_supply/SKD_supply/royalty/management_fee/shared_service), transfer price basis (cost_plus/market_price/arm_length), amount, currency, applicable transfer pricing policy reference, tax treatment, and SAP FI intercompany document reference. Supports global intercompany reconciliation and transfer pricing compliance.

attributes.name: intercompany_invoice_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the intercompany invoice record. Primary key.

attributes.name: issuing_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.billing_account. Business justification: Intercompany invoices should reference the issuing billing account; the code and name become redundant.

attributes.name: vin_registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vehicle.vin_registry. Business justification: Intercompany invoices for vehicle transfers reference the VIN; FK supports inter‑entity reconciliation and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Any adjustments applied to the gross amount, such as discounts, rebates, or transfer pricing adjustments. Positive values increase the invoice; negative values decrease it.

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: Cost center code in SAP CO that bears the cost or revenue associated with this intercompany transaction. Used for internal cost allocation.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who created this intercompany invoice record in the system. Used for accountability and audit purposes.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this intercompany invoice record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the intercompany invoice is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY, CNY).

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) showing whether the receiving entity has raised a dispute on this intercompany invoice due to pricing, quantity, or quality discrepancies.

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for dispute if dispute_flag is True. Captures details such as pricing disagreement, quantity mismatch, or quality issue.

attributes.name: distribution_channel
attributes.description: SAP SD distribution channel through which the intercompany transaction flows (e.g., wholesale, retail, direct). Defines the route-to-market.

attributes.name: division
attributes.description: SAP SD division representing the product line or business unit (e.g., passenger vehicles, commercial vehicles, parts). Used for segment reporting.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the receiving entity is expected to settle the intercompany invoice amount.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Fiscal period (month or quarter) within the fiscal year when the invoice was issued. Typically 1-12 for monthly periods.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year in which the intercompany invoice was issued, used for financial reporting and period-based reconciliation.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code to which the intercompany invoice revenue or expense is posted. Aligns with the corporate chart of accounts.

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: Total invoice amount before taxes, adjustments, or deductions. Represents the base transfer price or service charge.

attributes.name: intercompany_invoice_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the intercompany invoice: draft (being prepared), issued (sent to receiving entity), acknowledged (received and accepted), disputed (under review for discrepancies), settled (payment completed), cancelled (voided).

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique invoice number assigned to this intercompany transaction. Typically follows format IC followed by 10 digits.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Date when the intercompany invoice was formally issued by the issuing entity to the receiving entity.

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: Model year of the vehicle or product being transferred. Applicable primarily to vehicle_transfer and CKD/SKD supply transactions.

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: Final payable amount after applying taxes and adjustments. Calculated as gross_amount + tax_amount + adjustment_amount.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments related to this intercompany invoice, such as special instructions, approvals, or clarifications.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Method by which the receiving entity will settle the invoice: wire_transfer (bank wire), ach (automated clearing house), check (paper check), netting (multilateral netting arrangement), offset (offset against reciprocal invoices).

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Code representing the payment terms agreed between issuing and receiving entities (e.g., NET30, NET60, immediate). Defines the payment schedule and discount eligibility.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: Date when the intercompany invoice was posted to the general ledger in both issuing and receiving entities.

attributes.name: profit_center
attributes.description: Profit center code in SAP CO (Controlling) that captures the profitability impact of this intercompany transaction for internal management reporting.

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: Number of units (vehicles, kits, or service units) covered by this intercompany invoice. Typically 1 for vehicle transfers, multiple for CKD/SKD kits or shared services.

attributes.name: receiving_entity_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the Automotive legal entity or subsidiary that receives and must pay this intercompany invoice. Typically 2-letter country code followed by 4-digit entity identifier.

attributes.name: receiving_entity_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the receiving entity or subsidiary.

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: External reference document number such as a purchase order, delivery note, or contract number that supports this intercompany invoice. Used for traceability.

attributes.name: sales_organization
attributes.description: SAP SD sales organization code responsible for the intercompany transaction. Represents the selling unit within the issuing entity.

attributes.name: sap_fi_document_number
attributes.description: SAP FI document number that records this intercompany invoice in the general ledger. Used for reconciliation and audit trail.

attributes.name: sap_intercompany_clearing_account
attributes.description: General ledger account number used for intercompany clearing and reconciliation in SAP FI. Tracks outstanding balances between entities.

attributes.name: settlement_date
